raw.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tools & Systems
raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

raw.excerpt: Tu désires côtoyer des gens passionnés?  Évoluer en tant que professionnel dans un environnement moderne qui favorise la conciliation travail-vie personnelle?
raw.description:
Tu désires côtoyer des gens passionnés? Évoluer en tant que professionnel dans un environnement moderne qui favorise la conciliation travail-vie personnelle? Faire partie de l'équipe Unicorne, c'est tout ça, et encore plus! Télétravail, mentorat, horaires flexibles, formations payées, hackathon, une équipe authentique et professionnelle… Voilà notre quotidien et notre mission.

Chez Unicorne, les défis ne manquent pas et on s'amuse en changeant le monde un compte AWS à la fois. Nous accompagnons nos clients et partenaires dans leur utilisation de l'infonuagique, afin d'innover plus efficacement et atteindre des résultats tangibles. Que ce soit en développant des solutions SaaS complètes ou en optimisant des infrastructures AWS, nous travaillons avec des technologies de pointe à tous les jours et générons diverses sources de revenus récurrents.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) représentant(e) en prospection commerciale (SDR) pour collaborer étroitement avec le Vice-Président Croissance. Tu seras la première ligne de contact avec nos prospects. Ton rôle : ouvrir des conversations qui comptent, créer des opportunités, et nourrir le pipeline de ventes. Tu seras coaché pour devenir une machine à qualifier, comprendre les besoins clients, et connecter avec les bons décideurs.

Ton quotidien

  • Générer et qualifier des opportunités en faisant de la prospection active (cold calling, emails, LinkedIn)
  • Effectuer un volume élevé d'appels quotidiens
  • Identifier et cibler les bons comptes à l'aide d'outils modernes
  • Utiliser des scripts de vente et les adapter selon les conversations
  • Surmonter les objections initiales et susciter l'intérêt pour les solutions Unicorne
  • Qualifier les prospects selon la méthodologie établie (besoins, budget, autorité, timeline)
  • Planifier des rencontres entre prospects qualifiés et l'équipe de ventes
  • Préparer des briefings complets pour l'équipe de ventes (contexte, besoins, opportunités)
  • Maintenir le CRM propre, à jour et actionnable
  • Gérer le suivi, relancer, et adapter ton approche selon la personnalité du prospect
  • Entretenir des relations fortes pour maximiser le potentiel de nos clients, de nos partenaires et d'AWS
  • Participer activement à la stratégie d'outbound (et proposer tes idées!)
  • Suivre et rapporter les métriques de performance quotidiennes/hebdomadaires

Profil recherché

  • Diplôme d'études collégiales (DEC) ou universitaire en vente, marketing, administration ou domaine connexe
  • 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la vente
  • Autonome, organisé(e) et orienté(e) résultats
  • Bilingue français/anglais, autant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit et excellentes compétences en communication verbale
  • Résilience et persévérance face aux refus
  • Capacité à établir rapidement un rapport et susciter l'intérêt
  • Expérience en cold calling ou prospection téléphonique (atout majeur)
  • Maîtrise des outils CRM (HubSpot ou équivalent)
  • Aisance avec les outils de communication (téléphone, email, LinkedIn)
  • Expérience dans le secteur technologique ou SaaS(atout)

Pourquoi tu vas aimer ce poste

Tu ne seras pas laissé(e) à toi-même. Tu recevras une formation continue sur les techniques de prospection, tu auras accès à un stack moderne d'outils , et tu évolueras dans une culture de feedback et d'amélioration continue. Le rôle est évolutif : si tu performes, on te prépare pour la suite de ta carrière en vente. C'est un tremplin vers d'autres rôles en ventes avec un développement de compétences transférables en vente B2B.

Notre offre

En plus des défis stimulants, des technologies modernes et une équipe fantastique, nous offrons :

  • Télétravail à 100%
  • Poste permanent 35 à 40 heures par semaine avec un vrai horaire flexible
  • 4 semaines de vacances
  • 1 semaine de congés personnels
  • 14 journées fériées par année, dont 7 pendant la période des fêtes
  • REER collectif (contribution employeur jusqu'à 2%)
  • Assurances collectives (payées à 50%) avec télémédecine
  • MacBook Pro et tout le matériel nécessaire fourni dont un cellulaire payé
  • Allocation annuelle pour améliorer ton espace de télétravail
  • Accès à un espace de coworking une fois par semaine
  • Club social très actif
  • Formations continues payées, incluant les certifications AWS

raw.title: Lead Motion & Graphic Designer
raw.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets.
raw.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Lead Motion & Graphic Designer in the Curriculum team, you’ll turn complex tech concepts into clear visual and interactive learning experiences, and lead the team that makes them. About 80% of your time goes to hands-on design, motion, video, and interactive work; the other 20% to team leadership. Curriculum visuals help students understand and remember a concept, so we favor clarity, calm pacing, and accurate diagrams over flashy effects.

What you will do

  • Design learning visuals. Create graphics, animations, motion pieces, and explainer videos with Learning Experience Designers, from concept and storyboard to final edit.
  • Set the quality bar. Own visual and motion standards for curriculum content: guidelines, templates, and reusable asset libraries.
  • Lead the team. Run critiques, weekly planning, and retros; mentor designers with regular, actionable feedback; improve intake, reviews, and handoffs.
  • Speed up production. Partner with product, design, and engineering on shared libraries, AI-assisted workflows, and automation of repetitive work.
  • Prototype interactive formats. Design clickable diagrams, simple simulations, and step-by-step visual explainers for our learning platform.
  • Finish video. Edit and enhance video content, adding simple visual effects and sound design.
  • Experiment with new formats. Test new video and interactive formats, using Claude Design and Claude Code to prototype faster.

Requirements

Must have

  • 4+ years in motion and graphic design. A portfolio showing motion, graphic design, and visual storytelling, built in After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma.
  • Design leadership. Experience leading or mentoring designers, or owning design standards and processes for a team.
  • English at B2 or higher. Confident written and spoken English for daily work in a remote, cross-functional team.

Nice to have

  • Interactive and UX work. Interactive pieces in your portfolio, and a grasp of how people read, scan, and interact with learning materials.
  • AI creative tools. Hands-on use of Claude Design, Claude Code, or AI agents in Figma to prototype.
  • Ed-tech and languages. Experience in ed-tech, e-learning, or instructional design; Spanish or Portuguese.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration.
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

raw.title: Senior System/Cloud Engineer (Immediate Joiners preferred)
raw.excerpt: • Lead IT infrastructure projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and best practices.
raw.description:
• Lead IT infrastructure projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and best practices.
  • Provide technical leadership in cloud adoption, migration strategies, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Optimize cloud costs, performance, and security through continuous assessment and innovation.
  • Implement and enforce cloud governance, compliance, and security frameworks.
  • Automate cloud infrastructure deployment and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.
  • Troubleshoot complex system and network issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with IT and application teams to improve infrastructure automation, deployment processes, and operational workflows.
  • Develop and enforce IT policies, procedures, and best practices for cloud operations.
  • Administer, configure, and support SharePoint Online, including site architecture, permissions, governance, security, lifecycle management, and integration with Microsoft 365 services.
  • Provide Tier 3 administration and advanced technical support for the Microsoft 365 environment, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive for Business, identity and access management, security, compliance, and complex incident resolution.
  • Participate in internal and external audits by providing IT technical support, required documentation, system evidence, and timely responses to audit inquiries.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical training to the IT team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in IT system engineering, cloud architecture, or a related role.
  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including Virtual Machines, Azure AD, Networking, Storage, and Security.
  • Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with SharePoint Online administration, site architecture, permissions, governance, security, and integration with Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform.
  • Strong experience in automation and scripting with PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
  • Deep understanding of networking concepts, security protocols, VPNs, and firewall management.
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps practices and cloud automation.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise-level IT infrastructure, virtualization, and containerization.
  • Experience with cloud cost management and optimization strategies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a leadership capacity.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with GxP and GAMP5 framework.
  • Advanced Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AZ-305, AZ-400, and SC-500) are highly desirable.
  • Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud strategies and solutions.
  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions (M&A), including IT due diligence, infrastructure integration, tenant migrations, and technology consolidation, is desirable.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and enterprise IT frameworks.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

Location: Remote working in the UK

Salary: £30,204.75 rising to £32,692 after 1 year of service

Responsible to: Head of Programme Support

Contract type: Full Time (37 hours per week), Fixed Term until August 2027 with the possiblity to extend

Closing date: 6 November 2026, Midday

Interviews: We will be interviewing on a rolling basis. Please apply as soon as possible

Who we are

Futures For All is the largest social mobility charity in the UK. We help to level the playing field between state and independent schools by giving all young people access to the same prestigious networks available to the top fee-paying schools.

We believe that by inspiring young people to explore their ambitions through our speaker programme, facilitating access to multi-day experiences of the world of work, and supporting young people to successfully seize opportunities available to them, then we can make a profound difference to the lives of young people, their future happiness and prosperity.

By 2028, our ambition is that every young person in the UK has access to high quality work experience. Yet today, less than half of young people leave secondary school having had any work experience whatsoever.

Role Summary

This role sits within our Programme Support team and is crucial to the delivery of the charity’s programmes and hosting of virtual and in-person activities for young people. This role involves supporting schools and students as well as stakeholders in the delivery of work experience and charity programmes.

Key Duties / Responsibilities

  • Responding to enquiries from schools and students regarding questions about the application portal registration process and general troubleshooting
  • Helping with technical delivery processes using both our in-house software and that of external partners
  • Stakeholder engagement and management – working closely with organisations to deliver their virtual activities
  • Hosting virtual and in person activities including work experience and talks and supporting clients and the schools with the attendance lists and safeguarding
  • Supporting the technical hosting of virtual activities
  • Creating and developing content and structure of virtual activities and work placement
  • End-to-end technical support for partners, schools, and students
  • Enabling stakeholders in the delivery of work experience and charity programmes
  • Data Management and CRM
  • Inputting new data, maintaining existing records and generating reports
  • Creating bespoke impact reports for each programme (this may vary depending on the client)
  • Responding to and managing stakeholder queries via email and telephone
  • Supporting the delivery of charity programmes
  • Attending client, schools and other charity meetings and reporting of evaluation materials and scheduling of those meetings
  • Providing briefings for teachers/delivery partners, staff and volunteers for each event
  • Ensuring schools have any physical merchandise alongside the online materials available in advance of the sessions
  • Monitor the student and employer volunteer registrations and ensure the relevant paperwork is in place
  • Arrange the schools Data Sharing Agreements
  • Ensure safeguarding processes are followed for the events and that the clients staff have a clear awareness of safeguarding procedures
  • Ensure the prizes and merchandise for the programme are purchased and delivered to the schools
  • Planning in person and virtual events, including creating agendas and working out logistics for the day (this may vary depending on the client)

Skills / Experience / Knowledge:

Essential:

  • Experience of hosting virtual and in-person events for young people
  • Experience in creating and writing content for events
  • Experience in a similar delivery-focused role within a small, fast-paced organisation
  • Experience using Microsoft packages, including Outlook
  • Experience of using CRM software to achieve the tasks outlined above
  • Good customer service skills that mean queries are answered professionally and clearly
  • Excellent organisation skills and ability to learn quickly to ensure smooth delivery processes
  • Flexibility and a willingness to get stuck in and help with any tasks the team require support for
  • Ability to clearly communicate with students to ensure they understand our processes and are able to access opportunities
  • Are sociable and confident and happy building and maintaining relationships with multiple stakeholders
  • Excel at organising their workload and enjoy driving work forward independently

Desirable:

  • Experience of developing and delivering content to young people
  • Experience of working in programme support in education charities
  • Experience of using Salesforce
  • Experience of supporting young people via charity programmes
  • Experience of using Google Classrooms
  • Experience in creating and writing content for events

Diversity at our core

Futures For All is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process and encouraging equality and diversity among our workforces. We acknowledge that some candidates may require additional support to overcome barriers experienced during the application process. If you require any reasonable adjustments to support your application or interview, please reach out to us via

The Application Process:

Please apply as soon as possible by clicking the 'apply for this job' button in the top right-hand corner of the job advert. Once clicked, you will be asked to complete your application by submitting your CV and a cover letter. The cover letter is an opportunity for you to share the skills and knowledge you have to be successful in this role. Appointees are subject to a DBS check. You must have the right to work in the UK to apply.

The deadline to submit your application is 6 November 2026, Midday. Please note that we reserve the right to close this advertisement early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications

We will be interviewing on a rolling basis. Please apply as soon as possible.

Futures For All is committed to safeguarding the young people we work with and expects all staff members to share this commitment. Appointees are subject to a DBS check. Having a criminal record will not automatically exclude applicants. You are also required to have the Right to Work in the UK for this role.

Benefits offered at Futures For All

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Morning of your birthday off
  • £500 a year professional development fund
  • Option to purchase additional annual leave yearly
  • 'Winter shutdown' gifted so no need to use annual leave between Christmas and new years eve.
  • Early bank holiday finish - we finish at 3:30pm on a Friday before all bank holidays
  • 22.2 hours of volunteering days to use each year
  • Home office set up support
  • Enhanced sick pay
  • Enhanced family friendly leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Futures For All Values

PASSION: We are committed to levelling the playing field for young people across the UK, creating social mobility and tackling disadvantages.

AGILITY: We challenge our ideas of what is possible in order to better meet the needs of those we support. We are human, make mistakes, learn, evolve and adapt.

INTEGRITY: We act with empathy and bring our authentic selves to work every day. We value and respect the talent, time and intentions of those we work with.

COLLABORATION: We are one team with one mission and only by working together can we deliver better outcomes for young people. We support each other unconditionally and feel motivation in shared success as well as individual progress.

DIVERSITY: We know it takes people with different ideas, strengths, identities, interests, and cultural backgrounds to make our organisation succeed. We encourage constructive debate and critical friendship.

raw.excerpt: Position Overview:Connor Consulting is a fast-growing, modern, international company comprised of top-caliber professionals.
raw.description:
Position Overview:

Connor Consulting is a fast-growing, modern, international company comprised of top-caliber professionals. This role sits within the Software Publisher Services (SPS) line of business and is dedicated to a single, high-volume compliance program delivered on behalf of a global enterprise software publisher.

This is a platform-led program rather than a traditional audit role. Licensees complete their own compliance review through a dedicated audit platform, and the Program Associate drives that process end to end. You will own a large portfolio of engagements over the course of the year, with a large number active at any given time, and you will be accountable for getting each one started, unstuck, and closed. The work is high-cadence and relationship-driven: daily outreach, structured follow-up, clear escalation, and disciplined tracking. It is a strong fit for someone from a compliance, audit support, renewals or customer success background who is energized by volume, ownership, and consistent execution.

This is also a build role. The program is expanding, and the person who establishes the operating rhythm in the US will be positioned to add supporting staff and grow into a Manager role.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned portfolio of active compliance engagements and drive each one from initial outreach through closure against defined cycle-time and service level targets.
  • Conduct daily outreach and structured follow-up with licensee contacts by email and phone, maintaining persistent and professional contact cadences on unresponsive accounts and applying defined escalation triggers.
  • Onboard licensees onto the audit platform: explain the process and timeline, direct them to the platform, walk them through the required inputs, and resolve access or usability issues that stall completion.
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for licensee questions, objections, and concerns; handle pushback diplomatically and escalate contractual, disputed, or legal matters to the Senior Manager.
  • Lead the verification call with the licensee to confirm and clarify the data submitted through the platform.
  • Identify licensees unwilling or unable to use the platform and coordinate the exception path to a standard, manually executed review with the engagement team.
  • Review submissions for completeness and obvious anomalies, apply the program’s standardized methodology and templates, and prepare findings for Senior Manager review.
  • Maintain complete and accurate account status, contact history, and next actions in Connor’s engagement platform as the single system of record for the program.
  • Produce recurring program reporting for the client and internal leadership, including pipeline by stage, aging, response and completion rates, and results to date.
  • Monitor throughput, flag bottlenecks and recurring licensee objections, and recommend improvements to outreach templates, platform guidance, and process documentation.
  • Support the onboarding and day-to-day direction of additional program staff as the program scales.
  • Other duties may be assigned without notice.
  • Senior Associate: Carry a larger portfolio, own the most sensitive or highest-value accounts, quality review the work of supporting staff, and act as backup program lead.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • BA/BS in Business Administration, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • 2+ years in software license compliance, contract or audit compliance support, customer success, account management, renewals, inside sales, or a comparable high-volume client-facing role.
  • Exposure to software licensing concepts and contract terms. Prior license compliance or software asset management experience is preferred but not required; the ability to learn a publisher’s licensing model quickly is essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a high volume of concurrent accounts or cases without loss of accuracy or follow-through.
  • Comfort working from a repeatable playbook: applying the same process consistently across hundreds of accounts while recognizing the exceptions that require escalation.
  • Fluency with CRM, ticketing, or case management platforms (for example Salesforce, HubSpot, Monday.com, or Zendesk) and a track record of disciplined data hygiene.
  • Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite with solid Excel skills including lookups and pivot tables. Advanced modeling is not required.
  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to maintain a consistent and professional tone across a high volume of outbound correspondence.
  • Confident verbal communication and the ability to lead a call with a licensee’s technical, procurement, or finance contacts.
  • Professional persistence: comfortable following up repeatedly with unresponsive contacts and navigating resistance without escalating tension.
  • Self-directed, organized, and reliable with minimal day-to-day supervision.
  • Based in and available to work United States business hours, with occasional flexibility for licensees in other regions.
  • Minimal travel expected, up to 10%.

Preferred Additional Experience

  • Prior experience on a publisher-side or Big 4 software license compliance team.
  • Experience supporting customers through a self-service or customer-completed data collection platform.
  • Familiarity with common software deployment and usage data sources.
  • Second language capability (Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, or Polish) in view of planned EMEA expansion.

Competencies and Skills

raw.description:
About the opportunity

Join our Finance Division as an International Record to Report Manager to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every code line we write and every interface we design is another opportunity for us to enrich our customers’ experiences.

The R2R Manager owns the record-to-report process across our international entities and leads the team that delivers it. The role makes sure the books close accurately and on time, that technical accounting positions are sound and documented, and that audits, statutory accounts and controls run smoothly.

Some of the other responsibilities include :

  • Own the end-to-end R2R process, so accounts are complete, accurate and delivered within Group reporting deadlines.
  • Run the close calendar and track close KPIs, such as on-time close, reconciliation completion and post-close adjustments.
  • Make sure every balance sheet reconciliation is prepared, reviewed and approved, and that reconciling items are cleared promptly.
  • Own accruals, prepayments and journals standards, including coding and cut-off, so the team applies them consistently across regions.
  • Set the intercompany process, including monthly matching, elimination and loan balances.
  • Own fixed asset and capex accounting policy, including useful lives and the go-forward procedure.
  • Partner with FP&A to explain monthly business performance and variances.
  • Prepare the short-term and long-term operational cash forecast and funding needs.
  • Manage banking relationships and bank structure, and the capital adequacy reporting for regulated entities.
  • Bring acquisitions and newly onboarded entities into the R2R process.
  • Apply consistent methods across entities, and make sure any deviations are justified and documented.
  • Technical lead: the go-to for technical accounting, who forms, documents and defends positions, reviews the technical accountant's work and presents to auditors.
  • Policy ownership: revenue, leases, business combinations and PPA, impairment, share-based payments, capex useful lives, and consolidation, FX and intercompany, with the standards still to confirm.
  • Reporting and policy: statutory and sub-consolidation accounts, the policy manual with an annual review, and moves to new standards such as IFRS 18.

Controls, audit, tax and compliance

  • Own the control framework over R2R, with a strong controls bias. Design controls, make sure evidence is kept, and fix gaps. SOX experience is preferred.
  • Lead the year-end audit for the Group, sub-consolidations and local accounts, including auditor selection and handover where needed.
  • Make sure statutory accounts are filed on time in every jurisdiction, and that local GAAP aligns with Group reporting.
  • Work with the Tax team on corporate tax returns, transfer pricing and indirect tax analysis.
  • Keep policies, procedures and SOPs current, and review them every year.
  • Make sure the team meets accounting standards and regulations in every region we operate in.

Leadership, process improvement and systems

  • Lead, coach and develop the R2R team, including planning, staffing, training and goal setting, across remote and multi-location teams.
  • Manage the technical accountant and set clear ownership between technical accounting and day-to-day R2R.
  • Work with the NetSuite team on process improvements, automation and standard reporting.
  • Lead continuous improvement and standardisation projects with commercial leaders across the payments and software businesses.
  • Build a culture of quality, service for internal customers, flexibility and cost awareness.
  • Collaborate with FP&A, Tax, Treasury and Audit to meet shared reporting goals.

This role is fully remote across the UK, with occasional meet-ups at our Newcastle office.

What would make me a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our four core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

  • Fully qualified accountant (CIMA, ACCA, ACA or equivalent such as CPA).
  • Number of years of relevant R2R experience, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals, banking, fixed assets, intercompany and tax returns (direct and indirect).
  • Strong IFRS and US GAAP knowledge, with experience preparing consolidated IFRS accounts.
  • Technical accounting depth: able to form, document and defend positions on complex transactions.
  • Strong controls experience (SOX preferred).
  • Experience managing external audit to tight deadlines.
  • Proven people leader with remote teams across several locations.
  • Strong analytical skills, and clear written and verbal communication, including technical memos.

Desirable

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency group experience.
  • Hands-on experience with acquisition accounting, impairment testing and revenue recognition.
  • Experience with NetSuite or a similar ERP, and with consolidation tools.
  • Experience leading process improvement, automation and new-standard implementations.

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Some of our perks and benefits are:

  • Paid Parental Leave benefit programs
  • #GiveBackDays/Commitment to social impact – 3 extra days off to volunteer and give back to your local community
  • Ongoing dedication to Diversity & Inclusion initiatives such as D&I Council, Global Mentorship Program
  • Access to free mental health support
  • Flexible working arrangements

Ready to apply?

To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Please include the word "moonshot" at the top of your message to the Hiring Manager so that we know you took the time to read our job ad.

We understand that diverse candidates have diverse needs. We welcome you to inform us of any additional needs related to completing your job application or participating in the interview process, via .

Before you apply

To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorised to work in the United Kingdom. This applies to remote roles too, as we can only employ people who reside within the UK. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage.

Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly.

We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process .

Interview Recording and Background Checks

As part of our hiring process, successful candidates will be asked to complete background and identity verification checks. Many of our roles are remote, and to protect both candidates and our business from recruitment fraud, we may record video interviews via Microsoft Teams during the process. We keep any recordings and related data only for as long as the hiring process is active and do not retain them afterwards.

EEO and Artificial Intelligence

We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system with artificial intelligence-enabled features to support our recruitment process, but our recruitment team makes all hiring decisions after human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.

Xplor is dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability and age. We encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

We make it a priority to respond to every applicant.

Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.

  • Other duties as assigned

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Registered Nurse (RN)/ Licensed Practical Nurse(LPN) with unrestricted license
  • 2 years’ HEDIS abstraction/over-reading experience
  • Data entry proficiency
  • Working knowledge PDF, Word and Excel
  • Excellent written and communication skills
  • Database management

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in Pediatrics, Cardiology, Endocrinology and/or Obstetrics
  • QSHR proficiency

raw.description:
We're looking for a Product Manager to take real ownership of our new innovative customer app, DTCommand, working closely alongside development teams and design rather than sitting apart from them. This is more than managing a backlog: it's being accountable for whether DTCommand genuinely works for our direct and indirect customers and for the business, within the product direction set by the Head of Product.

You'll spend meaningful time with customers, test ideas before committing development time to them, and be trusted to shape not just what gets built, but why. Success in this role looks like DTCommand delivered well and adopted by customers, not simply features shipped on schedule.

This is a new role that is still taking shape, and so is how we work day-to-day: there's no fixed playbook to follow, so we're looking for someone who brings their own structure and good habits, rather than someone who needs a process handed to them.

Whilst initially this role is scoped to DTCommand, there is also the opportunity for the scope to broaden in the future. This role represents a genuine growth opportunity for someone who wants more than a single product to own long term.


Whilst this is a remote role, flexibility to attend our Telford office and meet with customers, partners and suppliers as required is important. We're looking for someone who is proactive in building relationships and maintaining a visible presence across the business, recognising when face-to-face engagement adds value.

Key Responsibilities

Ownership
  • Own the delivery of DTCommand, taking the agreed roadmap through to launch and into live service alongside development teams and design
  • Manage the backlog and plan releases, making sure work is clearly defined, scoped, and ready for development teams to deliver
  • Track DTCommand's KPIs post-launch and report of the KPIs, flagging where performance points to a change in direction
  • Bring customer insight and a delivery perspective into the product direction.

Customer understanding
  • Build a genuine, ongoing habit of speaking to customers, both direct and indirect, rather than treating it as an occasional check-in
  • Use what you learn to sense-check ideas early, through conversations, prototypes, or small experiments, before asking development teams to build something at full scale
  • Take the time to properly understand a problem before jumping to a solution, so the team isn't just building the first idea that comes up

Working with the team
  • Involve product design & development teams and design early, so their input shapes the solution rather than just its delivery
  • Write clear, well-thought-through requirements once direction is set, and stay closely involved through delivery
  • Be a credible, technically-minded partner to development teams on integration and platform decisions

Prioritisation and roadmap
  • Work with the product team on prioritisation across the needs of the business, bringing recommendations that balance customer value, commercial impact, and delivery capacity
  • Maintain the product roadmap and communicate agreed priorities, and the reasoning behind them, so stakeholders across the business understand what is coming, when, and why
  • Spot opportunities to grow DTCommand into new channels, segments, or related use cases, serving both direct and indirect customers, and build the case for considertion

Staying informed
  • Keep a current view of the market and competitor landscape, and let it genuinely inform decisions
  • Keep documentation clear and up to date so the wider business understands what we're working on and why

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Essential:
  • 3+ years in Product Management, with a track record of taking products from requirements through to successful launch
  • Experience regularly speaking with customers and using that insight to shape decisions and priorities
  • Comfortable working closely with Engineering / Development teams and design from early on, not just briefing them once decisions are made
  • Confident operating in ambiguity, able to bring structure to a fast-moving environment rather than needing it laid out for you
  • Strong stakeholder management: confident with senior leadership and technical teams, and able to push back constructively when needed
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including writing clear requirements

Desirable:
  • Experience in security, physical security, or a related hardware/software hybrid industry is a bonus but not essential
  • A track record of finding product-market fit or driving adoption in new commercial segments or geographies
  • Experience working across multiple countries or markets, and navigating the differences in customer needs and ways of working that come with that
  • Experience in a scale-up or startup environment, including zero-to-one product work

raw.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

  • Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
  • EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.
  • Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

About TNT Growth

TNT Growth is a performance-driven growth marketing agency that embeds directly into our clients' businesses to produce measurable outcomes across paid media, creative strategy, and analytics. We drive impact!

About the Role

We are looking for a senior Conversion Tracking & API Engineer who can independently own complex, production-grade tracking across browser, server, CRM, and ad-platform APIs. You combine deep backend and data-integration expertise with a practical understanding of paid-media measurement and strong client-facing communication.

This is not a tag-only or passive back-end role. You will work directly with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineering teams, and external platforms. You will own the path from consented browser and session capture through forms and CRM lifecycle events, event processing, ad-platform delivery, diagnostics, reconciliation, and monitoring. If you can build reliable systems, prove that they work end to end, and explain them clearly to non-engineers, this role was designed for you.

What You'll Do

  • Strong Communication
    • Proactively flagging implementation gaps, risks, and unverified assumptions before a campaign goes live — and separating confirmed root cause from a working hypothesis
    • Writing implementation and QA summaries that a Growth Manager without an engineering background can read, understand, and act on
    • Responding to questions in Slack within a reasonable window during working hours
    • Asking a clarifying question rather than building the wrong thing for two days
  • Conversion Tracking Architecture & Identity
    Design, build, and maintain client-side and server-side conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google Ads API and Data Manager API, Enhanced Conversions and offline uploads, TikTok Events API, and other major platforms. Own signal design, event taxonomy, account and action routing, timestamps, value and currency, attribution windows, and accuracy from landing page to ad platform.
  • CRM Integration & Event Pipeline Management
    Build and maintain integrations among client sites and forms, CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho, call-tracking and scheduling tools, TNT infrastructure, and ad-platform APIs. Use webhooks, change data capture, OAuth, and queues to deliver events with validation, idempotency, retries and backoff, dead-letter handling, replay and backfill, and a complete audit trail.
  • Browser, Identity & Cross-Domain Instrumentation
    Implement and debug GTM, server-side GTM, Google tag and GA4, platform pixels, deterministic dataLayer events, first-party session IDs and cookies, URL propagation, and form injection across redirects, subdomains, SPAs, embedded forms, and booking tools. Preserve and validate GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, UTMs, and consent state through the funnel.
  • Ad-Platform API & Payload Engineering
    Build platform-correct payloads and matching logic: normalize and hash permitted identifiers exactly once, send consent signals, pair browser and server events with stable event or order IDs, prevent double counting, handle adjustments and redactions, diagnose partial acceptance and attribution-window failures, and improve match quality using platform diagnostics.
  • End-to-End QA, Reconciliation & Production Operations
    Create synthetic tests that follow the real user journey from landing page through CRM and queue to the ad-platform UI. Reconcile source, database, CRM, internal reporting, and platform counts; monitor match quality, attribution lag, and delivery failures; produce evidence, alerts, runbooks, and incident updates; and verify fixes after launch.
  • TypeScript Development
    Write clean, well-tested TypeScript across the stack, including API clients, webhook handlers, and event workers. Own engineering quality through automated tests, code review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Data Layer & Database Work
    Design and operate PostgreSQL schemas for attribution sessions, identities, conversion events, attempts, and delivery status. Write diagnostic SQL, optimize queries and indexes, plan retention, and trace data from ingestion through reporting without exposing sensitive data.
  • AI-Assisted Development & Tooling
    Use AI systems (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and others) as force multipliers for debugging, code generation, documentation, and pattern recognition. Validate generated work and never trade tracking correctness, security, or maintainability for speed.
  • Cross-Functional Communication & Ownership
    Communicate clearly and proactively with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineers, and platform support. Translate root cause, risk, evidence, dependencies, and ETA into updates non-engineers can act on. Own incidents through verification and follow-up, not just code deployment. Create reusable standards, runbooks, and guidance that raise the capability of the broader team.
  • Version Control & Collaboration
    Own your work in Git. Strong branching strategy, meaningful commit history, clean PRs, and collaborative review habits. You treat version control as a professional practice, not a formality.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Senior-level, hands-on production experience with complex conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI and Google Ads API or Data Manager API, including Enhanced Conversions and offline conversions; additional TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, or Reddit CAPI experience is strongly preferred
  • Hands-on browser and server-side instrumentation with GTM, server-side GTM or equivalent, Google tag and GA4, deterministic dataLayer events, SPAs, redirects, cross-domain and subdomain flows, embedded forms, and booking tools
  • Expertise in attribution identity and matchback: GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, first-party session IDs, cookies or URL propagation, consent state, and CRM persistence
  • Deep knowledge of ad-platform payload semantics, including event names, action source, account and action IDs, value and currency, timestamps and time zones, stable event or order IDs, browser and server deduplication, attribution windows, conversion adjustments or redactions, and partial-acceptance diagnostics
  • Experience mapping CRM objects and lifecycle stages and integrating systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Attio, GoHighLevel, Typeform, or call-tracking platforms through webhooks, change data capture, and APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to prove delivery end to end with synthetic tests, platform diagnostics, source, CRM, database, internal-reporting, and ad-platform reconciliation, match-quality monitoring, alerting, incident response, and written QA evidence
  • Experience implementing consent-aware tracking and privacy controls under GDPR, CCPA, and ad-platform policies, including permitted PII collection, normalization and hashing exactly once, data minimization, and sensitive-category restrictions
  • Strong understanding of API client design, REST and webhook integrations, OAuth and secrets handling, change data capture, rate limits, partial failures, and inter-service communication patterns
  • Direct production experience with message queues (RabbitMQ, BullMQ, SQS, or similar), including idempotency, deduplication, retries and backoff, dead-letter handling, replay, and high-volume backfills
  • Proficient in TypeScript — clean, typed, testable, and maintainable across API clients, services, and asynchronous workers
  • Strong PostgreSQL and ORM fundamentals (Prisma, TypeORM, or equivalent), including diagnostic SQL, schema design, query and index optimization, and data retention
  • Strong working knowledge of paid-media measurement: funnel and lifecycle event design, primary and secondary conversions, values, attribution windows, match quality, platform learning-volume tradeoffs, and channel differences across Meta, Google, TikTok, and related platforms
  • Strong Git skills — branching, PR workflows, code review participation, and version control discipline
  • Practical fluency with AI development tools and the judgment to validate their output; AI expertise is secondary to conversion tracking, API, and backend engineering depth
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including client-facing technical discovery, implementation documentation, incident updates, and evidence-based explanations

Compensation

This is a non-US, long-term contract role.

  • Non-US Salary Range: $40k-$80k (Based on Location and Skillset)

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Sword Health is a multi-product commercial organization selling across employer health and health plan markets. The Field Enablement Lead builds the content, training, and deal support that keep sellers effective across a growing portfolio, including hands-on deal preparation: dry runs, objection handling sessions, and rep coaching on high-value opportunities. The right person has carried a bag, knows what a rep needs in the room, and builds enablement that reflects how deals actually happen.

  • Map the sales journey across commercial teams: interview reps, ride along on deals, document where sellers get stuck and what's missing
  • Own content governance: audit, organize, retire stale materials, build a system where reps find the right content without digging

  • Experience designing and delivering live training to commercial teams
  • Fluency in US employer health benefits sales: buyer personas, procurement cycles, competitive landscape, and how large employers and health plans evaluate vendors

Nice to have:

  • Comfort with sales intelligence tools (Gong or equivalent) and content management platforms
  • Multi-product portfolio enablement, interest in just in time enablement

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

raw.description:
We're looking for a Product Manager to take real ownership of our new innovative customer app, DTCommand, working closely alongside development teams and design rather than sitting apart from them. This is more than managing a backlog: it's being accountable for whether DTCommand genuinely works for our direct and indirect customers and for the business, within the product direction set by the Head of Product.

You'll spend meaningful time with customers, test ideas before committing development time to them, and be trusted to shape not just what gets built, but why. Success in this role looks like DTCommand delivered well and adopted by customers, not simply features shipped on schedule.

This is a new role that is still taking shape, and so is how we work day-to-day: there's no fixed playbook to follow, so we're looking for someone who brings their own structure and good habits, rather than someone who needs a process handed to them.

Whilst initially this role is scoped to DTCommand, there is also the opportunity for the scope to broaden in the future. This role represents a genuine growth opportunity for someone who wants more than a single product to own long term.


Whilst this is a remote role, flexibility to attend our Telford office and meet with customers, partners and suppliers as required is important. We're looking for someone who is proactive in building relationships and maintaining a visible presence across the business, recognising when face-to-face engagement adds value.

Key Responsibilities

Ownership
  • Own the delivery of DTCommand, taking the agreed roadmap through to launch and into live service alongside development teams and design
  • Manage the backlog and plan releases, making sure work is clearly defined, scoped, and ready for development teams to deliver
  • Track DTCommand's KPIs post-launch and report of the KPIs, flagging where performance points to a change in direction
  • Bring customer insight and a delivery perspective into the product direction.

Customer understanding
  • Build a genuine, ongoing habit of speaking to customers, both direct and indirect, rather than treating it as an occasional check-in
  • Use what you learn to sense-check ideas early, through conversations, prototypes, or small experiments, before asking development teams to build something at full scale
  • Take the time to properly understand a problem before jumping to a solution, so the team isn't just building the first idea that comes up

Working with the team
  • Involve product design & development teams and design early, so their input shapes the solution rather than just its delivery
  • Write clear, well-thought-through requirements once direction is set, and stay closely involved through delivery
  • Be a credible, technically-minded partner to development teams on integration and platform decisions

Prioritisation and roadmap
  • Work with the product team on prioritisation across the needs of the business, bringing recommendations that balance customer value, commercial impact, and delivery capacity
  • Maintain the product roadmap and communicate agreed priorities, and the reasoning behind them, so stakeholders across the business understand what is coming, when, and why
  • Spot opportunities to grow DTCommand into new channels, segments, or related use cases, serving both direct and indirect customers, and build the case for considertion

Staying informed
  • Keep a current view of the market and competitor landscape, and let it genuinely inform decisions
  • Keep documentation clear and up to date so the wider business understands what we're working on and why

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Essential:
  • 3+ years in Product Management, with a track record of taking products from requirements through to successful launch
  • Experience regularly speaking with customers and using that insight to shape decisions and priorities
  • Comfortable working closely with Engineering / Development teams and design from early on, not just briefing them once decisions are made
  • Confident operating in ambiguity, able to bring structure to a fast-moving environment rather than needing it laid out for you
  • Strong stakeholder management: confident with senior leadership and technical teams, and able to push back constructively when needed
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including writing clear requirements

Desirable:
  • Experience in security, physical security, or a related hardware/software hybrid industry is a bonus but not essential
  • A track record of finding product-market fit or driving adoption in new commercial segments or geographies
  • Experience working across multiple countries or markets, and navigating the differences in customer needs and ways of working that come with that
  • Experience in a scale-up or startup environment, including zero-to-one product work

raw.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

  • Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
  • EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.
  • Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

raw.description:
Remote — International Hire ONLY | Contract Full-Time

About TNT Growth

TNT Growth is a performance-driven growth marketing agency that embeds directly into our clients' businesses to produce measurable outcomes across paid media, creative strategy, and analytics. We drive impact!

About the Role

We are looking for a senior Conversion Tracking & API Engineer who can independently own complex, production-grade tracking across browser, server, CRM, and ad-platform APIs. You combine deep backend and data-integration expertise with a practical understanding of paid-media measurement and strong client-facing communication.

This is not a tag-only or passive back-end role. You will work directly with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineering teams, and external platforms. You will own the path from consented browser and session capture through forms and CRM lifecycle events, event processing, ad-platform delivery, diagnostics, reconciliation, and monitoring. If you can build reliable systems, prove that they work end to end, and explain them clearly to non-engineers, this role was designed for you.

What You'll Do

  • Strong Communication
    • Proactively flagging implementation gaps, risks, and unverified assumptions before a campaign goes live — and separating confirmed root cause from a working hypothesis
    • Writing implementation and QA summaries that a Growth Manager without an engineering background can read, understand, and act on
    • Responding to questions in Slack within a reasonable window during working hours
    • Asking a clarifying question rather than building the wrong thing for two days
  • Conversion Tracking Architecture & Identity
    Design, build, and maintain client-side and server-side conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google Ads API and Data Manager API, Enhanced Conversions and offline uploads, TikTok Events API, and other major platforms. Own signal design, event taxonomy, account and action routing, timestamps, value and currency, attribution windows, and accuracy from landing page to ad platform.
  • CRM Integration & Event Pipeline Management
    Build and maintain integrations among client sites and forms, CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho, call-tracking and scheduling tools, TNT infrastructure, and ad-platform APIs. Use webhooks, change data capture, OAuth, and queues to deliver events with validation, idempotency, retries and backoff, dead-letter handling, replay and backfill, and a complete audit trail.
  • Browser, Identity & Cross-Domain Instrumentation
    Implement and debug GTM, server-side GTM, Google tag and GA4, platform pixels, deterministic dataLayer events, first-party session IDs and cookies, URL propagation, and form injection across redirects, subdomains, SPAs, embedded forms, and booking tools. Preserve and validate GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, UTMs, and consent state through the funnel.
  • Ad-Platform API & Payload Engineering
    Build platform-correct payloads and matching logic: normalize and hash permitted identifiers exactly once, send consent signals, pair browser and server events with stable event or order IDs, prevent double counting, handle adjustments and redactions, diagnose partial acceptance and attribution-window failures, and improve match quality using platform diagnostics.
  • End-to-End QA, Reconciliation & Production Operations
    Create synthetic tests that follow the real user journey from landing page through CRM and queue to the ad-platform UI. Reconcile source, database, CRM, internal reporting, and platform counts; monitor match quality, attribution lag, and delivery failures; produce evidence, alerts, runbooks, and incident updates; and verify fixes after launch.
  • TypeScript Development
    Write clean, well-tested TypeScript across the stack, including API clients, webhook handlers, and event workers. Own engineering quality through automated tests, code review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Data Layer & Database Work
    Design and operate PostgreSQL schemas for attribution sessions, identities, conversion events, attempts, and delivery status. Write diagnostic SQL, optimize queries and indexes, plan retention, and trace data from ingestion through reporting without exposing sensitive data.
  • AI-Assisted Development & Tooling
    Use AI systems (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and others) as force multipliers for debugging, code generation, documentation, and pattern recognition. Validate generated work and never trade tracking correctness, security, or maintainability for speed.
  • Cross-Functional Communication & Ownership
    Communicate clearly and proactively with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineers, and platform support. Translate root cause, risk, evidence, dependencies, and ETA into updates non-engineers can act on. Own incidents through verification and follow-up, not just code deployment. Create reusable standards, runbooks, and guidance that raise the capability of the broader team.
  • Version Control & Collaboration
    Own your work in Git. Strong branching strategy, meaningful commit history, clean PRs, and collaborative review habits. You treat version control as a professional practice, not a formality.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Senior-level, hands-on production experience with complex conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI and Google Ads API or Data Manager API, including Enhanced Conversions and offline conversions; additional TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, or Reddit CAPI experience is strongly preferred
  • Hands-on browser and server-side instrumentation with GTM, server-side GTM or equivalent, Google tag and GA4, deterministic dataLayer events, SPAs, redirects, cross-domain and subdomain flows, embedded forms, and booking tools
  • Expertise in attribution identity and matchback: GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, first-party session IDs, cookies or URL propagation, consent state, and CRM persistence
  • Deep knowledge of ad-platform payload semantics, including event names, action source, account and action IDs, value and currency, timestamps and time zones, stable event or order IDs, browser and server deduplication, attribution windows, conversion adjustments or redactions, and partial-acceptance diagnostics
  • Experience mapping CRM objects and lifecycle stages and integrating systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Attio, GoHighLevel, Typeform, or call-tracking platforms through webhooks, change data capture, and APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to prove delivery end to end with synthetic tests, platform diagnostics, source, CRM, database, internal-reporting, and ad-platform reconciliation, match-quality monitoring, alerting, incident response, and written QA evidence
  • Experience implementing consent-aware tracking and privacy controls under GDPR, CCPA, and ad-platform policies, including permitted PII collection, normalization and hashing exactly once, data minimization, and sensitive-category restrictions
  • Strong understanding of API client design, REST and webhook integrations, OAuth and secrets handling, change data capture, rate limits, partial failures, and inter-service communication patterns
  • Direct production experience with message queues (RabbitMQ, BullMQ, SQS, or similar), including idempotency, deduplication, retries and backoff, dead-letter handling, replay, and high-volume backfills
  • Proficient in TypeScript — clean, typed, testable, and maintainable across API clients, services, and asynchronous workers
  • Strong PostgreSQL and ORM fundamentals (Prisma, TypeORM, or equivalent), including diagnostic SQL, schema design, query and index optimization, and data retention
  • Strong working knowledge of paid-media measurement: funnel and lifecycle event design, primary and secondary conversions, values, attribution windows, match quality, platform learning-volume tradeoffs, and channel differences across Meta, Google, TikTok, and related platforms
  • Strong Git skills — branching, PR workflows, code review participation, and version control discipline
  • Practical fluency with AI development tools and the judgment to validate their output; AI expertise is secondary to conversion tracking, API, and backend engineering depth
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including client-facing technical discovery, implementation documentation, incident updates, and evidence-based explanations

Compensation

This is a non-US, long-term contract role.

  • Non-US Salary Range: $40k-$80k (Based on Location and Skillset)
  • 12 Paid Holidays and 18 Paid Days Off

In this role, you will be responsible for generating new business opportunities and supporting revenue growth for OXB’s CDMO services, playing a key part in advancing our mission and making a real difference.

One of the original pioneers in cell and gene therapy, OXB has 30 years of experience in viral vectors; the driving force behind the majority of cell and gene therapies. OXB offers a vast number of technologies for viral vector manufacturing, including a 4th generation lentiviral vector system (the TetraVecta™ system), a dual-plasmid system for AAV production, suspension and perfusion process using process enhancers and stable producer and packaging cell lines.

OXB, a FTSE250 and FTSE4Good constituent, is headquartered in Oxford, UK. It has development and manufacturing facilities across Oxfordshire, UK, Lyon and Strasbourg, France, Bedford MA, and Durham NC, US.
