At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Sword Health is a multi-product commercial organization selling across employer health and health plan markets. The Field Enablement Lead builds the content, training, and deal support that keep sellers effective across a growing portfolio, including hands-on deal preparation: dry runs, objection handling sessions, and rep coaching on high-value opportunities. The right person has carried a bag, knows what a rep needs in the room, and builds enablement that reflects how deals actually happen.

What you’ll be doing

  • Partner with reps on high-value deal preparation: run practice sessions, lead objection handling workshops, coach multi-threading and outreach strategy, help build account-specific narratives and presentation prep
  • Build field-grade sales content across a multi-product portfolio: talk tracks, objection handling playbooks, discovery frameworks, conversation starters, competitive battlecards, curated call recordings
  • Own the commercial training cadence: bi-weekly enablement sessions and recurring calls covering product positioning, win/loss insights, and competitive intelligence. You set the agenda and run the room
  • Design and deliver quarterly skill-based training aligned to the selling cycle (negotiation, discovery, executive presence) in partnership with product and clinical leaders
  • Map the sales journey across commercial teams: interview reps, ride along on deals, document where sellers get stuck and what's missing
  • Own content governance: audit, organize, retire stale materials, build a system where reps find the right content without digging

What you need to have

  • 7+ years in B2B sales, sales enablement, or revenue-facing roles with direct experience carrying a quota or supporting quota-carrying teams in US health benefits, employer wellness, or digital health
  • Track record building field-grade sales content (not marketing collateral) that reps voluntarily reach for
  • Experience designing and delivering live training to commercial teams
  • Fluency in US employer health benefits sales: buyer personas, procurement cycles, competitive landscape, and how large employers and health plans evaluate vendors

Nice to have:

  • Comfort with sales intelligence tools (Gong or equivalent) and content management platforms
  • Multi-product portfolio enablement, interest in just in time enablement

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

$140,000—$220,000 USD

raw.description:
We are growing and seeking a Senior Research Scientist (Statistician) to join our Evidence Synthesis and Decision Modelling team. You will collaborate with a highly specialized team of statisticians, health economists, and researchers on global projects supporting evidence generation, comparative effectiveness research, health technology assessment (HTA), and decision-making for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.

About You

Experienced Quantitative Researcher: You have a background in statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, health economics, data science, or a related quantitative discipline, along with experience applying statistical methods in healthcare, life sciences, or outcomes research.

Evidence Synthesis and Statistical Methods Experience: You have experience planning, conducting, and reporting analyses that support evidence synthesis and comparative effectiveness research. You can critically assess clinical evidence, evaluate methodological assumptions, identify evidence gaps, and apply appropriate analytical methods to address complex research questions. Experience with indirect treatment comparison methodologies and analyses involving aggregate and/or individual patient-level data is desirable.

Technical Proficiency: You demonstrate strong statistical programming skills, particularly in R, and experience developing reproducible analytical workflows. You are comfortable working with complex datasets and applying a range of statistical methodologies appropriate to the research question.

Deliverable Creation: You contribute to client-ready deliverables including analysis plans, technical reports, presentations, manuscripts, and conference materials, and can communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver statistical analyses supporting evidence generation, comparative effectiveness research, and healthcare decision-making projects.
  • Design and implement fit-for-purpose analytical approaches that address client objectives and research questions.
  • Conduct statistical analyses and develop reproducible analytical workflows using R.
  • Lead analytical workstreams and contribute to project planning, delivery, and quality assurance activities.
  • Interpret and communicate complex analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support HTA, reimbursement, market access, and Joint Clinical Assessment evidence-generation activities.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to methodological best practices.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, proposals, and thought leadership activities.

Required Experience and Competencies

  • Master's degree or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Health Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Approximately 4 years or more of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong R programming skills and experience conducting statistical analyses.
  • Experience applying statistical methods to healthcare, outcomes research, evidence generation, or related research areas.
  • Experience with evidence synthesis and comparative effectiveness research.
  • Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and effectively.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Helpful Experience and Competencies

  • Knowledge of indirect treatment comparison methodologies such as network meta-analysis (NMA), matching-adjusted indirect comparison (MAIC), simulated treatment comparison (STC), or similar approaches.
  • Experience with external control arm (ECA) analyses
  • Experience with survival analysis, time-to-event modelling, or utility and health-related quality of life analyses.
  • Experience working with individual patient leveldata.
  • Understanding of Bayesian and/or frequentist statistical methods.
  • Experience supporting HTA, reimbursement, market access, or evidence-generation activities.
  • Familiarity with Python, or other programming languages.
  • Experience contributing to scientific publications or conference presentations.

raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced, detail-oriented Virtual Medical Assistants to support a growing U.S.-based pulmonary specialty practice operating across three clinic locations.

This role combines front-desk patient communication with back-office medical records management. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing high volumes of incoming calls, coordinating patient requests, processing medical records, and working closely with an established clinical team.

You will help streamline daily clinic operations while ensuring patients receive prompt, professional, and compassionate assistance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Communication & Call Management

  • Answer high-volume inbound patient calls, address general inquiries, confirm appointments, and direct requests to appropriate clinic personnel.

  • Triage incoming calls, emails, and AthenaHealth EMR messages, ensuring accurate documentation and timely routing to designated staff.

  • Coordinate with the bilingual Virtual Medical Assistant to assist Spanish-speaking patients through live call transfers or scheduled callbacks.

2. Medical Records & Administrative Support

  • Process medical records requests from insurance companies, referring providers, and patients accurately and within required timelines.

  • Coordinate with the in-house billing team to organize, track, and complete medical records requests while maintaining HIPAA compliance.

  • Assist with other clinical administrative workflows, including referrals, insurance verification, and prior authorizations, as assigned during future workflow expansion.

3. Team Collaboration & Workflow Management

  • Collaborate with clinic supervisors, billing personnel, and fellow Virtual Medical Assistants to ensure smooth communication across multiple locations.

  • Provide backup inbound call coverage during peak hours while balancing assigned medical records and administrative responsibilities.

  • Maintain accurate EMR documentation and contribute to developing standard operating procedures (SOPs) for consistent and efficient workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant supporting U.S.-based healthcare practices in similar clinical administrative functions.

  • Hands-on experience in patient communication, inbound call handling, medical records processing, or related medical administrative workflows.

  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills, with a professional, empathetic, and patient-centered approach.

  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare workflows, medical terminology, patient confidentiality, and HIPAA requirements.

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize time-sensitive requests, and work independently in a high-volume remote healthcare environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using AthenaHealth EMR for patient messaging, clinical documentation, or administrative workflows.

  • Previous experience supporting pulmonology practices or other U.S. specialty outpatient clinics.

  • Experience coordinating with billing departments, clinic supervisors, and remote healthcare teams.

Technical & Work-From-Home Requirements

  • Computer or laptop with at least an Intel Core i5 processor or equivalent/higher.

  • Reliable high-speed primary internet connection with a dedicated backup internet source.

  • Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or reliable backup power solution.

  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for handling confidential patient information and inbound calls.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is dependable, proactive, highly organized, and confident communicating with patients over the phone. You should be comfortable transitioning between live patient calls and back-office administrative responsibilities while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and a strong commitment to patient service.

You'll work closely with engineering, product, QA, and client stakeholders to manage priorities, understand development workflows, investigate technical blockers, challenge delivery assumptions, and ensure predictable outcomes. Description

CapsLock is a company that specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses that are facing sales growth challenges. Our comprehensive services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, all seamlessly integrated to ensure efficient and accelerated growth.

Our company was founded by industry professionals with expertise in IT, design, and data analytics. We identified a significant need for an exclusive, scalable customer acquisition solution in the market. Our vision is to provide a unique integrated solution for B2C clients that enables profitable customer acquisition, flexible scaling, and optimized internal processes.

At CapsLock, our core values center around our people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and fostering strong relationships. Our diverse and skilled team speaks 10+ languages and is located worldwide. We are dedicated to pioneering new and efficient marketing strategies to ensure our clients’ success.

﻿Role Description

As a Finance Director at CapsLock, you will be responsible for overseeing all financial aspects of the fast-growing marketing business, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting, and providing strategic guidance to support our business goals. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills and extensive financial expertise.

This role will report to the Chief Finance Officer of the Company.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Team leadership: Lead and mentor bookkeeping, FP&A, and taxation/compliance teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
  • Accounting: Oversee accounting. Lead implementation and improvement of financial and accounting policies/practices.
  • Budgeting: Oversees budgeting process. Supervise plan/fact analysis and provide explanations and recommendations.
  • Reporting: Ensure timely and accurate financial, and investment reporting for the Group of Companies
  • Internal Controls and Audits. Assist with developing and maintaining robust internal controls. Lead internal audits to ensure compliance with established financial procedures.
  • Tax and Compliance: Oversee tax filings, regulatory reports, and compliance with statutory obligations. Tax planning and optimization for the group
  • M&A transactions: Navigate the complexities of mergers and acquisitions including initial financial assessments, Due Diligence, and post-merger integration.
  • Process Improvement: Continuously improve financial processes, systems, and financial reporting to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and strategic relevance
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide insights and recommendations on financial performance and key financial metrics to the executive team
  • Third-party Communication: Manage relationships with banks, tax advisories, and external consultants

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA, CPA, ACCA preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in finance, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Experience with financial reporting, month-end / year-end processes, and IFRS/GAAP compliance.
  • Proven track record in financial planning, analysis, and management within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with executive management and external stakeholders.
  • Proactive nature, growth mindset, self-regulation.
  • Fluent English.
  • Ability and desire to work collaboratively with a diverse, remote global team.

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer above-market compensation, but we also offer perks and benefits that promote people’s well–being. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.

Ongoing Learning

People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.

Home Office

We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.

Physical Well–Being

Fitness is more than a gym membership. We all have different tastes and preferences. That’s why we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program that fits all.

Unlimited Sick Days

We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

Fun Stuff

There is never a shortage of fun stuff when you work with amazing people. But we like to spice things up and take them to the next level, you will soon learn how.

raw.description:
This is a Full Time (not contract/C2C), 100% remote position for mainland US "onshore" only.

Agency experience preferred.

You must submit a cover letter written by you (not AI).Submissions without a cover letter will be ignored.

Please explain how your experience and future goals align with this position. Ask at least one question about the role in your cover letter.

This position is for a Senior “LAMP” developer with Laravel expertise and experience in containerization. Please read this carefully. This is not an entry level position and there are specific requirements, just like any software development project.

You must be a PHP developer first, and a Laravel developer second. Front end experience is also a must.

Agency experience is preferred as you will be tasked with generating timelines and estimates for projects, then delivering them. At times, smaller projects may have little Project Management and delivery is handled by the developer. This is a typical example of Agency work. Larger projects have more Project Management. However, our developers are often communicating directly with the clients and internal teams regarding scope, costs, and timelines. In effect, you are soup-to-nuts freelancer, but as a full time position.

  • We are a small company with heavy hitting clients
  • Training is limited - you must be able to hit the ground running
  • We are often hired to solve problems that cannot be solved by our client’s internal teams
  • Interruptions and client management is part of Agency life
  • Accountability and improvement is key to our survival
  • Independence is key
  • Security is an absolute

Responsibilities & Qualifications

This is a full time, client facing role requiring excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. A background check and references are required.

Your primary role will be to collaborate with cross-functional teams building highly secure, complex back-end and front-end products with many moving parts. This role includes projects for a Fortune 500 investment company, as well as our Laravel based CMS for law firms called LawFirm CMS, and many others.

Clean sheet development and maintenance of legacy PHP based applications is in your wheelhouse.

You will also be involved with the co-creation of project plans and pre-sales activities (information architecture, estimates, scope, schedule, risks, etc.).

Your keen insight into data consumption, manipulation, and presentation will be tested. A passion for problem solving and self governance is a necessity.

With the rapid change in techniques and tools available, you will be tasked with creating maintainable, best-practice based system architectures. We maintain everything we produce and pride ourselves on long term, sustainable partnerships with our clients and related vendors. It is important to understand that maintenance is a large part of our business, which means building software but also maintaining it over time.

Also, because of our clients we tend towards conservative development approaches instead of bleeding edge. This means managing aging projects, as well as upgrading them to the latest best practices.

As with all of our projects, we pride ourselves on our customer service on all levels. Constant, clear communication in both good and challenging times keeps our customers active for many years.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field: Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline
  • 5+ years “Full Stack” development
  • Client facing product management and development
  • Independent team player in a typically fast paced, sometimes complex environment
  • Ability to shift priorities and handle multiple, concurrent projects while still managing to smile and laugh
  • Passion for problem solving
  • Integrate with and troubleshoot complex client DevOps
  • Independence is a must - many projects are often handled by a single developer, not a team
  • The first line of Quality Assurance is you
  • Collaboration, honesty, and integrity are absolutes

Professionals Skills & Knowledge

As a developer, your current career has led you to already incorporate many of the following technologies and techniques into your project workflows. It is understood that you may have more experience in some areas than others, or even lack a specific experience below. We are looking for constant learners with proven foundations in application development who are always looking to enhance their skills.

We often deal with aging code. Working with older code, upgrading the application, or even recreating the application in the latest and greatest is part of our service offerings.

Front End

Required: Semantic HTML/CSS, JavaScript (DOM, JSON, JQuery, AJAX, etc.), Bootstrap, Quality Assurance on your own code.

Experience with: React, Gulp, and/or other frameworks

Back End/Implementation

Required: PHP 7/8, SQL schema (MySQL/MSSQL/NoSQL/Other), REST/SOAP

Experience with / Nice to have: Laravel, Python, Node.js, SOLR, PDF Publishing, and other frameworks

CMS/Frameworks

Required: Laravel or other PHP frameworks

Experience with / Nice to have: Symfony, Drupal 8/9/10, WordPress, Other

Systems/Stacks

Required: Docker, bash, Apache/Nginx/MySQL/Linux maintenance. We often build and maintain systems for our clients who often lack the internal necessary teams.

Experience with / Nice to have: K8S, LAMP Stack (and variations), Bash and command line, Performance/PEN Testing, Hosting configurations, AWS/Azure/Cloud experience, Caching, DNS

Workflow/Other

CICD/DevOps (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), Git (GitHub, BitBucket)/SVN, SSO/SAML, SEO Best Practices, Compliance (ADA/SOC/GDPR/PCI DSS)

Tools

Visual Studio Code (our standard IDE), Office Suite, Google Suite, Slack/Teams, Basecamp, Jira, Other

Nice to Have

Acquia/Other Drupal hosts & workflows, SAST/DAST tools, React Native/Xamarin/Flutter/PWA, Adobe Suite

Compensation & Benefits

Salary

$100,000 - $130,000. Individual compensation varies based on job related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications.

Benefits

  • Health and 401(k) plans with employer match
  • Paid time off for vacation, sick and personal days
  • Remote work from anywhere in the continental U.S.A. (in a private (not shared), secure location, i.e. home office)
    • Note: because we can work with highly regulated financial companies, you must have a private and secure location to work.

Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

Salary: $100,000 - $130,000

raw.description:
About Us

Snif is setting the new standard in fine fragrance. The search for high-quality scented products should be simple, accessible, and fun. We bring our customers what they want to smell and develop new, unexpected ways for them to incorporate fine fragrance into their daily routines.
Every scent we develop is designed to be an immersive experience. From the name, packaging design, and creative campaigns to someone’s first spray, we want them to see and smell the quality behind every release. Our formulas are always made with top-shelf ingredients and are genderless, non-toxic, vegan, and cruelty-free.
Snif and its sub-brands are sold on our DTC site . Select products can also be found at Ulta Beauty and on Amazon. We’ve been featured across notable press outlets including Forbes, Fast Co., WWD, Vogue, Allure, Cosmopolitan, NY Mag, Harper’s Bazaar, and more. Additionally, we’re backed by some of the most revered investors in the consumer goods space.
We’re a lean team that’s expanding quickly, and we’re looking for someone who believes in our vision to shift the way people experience scents.

The Role:

As Retail Operations Manager, you will own how our retail orders move from receipt through fulfillment, delivery, and invoicing as we expand our distribution. Success means orders are processed accurately, shipment and invoice requirements are met, and exceptions are resolved early enough to protect retailer commitments.

You will be Snif’s primary owner for retail order execution, responsible for keeping each order moving, resolving operational exceptions within agreed guidelines and escalating inventory allocation, commercial, or spending decisions that require approval. You will work closely with Sales, Procurement and Inventory, Finance, and our manufacturing and fulfillment partners to make sure requirements are clear and commitments are met.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. When inventory is short, an EDI document is rejected, or a shipment is at risk, you will identify the issue early, bring the right partners together, and drive it to resolution.

As Snif expands its retail distribution, you will help shape the processes, reporting, and tools the business relies on, working directly with the VP of Operations to improve how we serve our retail partners.

This role will report directly to the VP of Operations.

While we are based in New York City, we operate as a remote team. This job may require travel ~10-20% of the time depending on business needs.

What You'll Do:

    Order Management and Inventory Coordination
  • Own daily order management across our retail channels, including Ulta, Ulta International, Amazon, and future distribution expansion
  • Validate incoming purchase orders against approved item data, pricing, quantities, inventory availability, and delivery requirements; resolve discrepancies before confirming orders
  • Partner with Procurement and Inventory to identify shortages, execute agreed fulfillment priorities, and communicate risks with recommended actions
    • Fulfillment and Retailer Requirements
  • Coordinate with fulfillment providers to meet retailer requirements for order confirmation, routing, labeling, shipping documentation, pickup, and delivery
  • Monitor EDI transactions and retailer portals, resolve missing or rejected documents, and verify that required order, shipment, and invoice information has been successfully received
    • Invoicing and Chargebacks
  • Prepare and submit accurate invoices, reconcile ordered, shipped, and invoiced quantities, and partner with Finance to resolve discrepancies and deductions
  • Investigate operational chargebacks, prepare dispute documentation, track deadlines, and address recurring causes
    • Retail Launch Readiness
  • Own retail order-execution readiness for new retailer and item launches, including operational data checks, test orders, documented workflows, and clear handoffs with Commercialization, Sales, Procurement and Inventory, and fulfillment partners
    • Reporting and Process Improvement
    • Maintain accurate order records and reporting by retailer and distribution center, with clear deadlines, shipment status, exceptions, and next actions
    • Improve procedures, service reporting, and backup coverage; simplify or automate repetitive work and verify that changes improve accuracy and reliability

What You'll Bring:

    • 3+ years of relevant experience in wholesale order management, retail operations, or customer operations within a consumer products business
    • Experience personally managing national retailer orders from receipt through delivery and invoicing, including resolving exceptions across internal teams and fulfillment partners
    • Experience supporting multiple distribution centers and meeting retailer routing and compliance requirements
    • Hands-on experience monitoring EDI transactions, diagnosing operational errors, and working with providers to resolve them
    • Experience working directly with third-party warehouses and transportation partners on fulfillment and delivery issues
    • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including reconciling order, inventory, shipment, and invoice data
    • Sound judgment when priorities compete, with the ability to explain risks, recommend actions, and recognize when a decision requires approval
    • Clear communication, careful attention to detail, and consistent follow-through
    • Examples of improving an operating process, with a clear explanation of your contribution and the resulting change in accuracy, service, or manual effort

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in beauty, fragrance, personal care, or home products
  • Familiarity with OpenText, ShipIQ, Partners Online, or comparable retailer systems; experience improving workflows through ERP systems or automation
  • Proficiency in LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT)
  • Experience supporting new retailer launches or managing Amazon fulfillment alongside national wholesale accounts

What You'll Get

  • Be part of a fast-growing company with an awesome mission
  • Highly competitive salary and equity so you’re a part of the Snif family
  • An opportunity for growth and ability to widen your role and responsibilities
  • Medical, Dental and Vision healthcare insurance
  • 401K Retirement Plan with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible vacation and PTO policy
  • Industry-leading well-being and mental-health benefits
  • Virtual and remote work as well as work-from-home setup
  • Snif product on us!
Snif is an equal employment opportunity employer to all employees and applicants for employment. We celebrate people from all backgrounds. If you’re driven by our mission, we’d love to hear from you! Email us at

Your primary role will be to collaborate with cross-functional teams building highly secure, complex back-end and front-end products with many moving parts. This role includes projects for a Fortune 500 investment company, as well as our Laravel based CMS for law firms called LawFirm CMS, and many others.

Clean sheet development and maintenance of legacy PHP based applications is in your wheelhouse.

You will also be involved with the co-creation of project plans and pre-sales activities (information architecture, estimates, scope, schedule, risks, etc.).

Your keen insight into data consumption, manipulation, and presentation will be tested. A passion for problem solving and self governance is a necessity.

With the rapid change in techniques and tools available, you will be tasked with creating maintainable, best-practice based system architectures. It is important to understand that maintenance is a large part of our business, which means building software but also maintaining it over time.

Also, because of our clients we tend towards conservative development approaches instead of bleeding edge. This means managing aging projects, as well as upgrading them to the latest best practices.

As with all of our projects, we pride ourselves on our customer service on all levels. Constant, clear communication in both good and challenging times keeps our customers active for many years.

Professionals Skills & Knowledge

As a developer, your current career has led you to already incorporate many of the following technologies and techniques into your project workflows. It is understood that you may have more experience in some areas than others, or even lack a specific experience below. We are looking for constant learners with proven foundations in application development who are always looking to enhance their skills.

We often deal with aging code. Working with older code, upgrading the application, or even recreating the application in the latest and greatest is part of our service offerings.

About Us

Snif is setting the new standard in fine fragrance. The search for high-quality scented products should be simple, accessible, and fun. We bring our customers what they want to smell and develop new, unexpected ways for them to incorporate fine fragrance into their daily routines.
Every scent we develop is designed to be an immersive experience. From the name, packaging design, and creative campaigns to someone’s first spray, we want them to see and smell the quality behind every release. Our formulas are always made with top-shelf ingredients and are genderless, non-toxic, vegan, and cruelty-free.
Snif and its sub-brands are sold on our DTC site . Select products can also be found at Ulta Beauty and on Amazon. We’ve been featured across notable press outlets including Forbes, Fast Co., WWD, Vogue, Allure, Cosmopolitan, NY Mag, Harper’s Bazaar, and more. Additionally, we’re backed by some of the most revered investors in the consumer goods space.
We’re a lean team that’s expanding quickly, and we’re looking for someone who believes in our vision to shift the way people experience scents.

The Role:

As Retail Operations Manager, you will own how our retail orders move from receipt through fulfillment, delivery, and invoicing as we expand our distribution. Success means orders are processed accurately, shipment and invoice requirements are met, and exceptions are resolved early enough to protect retailer commitments.

You will be Snif’s primary owner for retail order execution, responsible for keeping each order moving, resolving operational exceptions within agreed guidelines and escalating inventory allocation, commercial, or spending decisions that require approval. You will work closely with Sales, Procurement and Inventory, Finance, and our manufacturing and fulfillment partners to make sure requirements are clear and commitments are met.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. When inventory is short, an EDI document is rejected, or a shipment is at risk, you will identify the issue early, bring the right partners together, and drive it to resolution.

As Snif expands its retail distribution, you will help shape the processes, reporting, and tools the business relies on, working directly with the VP of Operations to improve how we serve our retail partners.

This role will report directly to the VP of Operations.

While we are based in New York City, we operate as a remote team. This job may require travel ~10-20% of the time depending on business needs.

What You'll Do:

    Order Management and Inventory Coordination
  • Own daily order management across our retail channels, including Ulta, Ulta International, Amazon, and future distribution expansion
  • Validate incoming purchase orders against approved item data, pricing, quantities, inventory availability, and delivery requirements; resolve discrepancies before confirming orders
  • Partner with Procurement and Inventory to identify shortages, execute agreed fulfillment priorities, and communicate risks with recommended actions
    • Fulfillment and Retailer Requirements
  • Coordinate with fulfillment providers to meet retailer requirements for order confirmation, routing, labeling, shipping documentation, pickup, and delivery
  • Monitor EDI transactions and retailer portals, resolve missing or rejected documents, and verify that required order, shipment, and invoice information has been successfully received
    • Invoicing and Chargebacks
  • Prepare and submit accurate invoices, reconcile ordered, shipped, and invoiced quantities, and partner with Finance to resolve discrepancies and deductions
  • Investigate operational chargebacks, prepare dispute documentation, track deadlines, and address recurring causes
    • Retail Launch Readiness
  • Own retail order-execution readiness for new retailer and item launches, including operational data checks, test orders, documented workflows, and clear handoffs with Commercialization, Sales, Procurement and Inventory, and fulfillment partners
    • Reporting and Process Improvement
    • Maintain accurate order records and reporting by retailer and distribution center, with clear deadlines, shipment status, exceptions, and next actions
    • Improve procedures, service reporting, and backup coverage; simplify or automate repetitive work and verify that changes improve accuracy and reliability

What You'll Bring:

    • 3+ years of relevant experience in wholesale order management, retail operations, or customer operations within a consumer products business
    • Experience personally managing national retailer orders from receipt through delivery and invoicing, including resolving exceptions across internal teams and fulfillment partners
    • Experience supporting multiple distribution centers and meeting retailer routing and compliance requirements
    • Hands-on experience monitoring EDI transactions, diagnosing operational errors, and working with providers to resolve them
    • Experience working directly with third-party warehouses and transportation partners on fulfillment and delivery issues
    • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including reconciling order, inventory, shipment, and invoice data
    • Sound judgment when priorities compete, with the ability to explain risks, recommend actions, and recognize when a decision requires approval
    • Clear communication, careful attention to detail, and consistent follow-through
    • Examples of improving an operating process, with a clear explanation of your contribution and the resulting change in accuracy, service, or manual effort

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in beauty, fragrance, personal care, or home products
  • Familiarity with OpenText, ShipIQ, Partners Online, or comparable retailer systems; experience improving workflows through ERP systems or automation
  • Proficiency in LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT)
  • Experience supporting new retailer launches or managing Amazon fulfillment alongside national wholesale accounts

What You'll Get

  • Be part of a fast-growing company with an awesome mission
  • Highly competitive salary and equity so you’re a part of the Snif family
  • An opportunity for growth and ability to widen your role and responsibilities
  • Medical, Dental and Vision healthcare insurance
  • 401K Retirement Plan with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible vacation and PTO policy
  • Industry-leading well-being and mental-health benefits
  • Virtual and remote work as well as work-from-home setup
  • Snif product on us!
Snif is an equal employment opportunity employer to all employees and applicants for employment. We celebrate people from all backgrounds. If you’re driven by our mission, we’d love to hear from you! Email us at

We invest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous development—equipping you with the tools, training, and opportunities to excel. With an unwavering commitment to safety, partnership, belonging, and impact, we empower you to lead change and strengthen industries worldwide.

Your Future Starts Here.

If you’re ready to push limits, reimagine what’s possible, and create the extraordinary, Hexion is where you belong.

Anything is possible when you imagine everything.

Role Impact

The Process Controls and Automation Manager leads the process controls and automation center of excellence (COE) team in conjunction with other global engineers to hold high accountability for the performance, reliability, and standardization of the control systems that run Hexion's manufacturing network. This is a working manager role: the incumbent leads a team of process controls engineers while remaining personally engaged in design, programming, troubleshooting, and technology evaluation at the plant level.

The Manager sets the direction and standards for control system and OT network architecture, programming practice, and instrumentation across the region, and converts site issues, project demand, and emerging technology into a prioritized work plan the team can execute. The role owns the process controls project portfolio, partners with project and process engineering managers on multi-site implementations and serves as the senior technical authority when control system incidents, upgrades, or new installations require immediate direction.

The Manager reports to the Sr. Director, Manufacturing Process Engineering and works in a peer relationship with Reliability, Operations, Maintenance, EHS, IT, and AI. Success in the role combines deep technical credibility in SIS, PLC, DCS, and MES environments with the people leadership to build a capable, geographically distributed team and the business judgment to make the case for control system investment.

What You Will Do

Process Controls Leadership and Technical Direction (40% of Time)

  • Lead the Process Control and Automation COE group, setting priorities, assigning work, and ensuring the team delivers responsive support to sites across the region.
  • Own the development and maintenance of process controls standards and protocols that standardize the equipment, instrumentation, programming methods, and documentation used in plant control systems.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for instrument and control activities, communicating clearly with technicians, site leadership, and senior management when issues arise.
  • Direct the design and specification of instrument and control equipment on capital and maintenance projects, and lead or assign engineers to project design teams.
  • Manage SIS, DCS, and PLC reliability, software upgrade programs, and system downtime within a matrixed supply chain and across assets at varying stages of their depreciated life.
  • Oversee reliability calculations for safety instrumentation system (SIS) and the documentation supplied to safety standard committees.
  • Support regional specialists and site teams in troubleshooting efforts and corrective actions, providing immediate direction during process incidents and new installation start-ups.
  • Partner with Reliability, Operations, EHS, and IT to keep control system practice aligned with plant reliability, process safety, and cybersecurity requirements.

Hands-On Engineering and Technology Development (30% of Time)

  • Personally develop and review instruction code for Rockwell PLC and Emerson DeltaV networks or equivalent control systems, carrying a working share of the group's technical load.
  • Own the design approach for HMI and control platforms, including escalation to the highest levels of vendor technical support, and document and define changes for manufacturing and technical audiences.
  • Investigate new instrumentation and programming technologies, develop testing protocols, and validate viability before incorporation into the existing process controls structure.
  • Apply mathematical and data analysis to design AI-driven models for process improvement, including machine analysis platforms such as AWS, TwinThread, or equivalent.
  • Evaluate and resolve networking issues at both the IT business layer and the industrial IOT layer, including process control network, data historian, and other PCN infrastructure.
  • Provide standardized design for OT layer with proper documentation and roadmap for implementation across the network sites.
  • Maintain working knowledge of batching systems and manufacturing execution systems, including non-standard configurations in use across the network.

Project Portfolio and Strategic Planning (20% of Time)

  • Build and manage programs that deliver control system project implementations across multiple remote sites, working with project and program managers on scope, schedule, and resourcing.
  • Develop and manage the annual process controls budget, forecasting operating and capital requirements and managing performance against plan.
  • Establish a risk-based prioritization process for control system obsolescence, upgrade, and automation investment, and build the business cases that support it.
  • Escalate significant unfunded control system risk to engineering and operations leadership and participate in capital prioritization reviews.
  • Track and report control system performance, project delivery, and program metrics to the Americas Engineering leadership team.

Leadership, People Development, and Culture (10% of Time)

  • Build, coach, and develop a team of process controls engineers working remotely and across multiple sites, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable for results.
  • Lead with flexibility and calm confidence, resolving problems quickly and steadying the team and site partners during process upsets.
  • Promote a culture of inclusion, empowerment, and psychological safety that encourages proactive problem identification.
  • Support succession planning and the technical and leadership development of engineers within the controls and broader engineering organization.
  • Model Hexion's values of integrity, innovation, accountability, and safety in all leadership actions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor of Science in chemical or electrical engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of experience building, programming, and supporting industrial control systems, including significant time in a plant environment working alongside controls technicians and electrical & instrumentation technicians.
  • Demonstrated leadership of engineers or technical specialists, whether through direct supervision, project leadership, or a matrixed team.
  • Solid command of control system architecture and programming, with hands-on depth in Rockwell PLC, MES, data historian, and Emerson DeltaV platforms or equivalents.
  • Working knowledge of industrial process control network, network communication protocols, and data security in conjunction with the IT team.
  • Ability to manage controls programs and project portfolios across multiple remote sites in a matrix environment.
  • Strong technical writing, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to explain an issue and its proposed solution clearly to any audience.
  • Certified with SIS calculation and fluent in SIS calculation applications, preferably ExSILentia.
  • Advanced computer skills, including the ability to build and work in large Excel models and to collect and interpret data across sites running non-matching systems.
  • Willingness to travel, typically 50 percent, to manufacturing sites across the Americas.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or professional registration as a licensed engineer.
  • Experience with batch and continuous chemical manufacturing processes and the working principles of unit operation.
  • Experience developing standards, documenting procedures, and maintaining controls documentation using appropriate symbols and drawing conventions.
  • Experience with machine analysis and process analytics software such as TwinThread, or with developing AI-driven models for process improvement.
  • Working knowledge of a computerized maintenance management system such as SAP PM.
  • Familiarity with electronic data management systems such as Hexion MOC, PI, and AIMs, or equivalents, and with the WAVE productivity project system.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Project and strong general Microsoft Office skills.
  • Experience building capital business cases and securing funding for automation or obsolescence projects.

Leadership Attributes

A working leader who stays close to the technology and earns credibility with the team by solving problems alongside them.

Self-directed and comfortable leading a distributed team in a matrix environment, providing immediate direction when sites are under pressure.

Flexible and quick to solve problems, imparting calming confidence without arrogance.

Skilled communicator who translates complex control system issues into terms that technicians, plant leadership, and senior management can act on.

Data driven and standards minded, balancing day-to-day site support against the longer work of building a consistent controls platform.

Other

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, pregnancy, race, national origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or military status, status as a qualified individual with a disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

To be considered for this position candidates are required to submit an application for employment through our career site and, be at least 18 years of age. Any offer of employment will be conditioned upon successful completion of a drug test and background investigation, as well as authorization for the Company to conduct additional periodic background checks as required by the Chemical Facility Anti-Terrorism Standards (CFATS) or regulations adopted by the department of Homeland Security or other regulatory agencies. raw.excerpt: About ShippaboShippabo is a tech-enabled ocean freight forwarder.
raw.description:
About Shippabo

Shippabo is a tech-enabled ocean freight forwarder. Founded in 2016, we have raised $22 million from Wonder Ventures, TenOneTen Ventures, Double M Partners, and Slow Ventures. Our platform gives importers one place to book, track, and manage ocean shipments, with their internal teams and their overseas suppliers working from the same data. Behind the platform sits a real forwarding operation: a dedicated ocean contracts and pricing team that negotiates carrier rates, and a team in China that works directly with shippers at origin. We’re about 40 people across the US, Canada, Vietnam, Philippines, and China. Our engineering team builds the software that makes the operation faster and more transparent than a traditional forwarder can be.

About the role

This is an account management role built around retention, service quality, and problem solving. It’s not a quota-carrying sales job. There’s no cross-sell or upsell target, and no cold outbound. The one exception is re-engaging importers who have gone quiet or moved volume elsewhere, where the goal is to understand what went wrong and win the volume back. What we actually need is someone who can look at an account and a shipment and figure out what is really going on, then drive it to resolution without needing to hand it off.

What you’ll do

Own a portfolio of importer accounts. You are the primary relationship owner for a book of existing importers. You are accountable for retention, satisfaction, and the health of the relationship over time.

Diagnose before you escalate. When a client raises an issue, your first job is to determine what kind of issue it is. Is it a rate problem, a service failure, an expectation that was set wrong, or a process that broke internally? The answer determines who needs to be involved and what the fix is. We want you to make that call, not pass it off to someone else.

Review shipments and catch problems early. You should be able to look at a booking and know when something is off before the customer tells you. Rolled bookings, a vessel schedule change that will miss a delivery window, drayage constraints at the port of discharge, a document mismatch that will hold a container at customs. You’ll know when to dig into carrier schedules, customs entry, drayage, or documentation, and when it is normal activity not worth alarming a customer over.

Balance the client and the business. Understand what each importer is optimizing for, whether that’s landed cost, transit reliability, or predictability, and weigh that against what makes commercial sense for Shippabo. Advocate hard for the client, and be honest internally about what we got wrong.

Drive quote acceptance and forecast accuracy. Make sure forecasted volume actually books, quotes are accepted or the reason they were not is understood, and that feedback goes back to the supply/pricing team so our rates stay competitive on the lanes that matter.

Own outcomes across teams. Many customer requests require Product, Operations, Finance, or the origin team in China. You’re the owner of the outcome. You map the steps, set the timeline, follow up, and close the loop with the customer.

Monitor and report on your portfolio. Track operational and revenue metrics across your accounts. Surface trends, at-risk accounts, and volume shifts before they become surprises.

Serve as an advisor, not an order taker. Educate importers on supply chain practices and on what Shippabo's platform and network can do for them. Communicate market conditions, rate trends, surcharges, and capacity shifts in terms of what they mean for that specific customer’s business.

Handle inbound small and new importer leads. Own inbound marketing leads from smaller importers, qualify them, and get them onboarded and running.

Re-engage churned and dormant accounts. Work through importers who have reduced or stopped shipping with us, understand why, and rebuild the relationship where the fit is still there.

What we’re looking for

  • Direct experience in ocean freight forwarding, NVOCC, or as an importer managing ocean freight. You understand the mechanics of an ocean shipment end to end, from booking and origin cargo receipt through customs clearance and final delivery.
  • The ability to troubleshoot independently. You form a hypothesis about what went wrong, check it against the data, and act. You don’t need a manager to tell you where to look.
  • Strong commercial judgment. You know the difference between a concession that’s worth making and one that sets a bad precedent.
  • Structured thinking. You can take a messy situation with many moving parts, prioritize it, map out next steps, and communicate clearly what happens next and by when.
  • Clear written communication. Much of this job is explaining a complicated logistics situation to a customer in plain language, quickly.
  • Comfort in a small company. About 40 people, no large support layer, a lot of ownership.

Helpful but not required

  • Experience with a freight forwarding TMS or a modern digital forwarder platform.
  • Familiarity with customs documentation and entry requirements
  • Working knowledge of demurrage, detention, and how to keep clients out of accessorial charges.

Compensation

Base salary is $110,000 to $120,000.CAD. An annual performance bonus brings expected Year 1 total cash compensation to $130,000 to $150,000 CAD. Actual compensation is dependent upon many factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, location, and market demands. This range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Benefits for our Shipmates

At Shippabo, our benefits are a reflection of our core values and our commitment to making healthy living affordable and accessible to everyone on board. Our team members enjoy ample Vacation and Sick time, allowing you to take the breaks you need to recharge and ensuring your well-being remains a priority as you grow with us. We offer multiple health plan options and contribute meaningfully toward the cost of coverage for you and your dependents, in addition to a RRSP Plan with matching contributions.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Shippabo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation. If you require accommodations during the interview process, please contact .

Salary: $120,000-$150,000 CAD

On top of it all, you know all there is to know about sales goals, velocities, and planning metrics, and you’re willing and ready to share that knowledge with your team and cross-functionally. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you for our Sr. Sales Manager - Costco position!

About you:

  • Your parents and Bear Grylls would agree that you are extremely resourceful and have the ability to make a lot out of a little.

Clipping Specialist (3-month FTC)

About the role

NewGen is hiring a Clipping Specialist on a 3-month fixed-term contract to build and run our clipping programmes at scale. You will find and onboard clipping channels, run campaigns through our in-house tech, and make sure every clip we seed lands with the right audience for the right brand.

NewGen is a social-first creator and influencer marketing agency. We work with global brands in gaming, sport, entertainment and consumer, and clipping is one of our fastest-growing propositions: turning long-form content, creator streams, trailers and campaign moments into short-form clips that are distributed through a network of clipping channels on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and X.

This is a hands-on role at the centre of a new line of business. You will work with our campaign, creator and tech teams, and you will have a direct say in how the proposition and the tooling evolve.

Contract:

3-month fixed-term contract (FTC), with potential to extend or go permanent

Location:

Remote

Start:

ASAP

What you'll do

Work with the clipping network

  • Identify, vet and recruit clipping channels and clippers across TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and X, through platforms and our own technology.
  • Build and maintain a segmented database of channels by niche (gaming, sport, entertainment, lifestyle), audience location and typical reach
  • Manage ongoing relationships with clippers so we have a reliable, responsive network ready to activate at short notice

Run campaigns at scale through our tech

  • Set up and manage clipping campaigns end to end in NewGen's in-house tooling: campaign sign-up, channel authentication, view caps, tracking and payouts
  • Brief clippers on the content, the moments to prioritise and the brand guidelines, and quality-check clips before and after they go live
  • Monitor campaign performance daily and move budget, caps and channels around to hit view and geo targets
  • Manage multiple campaigns in parallel across different clients and markets

Report and improve

  • Produce clear performance reporting for internal teams and clients: views, reach by geo, CPM delivered, top-performing clips and channels
  • Feed back to our product and tech team on what the tooling needs to do better, and help test new features as they ship
  • Document the process and playbooks so the programme can scale beyond your contract
  • Keep on top of platform changes, clipping trends and what competitors and creators are doing

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • Hands-on experience running clipping, meme page, UGC or creator distribution campaigns, either agency-side, in-house or as a clipper or channel operator yourself
  • A working knowledge of where clippers live and how they operate: Discord communities, Clipfarm or similar platforms, payout models and view caps
  • A strong instinct for what makes a clip perform on TikTok, Shorts, Reels and X, and for spotting fake or low-quality reach
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of channels and campaigns at once, with the organisation to keep it all moving
  • Confident with campaign tooling, spreadsheets and reporting, and quick to learn new platforms

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in gaming, esports, sport or entertainment content
  • Experience with Twitch and YouTube creator campaigns, game launches or trailer moments
  • Experience with multi-market campaigns, especially US and UK
  • Familiarity with short-form editing tools or AI editing workflows
  • An existing network of clippers or channel owners you can bring with you

Contract details

  • 3-month fixed-term contract, full time, starting as soon as possible
  • Remote contract
  • Pro-rata salary or day rate depending on how you prefer to work:
  • A genuine route to extension or a permanent role if the programme grows as we expect

Coaching and Leadership Development Specialist

Salary: £40,000 - £45,000 per annum with up to 10% annual bonus paid quarterly + competitive benefits package

Location: Remote with occasional travel to office locations

The Coaching & Leadership Development Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, delivery and embedding of coaching and leadership development activity across the Health Assessment Advisory Services (HAAS) within Ingeus.

The postholder will work closely with the Leadership Development Lead to support the iLEAD leadership development programme, embed a consistent coaching approach across HAAS, and strengthen manager confidence in effective development, feedback, performance, wellbeing and career conversations.

A core focus of the role is to help build practical coaching capability across managers, trainers, emerging leaders and colleagues. The postholder will develop coaching resources, facilitate coaching sessions, support action learning and reflective practice, and help ensure leadership development is transferred into day-to-day management practice.

The role will contribute to a culture of continuous learning, confident leadership and effective people development by supporting accessible, inclusive and practical coaching interventions across HAAS.

What you’ll be doing

  • Support the Leadership Development Lead to develop and embed a consistent HAAS coaching framework.

  • Support delivery and embedding of the iLEAD leadership development programme.

  • Create, develop and deliver coaching sessions, group coaching, reflective practice sessions and development conversations for identified cohorts.

  • Support managers, trainers, emerging leaders and aspiring leaders to build confidence in coaching skills.

  • Develop practical coaching tools, templates, guides and resources for managers and leaders.

  • Support the creation of coaching resources for Personal Development Reviews/Plans, career conversations, feedback conversations, wellbeing conversations and performance discussions.

  • Facilitate action learning sets, peer learning groups, confidence-building sessions and learning reinforcement activities.

  • Help participants apply learning from leadership development programmes into day-to-day leadership and management practice.

  • Gather participant feedback and identify themes to support continuous improvement of iLEAD and wider leadership development activity.

  • Work with the Leadership Development Lead to ensure coaching is integrated into leadership development journeys rather than treated as a standalone activity.

  • Design and deliver bite-sized coaching, manager confidence and skills practice sessions.

  • Support managers to develop effective coaching habits that improve colleague development, engagement, performance and progression.

  • Work with Content, Digital Learning and LMS colleagues to ensure coaching resources are accessible, engaging and available on iLearn where appropriate.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date coaching materials, session plans, reflective templates and manager toolkits.

  • Track coaching activity and provide regular updates to the Leadership Development Lead.

  • Support evaluation of coaching impact, including participant confidence, behaviour change, learning transfer and participant experience.

  • Identify common development themes from coaching activity while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.

  • Build effective relationships with managers, leaders, People & Culture, L&D colleagues, operational stakeholders and iLEAD participants.

  • Promote inclusive, ethical and psychologically safe coaching practice.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of coaching, leadership development, adult learning and behaviour change practice.

  • Maintain a personal development plan and engage in ongoing CPD relevant to coaching, leadership development and L&D.

Essential Criteria

  • Experience delivering coaching, mentoring, learning or development support.

  • Experience delivering group coaching, action learning sets or peer learning interventions.

  • Experience supporting managers, leaders or colleagues to improve confidence and capability.

  • Strong understanding of coaching principles, reflective practice and behaviour change.

  • CIPD Level 5 Associate Diploma in Organisational Learning & Development, People Management, HR, Coaching or equivalent qualification.

  • ILM Level 5 Coaching & Mentoring qualification or equivalent professional coaching qualification.

  • Experience designing or delivering learning sessions, workshops, coaching resources or development materials.

  • Strong facilitation, communication and active listening skills.

  • Ability to build trust and credibility with managers, leaders and participants.

  • Ability to create practical, accessible and easy-to-use development resources.

  • Good understanding of adult learning principles and blended learning approaches.

  • Ability to work sensitively with confidential development themes and coaching conversations.

  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.

  • Ability to gather feedback and use it to improve development interventions.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with L&D colleagues, operational managers and People & Culture.

  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail.

  • Flexible, proactive and able to work effectively as part of a dispersed team.

  • Evidence of relevant CPD in coaching, mentoring, L&D, HR or leadership development.

  • General IT skills and ability to use software effectively.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience supporting leadership development programmes.

  • Experience using an LMS or digital learning platform to support learning and development activity.

  • Experience working in a healthcare, public service, regulated or contract-led environment.

  • Experience supporting talent development or career progression activity.

  • CIPD Level 5 Associate Diploma in Organisational Learning & Development, People Management, HR, Coaching or equivalent qualification.

  • ILM Level 5 Coaching & Mentoring qualification or equivalent professional coaching qualification.

  • ICF accreditation or equivalent professional coaching accreditation.

Please note, we may shortlist and conduct interviews before the closing date and we may close this role early if we receive enough applications.

At Ingeus, our culture is built on treating everyone with dignity, ensuring every individual feels valued, respected and recognised for their contribution.

As a Disability Confident Employer, we understand that everyone’s journey is different, and we’re committed to making our recruitment process as inclusive and accessible as possible. If you require any support or adjustments—whether that’s help with the application, interview format, or anything else—we’re here to listen and work with you to find the best approach. Our goal is to ensure you can showcase your skills and potential in a way that works for you. Please don’t hesitate to contact us to discuss how we can support you.

Ingeus is a leading human services provider helping people, business and communities thrive through employment, skills and health & wellbeing services. We are a trusted partner to government and industry delivering services that create positive social impact and transform lives.

Description

At MEDvidi, the Automation team builds and operates a mix of AI and conventional product features that automate clinical and operational workflows - from AI-drafted medical documentation to automated resolution of patient issues, intake verification flows, provider tooling, and the backend pipelines behind them. We free clinicians and operations from manual work a machine can do reliably and safely, in a domain where mistakes have real clinical and compliance consequences.

It's a full-stack product team, not an AI lab: we ship UI, backend workflows, integrations, and AI features side by side, and we measure them the same way.

The team works closely with Product, Engineering, MedOps, Clinical people. We're hiring an Product Analyst to own analytics for the team end-to-end as our automated surface area grows.

The role

You'll be the Product Analyst for the team - across everything we ship, both classical product features and AI-powered ones. You'll turn the production behavior of our systems into evidence the team can act on: which parts work, where they fail silently, and what to fix next. The work blends product analytics, AI evaluation, and operational analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full product analytics stack for features the team ships - discovery and sizing, experiment design and analysis, funnel and adoption analysis, post-release impact assessment - across both AI-powered and conventional product features.
  • Analyze production behavior of AI and automation workflows across clinical and operational journeys.
  • Investigate hallucinations, silent failures, and quality degradation in AI-generated output.
  • Work directly with logs, transcripts, generated artifacts, and operational data to find patterns dashboards miss.
  • Design evaluations for AI quality - both automated and human review - and close the loop into prompt and product changes.
  • Build monitoring and dashboards for AI and automation health, and the operational metrics they roll up to.
  • Measure business and operational impact of automation initiatives and surface the risks they introduce.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, MedOps, and Legal to support fast decisions under ambiguity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Product Analytics/Operational Analytics/Data Analytics, or analytics roles within complex production systems.
  • Understanding of AI, ML, and LLM systems.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLM or AI output - prompt iteration, eval frameworks and human review pipelines is a strong plus.
  • Effective, structured written and verbal communication - able to turn analysis into crisp, decision-ready writeups that non-analysts can act on.
  • Comfort in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where ground truth often has to be constructed.
  • Strong product / operational analytics background, comfortable owning metrics end-to-end and writing SQL and Python code against messy production data.
  • Fluent Russian; English level B2 or higher,
  • Ability to work CET-overlapping hours in a B2B format.

Nice to Have

  • Experience evaluating LLM outputs or AI systems.
  • Previous experience in Data Science or Machine Learning.

What we offer

  • Opportunity to work on products at the intersection of Product Analytics and AI.
  • Real influence on product direction and engineering practices
  • High-impact work in a product-driven medical tech company
  • Startup environment: fast iteration, high ownership, minimal bureaucracy
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

  • 19 working days of vacation per year

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events.
