raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability.

As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey.

This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars

  • Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders.
  • Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams.
  • Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators.
  • Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable.
  • Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels.

Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling

  • Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance.
  • Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices.
  • Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation.

Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels

  • Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them.
  • Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities.
  • Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders.

Use automation & AI to scale technical content

  • Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools.
  • Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar).
  • Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year.
  • Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams.
  • Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories.
  • Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion.
  • Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering.
  • Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing.
  • Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 94,025 - EUR 112,830. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Job Title: Engagement Associate

Location: Remote

Company: PharmaForceIQ Inc.

Job Type: Full-time, Exempt

About Us:

We are a team of marketing strategists, digital innovators, life science leaders, and other professionals who are driving growth, pushing the envelope, and going above and beyond on behalf of our clients every day.

PharmaForceIQ is a real-time customer engagement platform built specifically for life sciences. We empower leaders across functions and brands with a faster, more effective way to engage healthcare professionals and patients. By streamlining real-time optichannel execution, leveraging AI, and focusing on measurable impact, we are driving a paradigm shift from sluggish, siloed customer engagement efforts to agile, data-driven strategies that deliver unmatched efficiency and tangible results.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an innovative Optichannel Associate with 0-2 years of experience in marketing, preferably within pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare agency environments. This role will own day-to-day optichannel program execution, lead cross-functional coordination, and ensure high-quality client deliverables across HCP, patient, and clinical trial recruitment campaigns. The Optichannel Associate will report to the Optichannel Engagement Manager and will serve as a key partner to both internal teams and external clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as primary day-to-day project lead for assigned accounts, managing timelines, deliverables, and communication across internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Maintain and deepen client relationships by driving agendas for client-facing and MLR/PRC meetings, capturing action items, proactively identifying risks and dependencies, and ensuring follow-through.
  • Serve as a central liaison between PharmaForceIQ and vendors/partners, overseeing asset tagging, asset trafficking, and delivery, and resolving issues to keep projects on schedule and within scope.
  • Lead project management for complex, multi-channel initiatives, including HCP, patient, medical affairs, market access, and clinical trial recruitment campaigns, ensuring alignment to overall strategy and KPIs.
  • Own the development of monthly and quarterly performance reports, synthesizing data, generating insights, and providing strategic recommendations to optimize campaigns and inform future planning.
  • Oversee weekly review of dashboards and analytics to ensure data integrity, timely updates, and actionable insights for both internal and client stakeholders.
  • Contribute to optichannel strategic planning by partnering with paid media, search, creative, and data/analytics teams to translate brand and business objectives into integrated activation plans.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, tools, and best practices to increase efficiency, quality, and scalability of optichannel program execution.
  • Support new business and organic growth opportunities through input into scopes, timelines, and resourcing for optichannel programs.

Prerequisites

We value experience with pharmaceutical or biotech companies, marketing agencies, or creative agencies that support regulated healthcare brands.

Hard Skills

Required:

  • 0–2 years of experience in marketing or agency account/project management, with hands-on ownership of multi-channel campaign execution.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, and Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides).
  • Demonstrated project management experience (timelines, status tracking, risk management, stakeholder coordination).
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Creatopy or other banner/ad creation platforms.
  • Exposure to programmatic, paid search, or paid social channels in the context of optichannel campaigns.
  • Familiarity with dashboards and analytics tools used in digital/optichannel marketing.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including meeting facilitation and expectation setting with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and keep cross-functional teams accountable to timelines and deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into clear recommendations.
  • Highly goal-driven, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous environment.

Qualifications

  • 0–2 years of experience in marketing, account management, or project management, ideally within a media, communications, or optichannel agency supporting pharmaceutical or biotech clients.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; degree in life sciences, marketing, communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Prior experience working in the pharma and biotech industry or with HCP and patient-focused campaigns is strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines without sacrificing quality.

Why Join Us?

  • Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive total compensation range of $60,000- $75,000 annually, which includes base salary and eligibility for our performance-based bonus program. Final compensation will vary depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and overall business considerations.
  • Competitive base salary. Actual base pay will depend on varying circumstances, including the position, location, individual qualifications, market finances, and other operational business needs. This position is bonus-eligible as well.
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits package.
  • A collaborative and growing workforce.

At PharmaForceIQ Inc. we value our employees and offer a generous benefits package that includes: Medical, Dental, Vision, Short Term Disability and the option to Buy-Up, Long Term Disability, Basic Term Life Insurance, Additional Term Life, Voluntary Insurance: Accident, Legal Plan, AD&D, Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Unlimited Paid Time Off, Flexible Spending Account & Dependent Flexible Spending Account, 401k and Company Match, 6 Paid Company Holidays, and Employee Assistance Program for all employees, Applicants must be at least 18 years old to apply. PharmaForceIQ Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We value a culture of inclusion and diversity within our workforce and are committed to maintaining a workplace free from prohibited employment conduct, including discrimination or harassment based on race (including hairstyle/texture), color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and related conditions), age (40 and over), religion, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, civil partnership, status as a covered veteran, status in the Uniformed Services of the United States, citizenship and any other characteristic protected by State and Federal law.

Salary: $60,000-$75,000 / year

Our interdisciplinary care teams reduce avoidable hospitalizations and improve quality of life wherever individuals call home. Through our leading-edge care model, Tuesday Health is shaping the future of community-based palliative care nationwide.

The Role:

The Member Engagement Specialist is responsible for engaging and enrolling eligible health plan members in Tuesday Health’s supportive care services. The Member Engagement Specialist will educate members on Tuesday Health’s service offerings and support ongoing engagement with the member throughout the program. The ideal candidate will be highly personable and professional with excellent communication skills and have experience working with members and caregivers.

Key responsibilities of this role may include:

raw.description:
About PSD Citywide

Ready to make a real impact on communities across North America?

PSD Citywide isn’t just a software company; we’re transforming how Local, First Nations, and Regional Governments achieve success and build sustainable futures for their communities. As a recognized leader in Enterprise Asset Management, maintenance management, and planning solutions, we provide cutting-edge software and expert advisory services that improve infrastructure and public services.

Why join us? We are a "Fun-clusive" organization! This means we intentionally foster a supportive and engaging culture where your contributions are celebrated, your skills are rewarded, and your career growth is encouraged.

Ready to influence change? Bring your expertise in technology and data to our team and directly shape how local governments improve service delivery. Apply now!

About the Role

The VP, Marketing is a growth-focused, strategic executive with proven expertise leading Marketing and Business Development teams to drive expansion for our PE-backed GovTech SaaS organization.
Reporting to the CRO and serving as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, the VP, Marketing will own the company’s marketing and business development strategy, team, and execution. This leader will connect corporate strategy to a measurable go-to-market (GTM) engine, strengthening our market position, generating qualified pipeline, and supporting revenue growth across our target municipal and government markets.

The ideal candidate brings experience scaling marketing in a B2B SaaS and GovTech environment, understands the expectations of a private equity-backed organization, and can balance strategic leadership with disciplined execution and measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing & GTM Strategy

  • Develop and execute an integrated marketing and GTM strategy aligned with corporate growth objectives and revenue targets.
  • Translate company strategy into clear market positioning, messaging, campaigns, and demand-generation priorities.
  • Build and strengthen the company’s brand, market presence, thought leadership, and competitive positioning within the GovTech SaaS space.
  • Develop strategies to support customer acquisition, expansion, retention, and entry into new markets or segments.
  • Partner closely with the CRO, Sales, Professional Services, Product, and Customer Success leaders to create a coordinated customer journey and revenue engine.

Marketing & Business Development Leadership

  • Provide overall leadership and direction to the Marketing and Business Development teams, including organizational structure, talent development, priorities, and performance.
  • Establish clear goals, KPIs, accountability, and operating rhythms across both functions.
  • Build a high-performing, data-driven team capable of supporting a growth-stage SaaS organization.
  • Ensure marketing and business development resources are aligned to the highest-value growth opportunities.

Demand Generation & Revenue Growth

  • Own the strategy for pipeline generation, lead acquisition, campaign performance, events, content, digital marketing, and other demand-generation channels.
  • Establish effective lead-generation and qualification processes in partnership with Sales.
  • Use data, market intelligence, and customer insights to optimize marketing investment and improve conversion throughout the funnel.
  • Develop reporting and attribution models that demonstrate marketing and business development contribution to pipeline and revenue.

Executive Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic member of the Senior Leadership Team, contributing to corporate strategy, organizational planning, and growth initiatives.
  • Support the CRO and CEO with board reporting, business performance updates, GTM metrics, and growth initiatives.
  • Provide clear analysis of marketing performance, pipeline contribution, market trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Help establish and execute scalable processes and operating disciplines appropriate for a PE-backed growth environment.
  • Partner with Finance and executive leadership on budgets, forecasting, resource allocation, and ROI.

Market & Customer Insight

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the municipal/government technology market, customer needs, competitive landscape, and emerging trends.
  • Develop market intelligence that informs corporate, product, sales, and GTM decisions.
  • Strengthen relationships with industry organizations, strategic partners, and key market influencers.
  • Leverage customer insights and data to continuously improve positioning, messaging, and the customer experience.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, with significant experience leading a B2B SaaS or technology marketing function.
  • Demonstrated experience building and executing growth-focused GTM strategies tied to revenue and pipeline outcomes.
  • Experience leading multiple marketing disciplines and ideally Business Development/BDR functions.
  • Experience in a PE-backed, high-growth, or investor-driven environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working closely with Sales and executive leadership to create an integrated revenue strategy.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS demand generation, marketing operations, CRM, digital marketing, content, brand, and performance analytics.
  • Experience developing and presenting executive-level and/or board-level reporting.
  • Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams through periods of growth and change.
  • Experience in GovTech, public-sector technology, enterprise software, or selling into municipalities/government is an asset.
  • Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and executive presence.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12–18 months, the VP, Marketing will have:

  • Established a clear, measurable Marketing & GTM strategy aligned to corporate growth objectives.
  • Built a high-performing, accountable Marketing and Business Development organization.
  • Increased qualified pipeline and improved conversion through the marketing and sales funnel.
  • Strengthened the company’s positioning and brand within the GovTech market.
  • Established meaningful marketing and BD KPIs, reporting, and ROI measurement.
  • Created a scalable GTM operating model that supports continued growth and PE value-creation objectives.
  • Established Marketing as a strategic business partner to Sales, Product, Professional Services, Customer Success, and the broader executive team.

The Candidate Journey

Resume Review:Once you apply, an actual person will review your resume and we are committed to getting back to you with a response.

Phone Interview:PSD’s People and Culture team will connect with you to learn about your experience and discuss the role further. They’ll also give you an understanding of what the interview process involves, along with an estimated timeline.

Virtual Interview:Depending on the position, there will be one or two interviews with the Hiring Team that will include questions related to your skills, work experience, values and goals. We provide the opportunity to meet with a wide range of staff members so you can learn more about life at PSD Citywide.

Offer/Feedback:The Hiring Team will debrief and make a decision within a few days of your final interview. If successful, your Recruiter will present you with a verbal offer, followed by a formal offer letter via email. If the timing was not right for this particular opportunity, we will connect with you and provide feedback.

PSD Citywide is committed to ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. We believe in integration, and we are committed to meeting the needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner. We will do so by removing and preventing barriers to accessibility.

We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Should you require any accommodation, please indicate this when you apply, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

PSD Citywide may use Google Gemini to assist with recruitment note taking during the hiring process. While we incorporate select AI features to enhance process efficiency, we remain committed to human-led decision making. All AI-generated outputs are subject to human review to ensure accuracy and fairness.

raw.description:
Vespa.ai is expanding its enterprise sales team to the United Kingdom and Ireland. We're looking for a results-driven Enterprise Account Executive to develop and close new business, grow existing customer relationships, and help organisations already using open-source Vespa evaluate Vespa Cloud.

You'll own the full sales cycle, including building your own pipeline, and work closely with technical and business stakeholders throughout the customer relationship. You should be able to position a technical platform in today's AI market, connecting its capabilities to specific customer use cases and business value. If you have a proven track record of selling technically complex platforms to engineering, data or AI teams and consistently exceeding quota, we'd like to hear from you.

About Vespa.ai

Vespa.ai is a Norwegian company building Vespa, the Apache 2.0-licensed open-source platform for search, recommendations and AI retrieval at scale.

Developed at Yahoo, Vespa has powered demanding production applications for more than a decade at very large scale. It combines vector, lexical and structured search with programmable ranking and machine learning inference in a single platform, helping applications find and rank relevant information from continuously changing data. Vespa powers production applications at companies including Spotify, Yahoo, Wix, DuckDuckGo and Elicit.

We operate Vespa Cloud for teams that want a managed service, and offer commercial software for customers running Vespa on their own infrastructure — so customers choose how and where they run, rather than being locked into one deployment model. Vespa.ai is well funded and growing.

What you'll do

  • Find and win new customers. Identify relevant accounts and use cases across the UK and Ireland, prospect, qualify and close new business. Build your own qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, relationships and industry engagement.
  • Own the full sales cycle. Lead discovery, business-case development, technical evaluations, negotiation and close. Work closely with Solutions Engineering while retaining ownership of qualification, next steps and the commercial outcome.
  • Develop inbound and open-source opportunities. Help organisations that discover Vespa through open source evaluate and adopt Vespa Cloud or our commercial self-managed offering.
  • Grow customer relationships. Own the commercial relationship from first sale through expansion and renewal, working with technical buyers, executive sponsors and procurement.
  • Stay close to the AI market. Recognise relevant customer needs and emerging use cases, and use those insights to sharpen your outreach and positioning.
  • Run your territory. Maintain an accurate pipeline and reliable forecast, and prioritise opportunities based on customer fit and commercial potential.

What we're looking for

  • Proven ability to generate and close your own business. You can give concrete examples of customers you identified and approached yourself, and opportunities you developed from first contact to a signed agreement.
  • Experience selling technical platforms to technical buyers. You've sold products such as search, databases, data infrastructure, developer tools or cloud services to engineering, data or AI teams, including working through technical evaluations and proofs of concept.
  • Practical understanding of AI applications. You understand where search, retrieval and data infrastructure fit in applications such as RAG and AI agents. You can ask informed discovery questions and connect technical capabilities to specific customer needs. You do not need to code, but you must be technically curious.
  • A strong sales track record. You have consistently met or exceeded B2B software sales quotas and can demonstrate strong discovery, negotiation, stakeholder-management and closing skills.
  • Independence and commercial judgment. You're comfortable in a growing company where processes are still evolving. You create opportunities rather than relying on inbound leads, and recognise potential in both AI-native companies and established enterprises.
  • Based in the UK, ideally in or near London, with the right to work in the UK and willingness to travel within the UK and Ireland.

Why join Vespa.ai

  • Proven technology in a growing AI market. Sell a platform with established production deployments and public customer references, with opportunities across search, recommendations and AI retrieval. You can show customers working applications, not just a roadmap.
  • Build our business in the UK and Ireland. Take ownership of developing the territory, winning customers and growing those relationships. Open-source adoption gives you a foundation to build on, while your prospecting and commercial judgement drive new business.
  • Work directly with the people building the product. Partner with Solutions Engineering on evaluations and POCs, with direct access to engineering and product expertise. Bring customer insights into decisions about how Vespa develops.
  • Offer customers deployment choice. Sell managed Vespa Cloud or commercial self-managed software, matching the offering to the customer's operational, security and data-residency needs.

Benefits

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission, workplace pension, paid annual leave, and stock options.

On-target earnings of £220,000–£280,000. The final offer will depend on relevant experience and demonstrated performance.

How to apply

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. A brief example of an opportunity you personally originated and closed is more useful than a generic cover letter. Please do not include confidential customer information.

Vespa.ai is an equal-opportunity employer.

Salary: £220,000 – £280,000

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleWe are seeking an Order and Billing Lead is responsible for the accurate and timely preparation, processing, and delivery of customer invoices.
raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an Order and Billing Lead is responsible for the accurate and timely preparation, processing, and delivery of customer invoices. This role works closely with Sales, Order Management, Revenue Accounting, Customer Service, Tax and Accounts Receivable to ensure customer billing aligns with contractual terms and internal policies.

The ideal candidate is a highly detail-oriented, individual contributor who is comfortable working with large volumes of order and billing transactions, and able to identify and resolve billing issues before invoices are issued to customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare, approve and issue customer invoices in accordance with contractual terms, billing schedules, and customer requirements.
  • Review sales orders, contracts, purchase orders, and supporting documentation to ensure billing is accurate and complete.
  • Verify pricing, quantities, billing dates, payment terms, tax information, and other invoice requirements.
  • Process recurring, milestone, usage-based, time-and-materials, and other types of customer billing.
  • Coordinate with Order Management to ensure orders are properly established and contain the information necessary for accurate billing.
  • Work with Revenue Accounting to ensure billing activity is consistent with revenue recognition requirements.
  • Research and resolve billing errors, rejected invoices, and customer billing inquiries.
  • Prepare credit memos, rebills, debit memos, and other billing adjustments in accordance with company policies.
  • Monitor billing schedules and proactively identify invoices that are approaching or past their scheduled billing dates.
  • Ensure invoices are delivered through the appropriate customer billing portals or other required channels.
  • Maintain accurate billing documentation and customer records.
  • Ensure accuracy of taxes on customer invoices.
  • Assist with customer account reconciliations and research discrepancies between billing records and the general ledger.
  • Support month-end and year-end close activities related to billing and accounts receivable.
  • Prepare billing reports and assist management with analysis of billing activity and outstanding issues.
  • Hands-on with the ERP in executing order to billing transaction, customer data management and wing to wing Order to billing.
  • Identify recurring billing problems and recommend improvements to billing processes and controls.
  • Assist with internal and external audit requests related to customer billing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, accounting, or a related finance function.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to interpret contracts, purchase orders, and billing instructions.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience working with an ERP or billing system.
  • Experience with complex B2B or enterprise billing.
  • Experience with software, SaaS, technology, professional services, or subscription-based businesses.
  • Experience with NetSuite, Zone Billing or similar ERP/billing platforms.
  • Experience with recurring, milestone, usage-based, or time-and-materials billing.
  • Experience working with customer procurement systems or electronic invoicing portals.
  • Experience supporting multi-site or multi-entity customers.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position will be measured by the ability to:

  • Issue accurate invoices on time and in accordance with contractual requirements.
  • Minimize order and billing errors, rejected invoices, and avoidable customer disputes.
  • Identify billing issues before invoices are sent to customers.
  • Maintain accurate and complete billing records.
  • Effectively communicate billing requirements and issues to internal stakeholders.
  • Support a smooth and efficient order-to-cash process.
  • Advise, lead and execute projects that simplify the order to billing to Collections processes for the company.

Why This Is A Once-In-A-Career Opportunity

  • Lead in a market undergoing significant disruption and growth from cloud migration to edge intelligence to AI-powered industrial automation.
  • Join a culture defined by ambition, authenticity, speed, teamwork, and the belief that manufacturing can meaningfully improve the world.
  • Competitive benefits, compensation and long-term impact on how the world’s industrial companies operate, automate, and innovate.

Why Join Velotic

Velotic is uniquely positioned at the intersection of industrial operations, advanced connectivity, and AI. Joining now means you can help shape:

Culture & Growth

  • Build foundational systems, processes, and culture from day one.
  • Work within a team defined by ambition, collaboration, authenticity, and speed.
  • Influence global operating models and employee experience at scale.

Work-Life Balance

  • Base Salary: MXN 424,000 - 530,000
  • Performance Bonus
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)
  • Global paid parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Join Us

Learn more at:

WHO WE ARE

Velotic is a newly-formed independent software company with a pure-play focus on industrial operations. We unite two category-defining portfolios -- ThingWorx and Kepware (formerly part of PTC) and Proficy (formerly part of GE Vernova) -- to transform industrial manufacturing, at scale. With $350M in annual revenue, a global footprint across a range of industries, a legacy customer base, and our intelligent data connectivity systems and AI solutions, we are one of the world's largest independent software companies focused on industrial operations -- here to power the future of manufacturing.

OUR MISSION

Enabling the world's industrial producers to do the right things right—across every shift, every plant, every day. We help manufacturers prosper by equipping them with software-defined, data-driven production systems that elevate quality, accelerate cycle times, improve resilience, and enable sustainable profit growth.

OUR VALUES

How we work matters as much as what we build. We shine brighter, bringing curiosity and energy to ever problem. We build what matters, turning fresh thinking into real impact. We move with pace and purpose, favoring good decisions made quickly. And we win the right way — together, holding ourselves to the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and respect. These values shape how we hire, lead, and hold each other accountable, every day.

CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.

Reports to: General Manager

Location: Remote (US or Canada); preference for candidates near Salt Lake City, Utah; Austin, Texas; or Toronto, Ontario

About the Role

    This role is the financial backbone of the merchandising organization—responsible for translating brand strategy into inventory investments, margin targets, and sales forecasts. It exists to own end-to-end planning for the brand, partnering with Product Development, Ecommerce, Customer Service, and Accounting to ensure the right product is in the right place at the right time.

    As Senior Merchandise Planner & Supply Chain Manager, you will own the full inventory management process from forecasting to purchase orders to import logistics to markdown management. Within the first 60 days, you will have full management of the OTB, forecasting, and orders.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Develop, monitor, and evaluate Open-to-Buy monthly with the executive team; deliver timely re-projections based on current trends to manage inventory and protect margin.
  • Establish a "never-out" system for best-sellers.
  • Forecast sales, receipts, gross margin, and inventory position on a monthly and seasonal basis at the sales channel, category, and warehouse level.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build assortment recommendations—brand and key-item projections, SKU count, and depth.
  • Manage inventory health through buying budgets, seasonal sell-through targets, PO receipt flow, and pricing strategies.
  • Manage the full purchase order lifecycle with vendors, from issuance through delivery, including coordinating container bookings and import logistics.
  • Navigate tariff classifications and government trade regulations to ensure compliance and accurate COGS.
  • Prepare recommendations for key financial meetings that maximize sales, margin, and inventory productivity.
  • Recap business performance weekly, review variance to plan, assess deviations from current trends, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Proactively identify and manage closeout/excess inventory to minimize risk.
  • Ensure structured reporting deliverables are met, evaluating reports for accuracy, efficiency, and standardized best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of owning end-to-end inventory planning, including replenishment, demand forecasting, weekly reporting, and open-to-buy management
  • Knowledge and use of an ERP for PO management
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional aptitude for retail math
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships across e-commerce, customer service, product development, sourcing, and finance teams; skilled at identifying and influencing key stakeholders
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong ability to learn new technical applications quickly
  • Strong forecasting acumen and data-driven decision-making
  • Proactive and comfortable managing a high-scope role independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a lead or management role
  • Experience in multi-channel B2B wholesale
  • Comfortable working with AI tools (Claude or similar) and Microsoft Office/365 integrations to streamline workflows
  • Exposure to planning, finance, analytical, or data management systems beyond Excel

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Team Impact: Build and lead inventory planning for the brand, with direct ownership of the decisions that drive sales, margin, and inventory productivity.
  • Growth & Leadership Development: High performers are quickly entrusted with greater responsibility, new challenges, and leadership opportunities across the portfolio of brands.
  • Ownership: Own the brand's entire inventory plan end to end—from pre-season strategy through in-season execution—and see the direct impact of your decisions on the business.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Please Note

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact .

Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. This position is not open to and cannot be filled by a B.C. Resident.

raw.excerpt: For the creatively obsessed. You know that feeling when you've got a great idea and just need to make it happen?
raw.description:
For the creatively obsessed.

You know that feeling when you've got a great idea and just need to make it happen? No endless planning, no overthinking. Just good creative instincts, a few clever tools and the skills to pull it off.

That’s the energy we’re after.

We're looking for a Content Creator who genuinely loves making things. Someone with great taste, a head full of ideas and the skills to bring them to life. Someone who's just as comfortable behind the camera as they are in front of it, and has the personality to make people want to watch.

And you'll be creating content for people just like you.

A little about us.

Envato is an all-in-one creative toolkit bringing together world-class creative assets, purpose-built AI tools to help people make their ideas real.

Our community is made up of designers, filmmakers, editors and creators who care about craft, love experimenting and are always looking for the next tool, technique or spark of inspiration to make better work.

What's the gig?

You’ll be one of the faces of Envato, creating content that brings our products to life and makes creatives want to try them for themselves.

Think clever product demos, creative experiments, social first videos and tutorials that don’t feel like tutorials. The kind of work that makes someone think, “I need that in my toolkit.”

You’ll own the process from first idea to final edit. Concepting, writing, filming, presenting, editing and experimenting with the latest creative tools, including AI.

One day, you might be bringing a new feature to life. The next, testing a creative technique or finding an unexpected way to tell a story.

This isn’t a content churn role. We want someone who cares about making genuinely good work. Content that entertains, inspires and helps creative people make something better.

Sound like you?

You’re creatively curious and know how to make things people actually want to watch.

You have strong video production and editing skills, a sharp eye for visual craft and a natural presence on camera. You know your way around tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects and Photoshop, and AI is already a meaningful part of how you create. You’re confident using it, excited by what’s possible and thoughtful about how it can make creative work better.

You understand social, but you’re not here to simply copy trends. You know how to find an interesting angle, tell a good story and make work feel fresh.

Most importantly, you love the craft, bring plenty of personality and don’t take yourself too seriously.

Show us what you've got.

Send us one piece of content you’re proud of that shows your creative taste, personality, what you can make and you on camera.

If you’ve used Envato tools or assets to create it, tell us.

Life at Envato

Great work can happen from anywhere and we believe in giving our people the flexibility to make work and life work for them. We're remote first globally, with the option to apply to work from another location for up to three months a year. You'll also get home office and team connection budgets, learning support and study leave, wellbeing benefits, two days of volunteer leave and generous paid parental leave.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

A few things before you apply

We know great people don't always tick every box, particularly those from neurodiverse and underrepresented backgrounds. We value different perspectives and lived experiences, so if the role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

We're big believers in using AI to work smarter, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions.

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy. We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information.

raw.title: Proposal Writer
raw.excerpt: About ButtonSince 2018, Button has been building reliable technology for government and private-sector clients with the goal of creating a more sustainable future through digital transformation.
raw.description:
About Button

Since 2018, Button has been building reliable technology for government and private-sector clients with the goal of creating a more sustainable future through digital transformation. Our agile, multi-disciplinary team works on truly impactful technology projects – from climate action to major funding programs. We create secure, easy-to-use systems through deliberate consideration and iteration. We are passionate about creating stronger communities through technology and continuing to grow across Canada and beyond.

You will work closely with our operations team and subject matter experts to develop responses to Requests for Proposals (RFPs), bids, government procurements, and private-sector competitive opportunities.

Your work will include:

  • Reviewing solicitation documents and identifying requirements, evaluation criteria, and submission risks.
  • Interviewing subject matter experts to gather technical, operational, and business information.
  • Asking thoughtful questions to uncover information that may not be immediately apparent.
  • Synthesizing complex technical concepts into clear, compelling, and persuasive written responses.
  • Developing proposal content that aligns with evaluation criteria and scoring rubrics.
  • Identifying information gaps and working collaboratively to gather what is needed before writing.
  • Using AI tools appropriately to support research, organization, and drafting while applying strong editorial judgment to ensure accuracy, quality, and confidentiality

While producing written work is the outcome of the job, knowing WHAT to write is key to success. You'll need to ascertain highly specialized and often technical information and ensure it's translated in a way that speaks directly to the assessment criteria.

Direct experience with public-sector procurement processes, government funding programs, and writing against scoring rubrics is considered a strong asset.

You may have experience in:

  • Proposal writing
  • Grant writing
  • Government procurement responses
  • Management consulting
  • Public policy
  • Research
  • Technical communications
  • Academic writing (Master's or PhD research)
  • Strategy or business analysis

You don't need to be a subject matter expert or technical yourself but you do need to be experienced and comfortable working with subject matter experts. The strongest proposal writers are exceptional listeners.

You don't simply record what subject matter experts say, you identify what's missing, ask follow-up questions, and uncover the information needed by the evaluators.

While you will not be expected to provide technical architecture or deeply technical summaries, the nature of our work involves delivering digital and technical solutions to our clients. A familiarity and comfort level with technology and technical conversations is important.

You'll likely be successful if you have proven experience:

  • Working with technical subject matter experts
  • Conducting interviews and extracting information from stakeholders, including technical recruiting
  • Turning incomplete or ambiguous information into well-structured written content
  • Writing against evaluation criteria or scoring rubrics
  • Working in fast-paced environments with competing deadlines

We operate in a fast-paced environment and the work will typically be offered in “chunks” as opportunities arise. A flexible schedule with some daytime availability is preferred to support collaboration with internal stakeholders. While the role is remote, most collaboration will occur during standard business hours (9–5 PST).

raw.description:
The Consultant, Mental Health & Suicide Prevention is a member of JED’s School Programs and Consulting division, and is an excellent opportunity for experienced education leaders and/or mental health clinicians who are seeking to utilize their talents on a national level. The Consultant supports District Programs, aiding in the creation and implementation of strategic plans for partner districts, which support student mental health, substance use, and suicide prevention efforts. The Consultant will engage in reviewing partner processes, programs and protocols and analyze partner-specific data to inform the strategies and guidance they provide. The Consultant’s experience and knowledge of mental health, and educational environments and systems, will be utilized in the implementation and development of program delivery to partner leadership. This role is skilled in relationship management, problem-identification and problem-solving, and resource development, while also providing guidance and technical assistance in school mental health. The Consultant will report to a Senior Consultant, Mental Health and Suicide Prevention (or the Senior Director, as needed) and work collaboratively with the entire JED team.

The Consultant, Mental Health & Suicide Prevention District Programs should reside within the states of Idaho, Montana, or Wyoming, and within an easy (approx. 60 min) commuting distance from an airport to facilitate transit to various regional and national districts. The Consultant, Mental Health & Suicide Prevention District Programs must have the ability and desire to travel to partner districts, conferences, regional internal meetings, and to the JED headquarters office in NYC regularly (up to 40% travel).

Key Responsibilities

Program Implementation and Technical Assistance Provision
  • Manage a consulting portfolio of partner districts in various JED program phases and locations, as assigned by JED leadership (supports a portfolio of approximately 15-20 districts nationwide).
  • Guide partners through the full cycle of JED’s programs with an emphasis on collaboration through consultation and coaching.
  • Leveraging school mental health expertise, provide direct technical assistance to partners on best practices in mental health practices, programming, and policies.
  • Analyze and synthesize data from a variety of sources to inform development of feedback reports, strategic plans, and other support resources for partners, and help partners draw meaningful conclusions from data.
  • Lead collaboration with partner personnel to develop a data-informed strategic plan to improve their practices, procedures, and policies around mental health support and suicide prevention, including the related fields encompassing student support.
  • Support partner personnel and leadership in communications planning in their efforts to leverage community engagement throughout various phases of JED’s programs.
  • Assist in the curation and development of mental health support and suicide prevention activities, materials, presentations, and other related resources for partner professional development, community meetings, etc.
  • Recommend evidence-based strategies and creative solutions to meet individual partner challenges throughout multi-year project execution.
  • Leverage expertise to assist with other school mental health and related consulting projects, as assigned.
  • Collaborate with other internal teams to develop high quality materials, activities, and other collateral to support program delivery.

Monitoring and Evaluation
  • Motivate and advise partners in completion of baseline assessment protocols, surveys, and other program activities and data collection methods.
  • Lead partners through a continuous evaluation process to review progress and measure effectiveness.
  • Regularly update strategic plans to include measurable progress made on JED assigned action items.
  • Utilize Salesforce and comply with other JED procedures to record and track program metrics for quality assurance and evaluation.

Project Management
  • Build and maintain positive and effective working relationships with partner leaders to ensure success throughout the duration of program engagement.
  • Monitor partner progress throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Oversee project timelines and ensure partners are meeting program milestones in a timely manner.
  • Assist partners with internal project management related to accomplishing goals in the implementation phase of programming.

Content Expertise
  • Serve as content expert regarding best practice in policies, procedures, and practices related to JED’s comprehensive approach core domains.
  • Act as both an advisor and subject matter expert during all phases of the program.
  • Maintain current knowledge about best practices related to school mental health, guiding district leadership through JED’s PK-12 programming with a focus on systems-wide school mental health transformation.
  • Support content development of and facilitate convenings, learning series, and related activities surrounding specific topics affecting partners to provide guidance, JED stances, and facilitated communication between partners.
  • Collaborate with leadership to update programmatic materials such as assessment tools, measurement tools, deliverables, and implementation tools to align with best practices.

Consulting Support
  • Work closely with the Senior Consultants, Senior Directors, and other leadership of JED’s School Programs and Consulting Division on assigned projects, team culture, and other key areas related to program delivery.
  • As needed, provide technical and analytical support to Senior Consultants and other team members conducting external consulting projects; assignments may include landscape analyses, report generation, and bespoke consulting initiatives related to mental health and suicide prevention.
  • Assist in the curation and development of mental health support and suicide prevention activities, materials, presentations, and other related resources for professional development, community meetings, etc.
  • Support internal JED functions by leveraging expertise to assist with other mental health and related projects, as assigned. May include content development for other JED offerings; training and development of new Consultants; support for other functions such as advocacy, recruiting, and community engagement teams.
  • Assist with the delivery of training, workshops, and other educational programming for partners, as assigned.

Functional Ownership
  • Owns a portfolio of districts, guiding them through JED’s program lifecycle (strategic assessment, planning, implementation, evaluation) and providing direct technical assistance on school mental health and suicide prevention practices.

Decision Rights & Collaboration
  • Decides day-to-day technical assistance approach and strategic recommendations for assigned partners independently.
  • Requires input from the Senior Consultant or Senior Director on cross-partner strategy and complex escalations.
  • Collaborates with internal teams on shared materials and resources.

Skills Knowledge and Expertise

Required
  • Minimum of master’s level training in education, educational leadership, counseling, psychology, social work, or related field required; LPC, MSW, MPH, MED, and early to mid-career PhD degree-holders are encouraged to apply.
  • At least 5-7 years professional experience working within, or in direct partnership with, PK-12 or higher education systems in ID, MT, or WY with experience in campus, district, or organizational level leadership preferred.
  • Strong technical knowledge of school based mental health, Social Emotional Learning, suicide prevention, and substance use prevention, required.
  • Deep knowledge of the relevant education systems and systems-level change, including data, daily operations, and the current educational landscape, required.
  • Self-driven and results-oriented with a positive outlook and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Strong research, analytical, and critical thinking abilities, and the ability to analyze and apply data to draw meaningful conclusions.
  • Experience leading, building, and managing education programs and collaborating with education leaders.
  • Experience in research and evaluation methodology, strongly preferred.
  • Excellent verbal communication.
  • Excellent written communication with experience in drafting report-style formats, with attention to detail.
  • Excellent presentation skills with experience and comfort presenting to large groups, including senior leadership.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, including comfort with establishing new partnerships, identifying new business opportunities, and a history of maintaining high partner engagement.
  • Experience working with Salesforce, Asana, or other CRM/project management systems strongly preferred.
  • Ability to travel to partner sites, conferences, and other JED engagements nationwide, as well as JED headquarters in NYC regularly (up to 40% travel).

Success Metrics
  • Partners meet program milestones and engagement goals on schedule.
  • Strategic plans and feedback reports are data-informed and delivered on time.
  • Strong partner satisfaction and continued engagement.

raw.title: AI Engineer (Offensive Security)
raw.excerpt: At CovertSwarm, we're doing something few teams get to do: building agentic workflows for real ethical hacking.
raw.description:
At CovertSwarm, we're doing something few teams get to do: building agentic workflows for real ethical hacking. This is greenfield engineering where you'll work alongside expert security consultants, translate their judgement into LLM-powered systems that are reliable, observable, and backed by rigorous evals.

You'll join a small, new team and help shape not just what we build but how we build it. All this, in a culture of low ego, high trust and constant learning. It's the perfect role for someone excited by real autonomy and technical challenge.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in EU. We gather in person around once per quarter for occasional offsites to kick off new workstreams and align as a team.

We are looking for a new AI Engineer to join our growing international team.

What you'll work on

You'll help design, build, and improve AI systems that support real offensive security work. This may include:

  • Autonomous hacking agents that carry out multi-step offensive workflows end to end. You'll design and build the architecture that makes them reliable and reusable.
  • Backend and interfaces that surface these agents to consultants: APIs, services, and UIs that turn raw agent capability into tools consultants can use independently.
  • Evaluation and benchmarking, building realistic target labs and eval harnesses to measure agent performance, and the validation logic that confirms exploits and reduces false positives. All of it built on testable, observable, and maintainable systems.
  • Gen-AI features for consultants, such as chatbot interfaces, text-generation tools, and strategy ideation features that solve real delivery problems.
  • Applied AI research, separating what's genuinely useful from what's hype. You'll have regular research time and an unlimited training budget for continuous learning

The tech stack

Our current stack includes Python, TypeScript, LangGraph, Docker and AWS. You don’t need deep experience in all of these, but you should be comfortable building production-quality systems and learning quickly.

Most of the work sits at the intersection of engineering, agentic AI, evaluation, observability, and usable internal tooling.

Who you are

You're a strong engineer who's gone deep on LLMs and agents. You write good quality code, you think rigorously, you take problems and run with them end to end.

What experience you need to be successful

  1. Strong production engineering experience
    You should have proven experience writing high-quality production code and building reliable applications across at least a portion of our tech stack. This includes writing testable and maintainable software, designing systems end to end, working with CI/CD, deploying services, debugging production issues, and making sensible engineering trade-offs.
  2. Experience building and evaluating agentic workflows
    You must have hands-on experience building agentic workflows or LLM-based systems that involve tool use, multi-step reasoning, orchestration, evaluation, or automation.
    We are especially interested in people who have thought deeply about how agents fail, how to measure performance, and how to move beyond impressive demos into reliable systems. This experience may come from professional work, open-source contributions, research, or serious side projects.
  3. Ownership, judgement, and clear communication.
    You’re excited to work on a frontier problem where AI is being applied to real offensive security workflows in new and meaningful ways. You can take a rough idea, shape the approach, make good technical decisions, build and ship the system, and iterate based on feedback. You keep the wider goal in view, test assumptions quickly, adapt as we learn, and communicate clearly throughout, whether you’re documenting an architecture decision or explaining an agent failure mode to a non-AI specialist.

The Perks

Join a team that values both excellence and balance:

  • True remote flexibility - work from anywhere.
  • Unlimited training to keep your skills sharp.
  • Unlimited vacation - because burnout helps no one.
  • Private medical insurance and pension scheme.
  • Conference speaking bonuses.
  • A culture of radical candor, continuous improvement and technical excellence.

The Culture

At CovertSwarm, we take pride in pushing the boundaries of offensive security. Our team consists of passionate and humble professionals who value creativity, technical depth and delivering results that matter.

Ready to join the Swarm?

Take the next step in your career by applying today. Let’s talk about how your skills, research mindset and offensive capability align with CovertSwarm’s mission to redefine offensive security.

We are looking for AIConversation Recording Contributors to join an Wolof (Senegal)speech data collection project and help support the evaluation and development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 2–4 hours daily)
Project Duration: TBC
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 10 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to evaluate and improve speech recognition and conversational AI technologies by providing spontaneous speech collected from real-life situations.

How Your Recordings Will Be Used

The collected recordings, annotations, and related metadata will be used to evaluate the spontaneous speech capabilities of speech-enabled AI models. The compiled data may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Record or collect natural, spontaneous speech in accordance with the project guidelines.
  • Participate in or capture speech from approved real-life situations, such as workplace conversations or casual one-on-one discussions.
  • Complete individual or two-person conversational speech tasks, or participate in voice or voice-text interactions with an AI or machine-based system.
  • Annotate collected speech data according to the instructions provided.
  • Provide the required information and metadata related to each recording.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in Wolof (Senegal).
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target language through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording or data annotation projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail when providing annotations and recording metadata.
  • Ability to follow detailed project and recording instructions.

Technical Requirements

  • Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.
RWS embraces DEI and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.
