raw.description:
Growth Marketing Lead (AI-First)

Location: Bangalore-based, remote — working core hours that overlap the US day (our team and customers are US-based)

Engagement: Contract to start, with potential to expand

Reports to: Founder / CEO

About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning builds award-winning learning experiences for young children. Since 2013, we've reached hundreds of thousands of families and thousands of classrooms across North America, with our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bringing STEM and global discovery to life for early learners.

We're now an AI-first company. Our newest product, Miss Audrey AI, puts a proactive AI coach and teaching assistant in the hands of early-childhood educators, supporting teachers in the moment with guidance, resources and family engagement. It opens up a new category in early learning, and we're building the growth engine to bring it to every teacher, centre and early-learning organisation that needs it. This is the role that leads it.

Backed by top-tier investors and running lean, we're looking for a senior, hands-on growth leader who wants to build that engine with AI at its core.

The role in one line

Lead MarcoPolo's growth. Define the story that makes educators and early-learning leaders see Miss Audrey AI as essential, build an AI-powered engine to reach them at scale, and turn that interest into sign-ups, paid subscribers and sales conversations.

This is not a general marketing role

This is not a single-channel role. It isn't only SEO, paid social, content calendars or app installs. Miss Audrey AI is creating a new category, so growth here comes from sharp positioning, smart outreach and constant experimentation rather than capturing existing search demand. We're looking for a strategic generalist who can set the direction, do much of the work hands-on, and bring the team along.

You'll work in a fast-moving, AI-first startup where AI is built into how marketing gets done, from research and outreach to creative, testing and reporting. You'll be the person who knows which tools are worth using, puts them to work, and keeps raising the bar on what our growth engine can do.

What you'll own

Positioning and messaging. Shape how we talk to teachers, centre directors and early-learning leaders. Test messaging angles quickly, learn from the results and sharpen the story until it consistently converts.

An AI-powered growth engine. Design and run AI-driven workflows for audience research, prospect enrichment, personalised outreach across email, LinkedIn and other channels, creative, landing pages and reporting. Review the output, refine it and keep improving it.

The Miss Audrey AI funnel. Take educators from free sign-up to first value to paid subscription, working with engineering on onboarding, upgrade moments and lifecycle messaging.

Pipeline for our sales team. Turn campaigns and product usage into qualified conversations with centre directors and organisation leaders, and equip our US sales team with the messaging and evidence to close.

The experiment loop. Decide what to test across audiences, messages, channels and offers; read the results; and double down on what works.

Tools and innovation. Stay ahead of the AI marketing landscape. Evaluate new tools, adopt the ones that move the needle, and help the wider team use them.

Leadership and communication. Present plans and results to leadership, explain the approach clearly to the team, direct freelancers and partners, and help build the function as it grows.

Report the numbers that matter. Pipeline, sign-ups, activation, paid conversion and cost to acquire, with a clear point of view on what to do next.

Expected outcomes

You'll be measured on results, not activity:

  • Messaging: a clear, tested value proposition that resonates with teachers, centre directors and early-learning leaders.
  • Growth engine: a live, AI-powered acquisition and outreach engine producing a steady flow of qualified sign-ups and conversations.
  • Conversion: a measurable and improving free-to-paid conversion rate for Miss Audrey AI.
  • Sales pipeline: a reliable flow of qualified opportunities handed to the US sales team.
  • Experimentation: a regular testing cadence across messaging, channels and offers, with results that compound.
  • Capability: new AI tools and workflows adopted across marketing, and a clear plan for how the function scales.

What you'll need (essential)

  • 7+ years in growth or marketing across strategy, positioning and messaging, demand generation, lifecycle and experimentation. You're a generalist with real breadth, not a single-channel specialist.
  • Leadership experience. You've owned a growth or marketing function, or a major part of one: setting strategy, directing people, agencies or freelancers, and working closely with founders or senior leadership.
  • AI-first in practice. You use AI tools daily in your marketing work and can show workflows you've built and deployed. You keep up with the AI marketing landscape and know which tools are worth using.
  • Experience building demand for a new or differentiated product, where you shaped the story and made the case rather than capturing existing demand.
  • A confident, clear communicator, with excellent spoken and written English. You're comfortable presenting to leadership, working with a US-based team and customers, and explaining strategy simply.
  • Data and experimentation fluency. Comfortable setting up measurement, reading funnel and campaign data, and running clean experiments.
  • Startup pace and self-direction. You ask the right questions, propose a plan and execute with minimal oversight in a fast-changing environment.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience marketing to educators, schools, childcare or early-learning organisations, or to individual users within larger organisations.
  • Freemium or product-led growth experience, converting free users into paying subscribers.
  • Experience working with or for a US-based company while based in India; you understand US customers, US working styles and collaborating across time zones.
  • Prior startup experience: you know what it's like to build with limited resources and moving goalposts.

Nice to have

  • EdTech, or any product sold to educators, parents or consumers.
  • Familiarity with tools already in use here, including HubSpot, Customer.io, n8n, ClickUp and Webflow, and with AI-driven prospecting and outreach tools.
  • Enough design sense to shape clean, conversion-focused web and email flows (you don't need to be a visual designer).

Engagement details

  • Type: Contract to start, with potential to expand as the growth engine proves out.
  • Location & hours: Bangalore-based and remote, with daily working overlap with our US team.
  • Works closely with: The US sales team and AI-automation partners who support the technical build.
  • Start: Immediate start preferred.

raw.title: Director, Customer Success
raw.excerpt: About ArmorCodeArmorCode delivers the Agentic Control Plane for Unified Exposure Management.
raw.description:
About ArmorCode

ArmorCode delivers the Agentic Control Plane for Unified Exposure Management. The ArmorCode platform ingests findings from 400+ security tools, correlates them with business context in the Context Risk Graph, and puts Anya AI agents to work prioritizing, routing, and verifying fixes. Enterprises including Visa, PayPal, Volvo Group, and Johnson Controls use ArmorCode to remediate at machine speed and reduce risk fast.

Processing over 400 billion+ findings a year across hundreds of native integrations, ArmorCode unifies, prioritizes, and drives remediation across applications, cloud, code, infrastructure, and AI. Powered by Anya, the industry's first agentic AI framework for enterprise security, ArmorCode is trusted by global enterprises to reduce exposure and adopt AI and modern software practices with confidence, without replacing existing tools or forcing vendor consolidation.

ArmorCoders believe in five core values: Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. Human. Our organization is powered by exceptional professionals who bring fresh ideas and passion to their roles, believing that nothing is beyond reach when our "5H" principles are applied. In their work and professional relationships, ArmorCoders commit to excellence and experiences that leave an impression.

About the Role

As Director, Customer Success, you will own the end-to-end customer journey for ArmorCode's enterprise security customers — from onboarding and adoption through renewal, expansion, and advocacy. You'll lead a global organization spanning Customer Success (US and India), setting the strategy, playbooks, and operational rigor that turn customers into long-term partners and champions of the ArmorCode platform. You will bring an AI-first mindset to the role, leveraging automation and AI-driven insights to proactively engage customers, accelerate adoption, and uncover expansion opportunities.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, scale-up environment and is equally comfortable setting strategy with the C-suite and rolling up their sleeves on the details that drive GRR, NRR, and customer trust.

What You'll Own

Customer Retention & Growth

  • Own and improve GRR and NRR, setting clear playbooks and KPIs.
  • Partner with Sales on expansion and renewal strategy, driving upsell and cross-sell motions.
  • Design and execute proactive engagement strategies to identify and capitalize on expansion opportunities early in the customer lifecycle.
  • Establish C-level engagement frameworks to ensure customers view ArmorCode as a strategic partner.

Customer Success Management

  • Own the global Customer Success strategy and operations, ensuring world-class responsiveness, resolution times, and customer satisfaction.
  • Define and track SLAs (first response, time-to-resolution, backlog management) and ensure performance meets or exceeds benchmarks.
  • Implement scalable support models (tiered support, self-service, knowledge base, AI/automation).
  • Build escalation paths that ensure seamless collaboration between Support, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  • Drive continuous improvement by analyzing support tickets to identify systemic issues and feeding insights into Product and CS.
  • Drive operational excellence in ticket resolution efficiency and turnaround time, continuously identifying opportunities to improve.

Customer Onboarding and Training

  • Develop scalable onboarding and adoption programs that ensure time-to-value and deepen product usage.
  • Develop the training and adoption strategy for customers.

Product Adoption and Value Realization

  • Develop and implement a product communication cadence and strategy, keeping clients updated on product updates, cybersecurity trends, and industry insights.
  • Drive new feature adoption and manage release planning alongside Engineering and Product.
  • Define metrics and dashboards to monitor adoption health across accounts.
  • Utilize customer data and analytics to assess customer behavior, usage patterns, and overall satisfaction, building the right adoption and product-usage dashboards.
  • Spearhead proactive adoption campaigns, utilizing predictive modeling and AI-driven alerts to intervene before churn risks materialize.

Customer Advocacy and Community

  • Build formal advocacy programs — advisory boards, case studies, references, and peer communities.
  • Ensure customers become champions within their industries and referenceable for new sales opportunities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the voice of the customer to executive leadership, influencing product, sales, and marketing strategy.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities based on customer needs and adoption blockers.
  • Drive product roadmap through a mix of customer support data analytics and customer feedback loops.
  • Work with Finance to forecast retention and expansion revenue.
  • Partner with Marketing on advocacy.

Team Leadership

  • Lead a team of Customer Success team members (US and India).
  • Ensure a motivated, collaborative, and well-connected team across continents.
  • Create repeatable processes for enterprise account management, QBRs, and executive engagement.
  • Champion an AI-first mindset within the team, training and enabling CSMs to leverage AI tools and methodologies for improved efficiency and customer outcomes.

Who You Are

Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum 15+ years in Enterprise Customer Success, of which at least 10+ years are in a SaaS environment.
  • Proven experience in a customer success leadership role within the technology or cybersecurity industry, preferably with exposure to large enterprise accounts and complex customer landscapes.
  • Experience managing Customer Success or similar organizations in an enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Experience scaling CS organizations in $25M–$100M ARR companies.
  • Proven success driving GRR and NRR in enterprise SaaS with ACVs greater than $100K.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing AI approaches or AI-driven tooling (e.g., predictive analytics, automated workflows, LLM-assisted communication) within a Customer Success organization.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage C-level stakeholders at Fortune 1000 companies.
  • Deep understanding of customer lifecycle management, renewal, and expansion motions, with a heavy focus on proactive strategies.
  • Strong process optimization and operational rigor across customer engagement workflows, escalation processes, knowledge base, and self-service adoption strategy.
  • Track record of building high-performing teams and creating scalable processes.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.

Skills

  • A hands-on and entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable working in a startup/scale-up environment.
  • Data-driven leader with experience using CS platforms (Gainsight, Vitally, etc.).
  • Demonstrated success in upselling, driving customer growth, and achieving revenue targets.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of engaging with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to break down data, identify patterns, and derive actionable insights.
  • Understanding of customer success operations tooling (Gainsight, Vitally, Salesforce, AI-driven adoption platforms).
  • Highly AI literate: Understands the capabilities, limitations, and practical applications of generative AI and machine learning in a B2B SaaS context.

Personality Traits

Detail-oriented and intellectually curious, with a natural instinct for building relationships. You operate as a true player-coach with a problem-solving mindset and strategic thinking, and you bring the resilience to manage conflict effectively. You possess an AI-first mindset, constantly seeking ways to augment human capabilities and optimize processes through technology.

Why You'll Love It

  • Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and provide career progression paths, enabling our employees to advance in their careers.
  • Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance, offering flexible hours and remote work options to promote a sustainable lifestyle.
  • Collaborative Environment: Our company fosters a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture, where employees can collaborate and learn from each other's experiences.
  • Employee Recognition: We value and recognize the contributions of our team members through awards, employee of the month programs, and other forms of acknowledgment.
  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses, recognizing and rewarding the hard work and dedication of our team.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health insurance for employees and dependents, to support the overall well-being of our employees. We encourage learning and skilling, and aid our employees to continuously upskill themselves.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: We are committed to diversity and inclusion, striving to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.

Join ArmorCode and lead the charge in reducing signal fatigue, prioritizing risk and streamlining key cybersecurity workflows. Apply today to be part of a close-knit team, dedicated to democratizing software security and helping build the safest software possible.

Equal Opportunity

ArmorCode is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or any other legally protected category. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background or characteristics. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

raw.title: Campaign Manager
raw.excerpt: At the Craft&Crew group of companies, we're committed to delivering outstanding results through innovative paid media strategies.
raw.description:
At the Craft&Crew group of companies, we're committed to delivering outstanding results through innovative paid media strategies. Our Campaign Managers expertly guide and optimize paid advertising campaigns for our clients, act as a strategic marketing and technology advisor, leverage their deep understanding of marketing and paid media to identify opportunities, solve problems proactively, and drive measurable success.

Objectives of this role

  • Serve as a key contact for clients, implementing and optimizing paid media strategies aligned with their organizational goals.
  • Provide clients with insights into campaign performance, helping them understand opportunities and challenges to improve their return on investment.
  • Manage the setup, ongoing management, and continuous optimization of paid campaigns across major digital advertising platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure integrated strategies that deliver cohesive, effective client solutions.
  • Learn about and test new technologies and vendors to enhance campaign performance and add value for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, build, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns on platforms including Google Ads, DV360, Bing, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Twitter.
  • Measure and analyze campaign performance, preparing insightful reports that highlight outcomes, trends, and optimization recommendations.
  • Develop and deliver both routine and ad-hoc reporting, clearly communicating results and strategic recommendations to clients.
  • Research and test new digital media platforms, partnerships, and tools to improve campaign effectiveness and performance.
  • Contribute to refining internal processes, tools, and workflows, promoting operational efficiency and effectiveness
  • Support the QA process
  • Support AI-based services and initiatives
  • Support ancillary services with new and existing clients
  • Collaborate with team members by sharing best practices in paid campaign execution and optimization.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned

Required skills and qualifications

  • 2-3 years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid digital marketing campaigns.
  • Solid knowledge and experience with digital advertising platforms, including Google Ads, DV360, Bing, Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in campaign measurement, reporting, and optimization techniques.
  • Excellent client management and communication skills, able to translate complex digital media insights into clear, actionable strategies.
  • Proven track record of driving measurable results and campaign improvement through data-driven optimization.

Preferred skills and qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, digital media, or related fields.
  • Agency or similar fast-paced digital marketing environment experience.
  • Certifications from leading digital marketing platforms, such as Google Ads, Meta, or DV360.
  • Experience implementing A/B testing and multi-channel optimization strategies.

While we are not actively hiring for this position today, we are growing steadily and expect to expand our team in the coming months. We’re always interested in meeting talented individuals who share our values and expertise. If you’re a great fit, we’d love to keep your information on file for future opportunities as we scale.

Craft&Crew is a remote-first company, but we require all staff to attend certain annual events and meetings in person. Candidates must already be located in Canada, ideally in Ottawa, Montreal, or Toronto.

Salary: $70,000 - $90,000

raw.description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK.

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively.

Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades.

That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver.

You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions.

You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it.

How we work

We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty.

We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions.

You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them.

You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something.

And you'll make the team's thinking visible - explaining what we're trying to achieve, what we've learned, what we're uncertain about and why we're making the choices we are.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll:

  • Understand the problem. Build a deep understanding of our users, their needs and behaviours, as well as the organisational, operational and technical context surrounding them.
  • Shape product direction. Work out where the greatest opportunities lie within your area and help translate PLOS's objectives into clear product outcomes and priorities.
  • Practise continuous discovery. Work closely with design, engineering and others to explore problems, identify assumptions and regularly test ideas with users and through data.
  • Turn uncertainty into learning. Frame hypotheses, design useful experiments and look for the smallest sensible way to learn whether we're heading in the right direction.
  • Make good product decisions. Weigh evidence, impact, effort, risk and opportunity when deciding what to pursue - and what not to pursue.
  • Measure whether things are getting better. Define useful measures of success and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand whether our work is having the intended effect.
  • Work iteratively. Help the team deliver in small steps, learn from what happens and adapt rather than treating plans as fixed commitments.
  • Communicate your thinking. Clearly explain problems, evidence, choices, trade-offs and learning to people with very different levels of technical and product knowledge.
  • Create strong feedback loops. Use conversations, demos, reviews and other forums to get useful feedback early rather than presenting finished thinking late.
  • Work as part of a team. Create the conditions in which designers, engineers and other specialists can contribute to product decisions rather than treating product management as something the PM does alone.
  • Look beyond the product interface. Understand the wider service, including processes, systems and teams around it, and recognise when solving a user problem requires changing more than software.

Experience and qualifications

Essential

  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent professional experience. 
  • Using creative problem solving to build software solutions.
  • Demonstrate experience working as a Product Manager in a multidisciplinary digital product team, working closely with disciplines such as design, engineering, research and delivery.
  • Experience using product discovery alongside delivery - for example, user research, data, experimentation and hypothesis testing - to understand problems and inform what a team should do next.
  • Experience working with significant uncertainty or ambiguity: identifying what is known, what is assumed and what needs to be learned before making larger commitments.
  • Experience taking complex problems and helping a team turn them into clear priorities, outcomes and practical next steps.
  • Experience making product decisions using a combination of user evidence, data, organisational goals, technical constraints and product judgement.
  • Experience communicating product thinking clearly to a wide range of people, including explaining evidence, uncertainty, trade-offs and why particular decisions have been made.
  • Experience working collaboratively with people outside the immediate product team, particularly where different groups have different needs, incentives or perspectives.

Particularly useful

We'd be especially interested in candidates who have experience of one or more of the following:

  • Working in an organisation going through significant product, digital or organisational transformation.
  • Working in complex service environments where improving the user experience involves changes to technology, operations, policy or organisational processes - not simply changing an interface.
  • Helping teams move towards more iterative, outcome-focused or evidence-led ways of working.
  • Working in a mission-led, research, publishing, education, scientific or other knowledge-based organisation.

Experience of scholarly publishing is useful but isn't required.

What we're looking for in a Senior Product Manager

For us, seniority isn't about having a larger backlog or knowing more product framework: it's about judgement.

You'll be able to take a complex and uncertain problem, help people understand it, decide what we most need to learn, bring a team together around a sensible course of action and change that course when the evidence tells us to.

You'll be comfortable making decisions without perfect information while being clear about the assumptions and risks involved.

And you'll help the people around you think more clearly about the product - not simply tell them what to build.

Working at PLOS

You'll join PLOS's Product team and work collaboratively with colleagues across Digital and the wider organisation.

The role has no direct line-management responsibility.

The job is fully remote. Some flexibility to work across time zones and occasional national or international travel may be required.

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (UK) £65,000 - £73,500. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below.

BENEFITS:

  • Private medical insurance
  • Life assurance
  • Income protection 
  • Personal accident insurance
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out.

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all.

Visit to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Sword Health is a multi-product commercial organization selling across the employer and health plan markets. The Director of Revenue Operations leads the team that keeps the revenue engine accurate, fast and scalable: CRM and systems, pipeline and forecasting, deal desk and contracting, and commercial reporting. You manage a small senior team and are the go-to partner for sales leadership on how we plan, sell and close. The right person has built RevOps in a complex enterprise sale, is comfortable in the Salesforce admin console and in front of the CRO, and treats process as a product.

  • Track record of building forecasting and pipeline management processes that sales leaders actually use

  • Strong analytical skills (SQL or BI tools a plus) and the judgement to know which numbers matter
  • Experience with CPQ/CLM tools (Ironclad, Spotdraft or equivalent) and Gong

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our team. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and support the data and software solutions that power clinical research and help advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in data integration, software product development, and clinical trial information sharing.


You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to solutions from design through live deployment. Responsibilities include building extract, transform, and load (ETL) programs and workflows in Databricks, developing technical specifications for data loading rules, architecting software products and customer-specific extensions, and mentoring Software Engineers, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence how clinical data is shared.

  • Support technical consulting activities for clients in the pharmaceutical industry
  • Design and support clinical trial information sharing solutions
  • Provide application support for existing products
  • Support release management using versioning tools such as Azure DevOps Git and execute live deployments

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in data analysis, data modeling, database design, and software development

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in technical discipline (Mathematics, Science, Engineering, Computing, etc.) or a related study, or equivalent project-related experience
  • Proven relevant experience in systems integration and implementation, or software development, or a related discipline
  • Demonstrated ability to liaise with multiple stakeholders
  • 5+ years of experience with Microsoft Azure components, in particular Azure SQL, Azure Databricks, and Azure Data Factory
  • Experience implementing ETL solutions, particularly using Databricks
  • Strong database development skills, particularly implementing SQL solutions in Azure SQL or Databricks environments, with good experience working with large datasets
  • Experience improving data quality in data warehouses
  • Experience testing ETL solutions, particularly using Genie and MS Copilot
  • Experience using enterprise architecture modeling tools, frameworks, and methodologies such as TOGAF, SPARX EA, UML (Unified Modeling Language), BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation), and ArchiMate
  • Experience designing data warehouses, applying Kimball's dimensional modeling techniques, and architecting ETL systems

  • Experience debugging complex software systems
  • Significant experience implementing data-driven systems with large-scale relational or object-oriented databases

raw.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit is a complex consumer ecosystem where users, content, communities, and conversations interact over time. We are looking for a very senior data science thought leader to shape how Reddit understands and improves that ecosystem for the user / consumer flywheel.

This role will define the measurement, modeling, and experimentation strategy for major Consumer questions: how users discover value, form habits, and deepen engagement; how we understand and serve user intent; how content and communities evolve; and how our systems create durable value for users, contributors, communities, and Reddit.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in one or more areas of consumer science, such as:

  • Recommender systems and information retrieval
  • User modeling, personalization, lifecycle, LTV, or optimization
  • Content, community, or ecosystem modeling
  • Knowledge graphs and representations of users, content, and communities
  • Causal inference, experimentation, and long-term consumer measurement

You will partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, Research, and Community to turn ambiguous consumer problems into clear scientific questions, durable analytical systems, and decisions that improve Reddit at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Set the scientific direction for high-impact Consumer problems spanning discovery, relevance, personalization, user growth, retention, content, and communities.
  • Build a durable understanding of users, their intent, their needs, and the behaviors that lead to lasting value
  • Develop models and frameworks that represent users, content, communities, and their relationships over time for use in systems that operate at scale
  • Determine how to measure consumer and ecosystem health when objectives compete and short-term engagement may differ from long-term value.
  • Set learning agendas and steer experimentation strategy to distinguish durable improvement from temporary metric movement.
  • Build state-of-the-art measurement systems to evaluate heterogeneous effects across user personas, acquisition cohorts, platforms, content types, and community stages, and guide their actionability in production environments
  • Ensure coherence around ecosystem interactions including feedback loops, selection effects, interference, distribution shift, content supply, and other ecosystem risks.
  • Translate complex technical findings into clear product and business decisions.
  • Develop exceptional scientists through mentoring and influence data science org health and direction

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in at least one relevant area, with the breadth and curiosity to work across adjacent domains.
  • A deep understanding of how to model and optimize systems involving users, content, communities, and feedback loops.
  • Ability to frame and lead the most ambiguous questions, identify the most important uncertainties, and develop a rigorous path from evidence to action.
  • Exceptional technical judgment across model design, objective selection, validation, experimentation, and production tradeoffs.
  • Advanced knowledge of modern machine-learning methods for behavioral and content data, including representation learning and sequential or contextual models. Experience with deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.
  • Experience working across Product, Engineering, Research, and other partner teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain technical ideas clearly.
  • Significant experience applying data science, machine learning, statistics, experimentation, or causal inference to complex consumer products.

Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. Real ownership from day one, not check-ins and micromanagement. That's what the VP of Client Servicesrole at Nortal looks like.

What working with us looks like

  • Remote work with a LATAM team. Coffee breaks, tech talks, and games keep it human, even at a distance.
  • No micromanagement. We hire for autonomy and expect you to use it.
  • Support beyond the job. Our People Care team helps with time off, wellness, and anything in between.

What you get

  • Competitive USD salary.
  • Full remote work, with coworking spaces across LATAM if you want to meet the team in person.

  • Sick leave, no stress attached.
  • A yearly refundable credit. Spend it on anything related to your health and well-being.

About this search

Great talent doesn't wait for job postings, so we don't either. We're building a network of skilled professionals for roles that come up regularly with our clients.

Join our Future Talent network and you'll be one of the first people we reach when the right opening appears. We make around 160 hires a year, so it happens often.

The role

As a VP of Client Services, you will own and grow our portfolio of US clients by 10–15%+ every year. You'll lead a team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs), be the senior relationship holder for our clients' leaders, and own the portfolio's revenue forecast and margin.

Your day-to-day:

Grow the US portfolio

  • Manage our portfolio of US clients and grow each account to $20M+ in annual revenue.
  • Spot growth potential across the current portfolio: new business units, new stakeholders, and new service lines we can sell to clients we already serve.
  • Build a yearly growth plan per account: where we'll expand, what's at risk, and what we'll do about both.
  • Lead renewals, contract extensions, and rate negotiations.

Lead the Client Success team

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of CSMs so they hit their account growth targets.
  • Set clear goals per CSM and account, and review progress every month.
  • Raise the bar on how the team plans accounts, runs business reviews, and works in the CRM.

Build a network inside our clients

  • Build trusted relationships with client executives, from IT leaders to the C-suite.
  • Map each client's organization and widen our network beyond our first contacts.
  • Keep in touch with contacts who change companies, and turn those moves into new opportunities and referrals.

Protect service quality

  • Work with Delivery and Technology to make sure we deliver with quality and sell what we can deliver well.
  • Step in early when a client is unhappy, and stay until the problem is fixed.
  • Run quarterly business reviews that show the value we delivered and agree on what comes next.

Own the numbers

  • Own the portfolio's revenue forecast, and explain any gap before it becomes a surprise.
  • Track margin per project and account, and act when it slips.
  • Work with Finance on monthly forecasting, budget, and pricing decisions.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ Years in a similar client services, account leadership, or client success leadership role at a technology company (IT services, software engineering services, or digital consulting).
  • A record of growing an existing client portfolio, with direct ownership of revenue targets.
  • Experience leading a team
  • Experience managing US enterprise clients from LATAM, with nearshore or global delivery teams.
  • Solid financial skills: revenue forecasting, project margin, P&L, pricing, and contract negotiation.
  • A genuinely social profile: you enjoy meeting people, building relationships, and keeping them over time.
  • Availability to travel regularly to the United States.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons. 

How the process works

  1. Apply and upload your resume.
  1. We review your profile and add it to our talent database.
  1. We reach out for an interview to learn about your experience and share more about what we're looking for.
  1. When a role opens that fits, we contact you to start the process. Because we already know you, it moves faster.
  1. No intermediaries. You deal with us directly.

About Nortal

For over 25 years, we've built the systems that global enterprises and public institutions run on. Today, that means using AI and data to help organizations make better decisions, not just build what they asked for.

We believe good solutions don't have to be complicated. That's why our clients trust us with the initiatives that matter most.

Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. If that's what you're after, apply now. 👇

Logistics at full potential.

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

You’ve built an impressive career, and now you’re looking for the next logical step. As the Director, Data Center Implementations Program Management you will lead the Avengers Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) teams, driving operational excellence and technical standardization across all Data Centers, Warehouses, and enterprise Training & Onboarding functions.

This role is responsible for overseeing complex technical builds, core warehouse processes, and scalable training frameworks to ensure maximum workforce readiness, execution consistency, and strict compliance with Standard Work Instructions (SWI).

This role is open to candidates based remotely anywhere in the US.

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and the opportunity to participate in a company incentive program.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

  • Lead the development of effective growth strategies for the supply chain; drive new account growth through effective solutions development
  • Build and improve strategic relationships with the client’s senior management team
  • Ensure annual profit, efficiency and quality goals are attained at each client engagement
  • Develop short-range and long-range plans and goals for the organization; ensure VOC/VOM KPIs are meaningful, aligned and achieved regularly

raw.description:
What you’ll do

  • Design interactive data visualizations for the corporate website, primarily using Highcharts.
  • Design custom scroll-based animations, including scrubbed, triggered, and pinned scroll behaviors, along with parallax effects and microinteractions.
  • Create production-ready Figma designs at the client’s responsive breakpoints (1440, 1200, 992, 768, and 375px), using the client’s design system.
  • Build functional, inspectable prototypes in HTML/CSS/JavaScript or in tools such as Figma Make, Framer, or Webflow that clearly show scroll behavior and the entry and exit states for each scene.
  • Write clear animation specifications for engineering, documenting the motion system, trigger points, scene-by-scene start and end states, durations, scroll distances, and easing.
  • Partner with the client’s internal engineering team through handoff and implementation.
  • Help estimate project timelines and level of effort as the work takes shape.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in interactive, motion, or web design, with a portfolio of live scroll-driven and interactive web experiences.
  • Strong front-end prototyping skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Hands-on experience with web animation libraries such as GSAP/ScrollTrigger, or similar.
  • Experience designing interactive data visualizations or charts for the web.
  • Expert-level Figma skills and experience working within an established design system.
  • A solid understanding of performance-conscious and accessible animation, including reduced-motion preferences, frame rate, and layout stability.
  • Experience handing off motion work to engineering teams with clear, detailed documentation.
  • Comfort working independently and remotely on a flexible, project-based schedule.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on Highcharts experience or experience with other charting libraries (D3.js, Chart.js).
  • Experience with Lottie, Rive, or other web animation formats.
  • Experience with financial services, corporate, or investor-facing websites.
  • Experience prototyping in Figma Make, Framer, or Webflow interactions.

We Are Rosie provides strategic consulting and talent solutions for the marketing industry. Our company has been recognized as an industry trailblazer and earned many accolades, including being named to the 2023 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces, the Inc. 5000 2022, and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Agencies in 2021.

We Are Rosie is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, marital status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Our client, a global alternative asset manager, is looking for a freelance interactive motion designer with front-end prototyping skills to help bring its corporate website to life. Client Success Manager

We are continually growing and are always interested in connecting with exceptional talent. This posting is intended to help us build a pipeline of qualified candidates for anticipated future openings. While there may not be an immediate vacancy, candidates who align with our needs may be contacted as opportunities arise.


Please note - this position is fully remote in the United States. Candidates in the Eastern and Central Time Zones are preferred. Annual on-target earnings are ~130 - 140K USD (base + bonus).


Interested in a career that bridges the gap between Supply Chain and Technology?


Elemica, a global leader in digital supply chain automation, is seeking experienced Client Success Manager to grow our business and strengthen our partnerships with existing top enterprise clients. This is an opportunity to join a growing company of talented and committed individuals, unified in the common goal of exceeding our client’s expectations.


Our Values

At Elemica, we believe that embodying our values is essential for all team members. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community:

  • Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them
  • Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners
  • Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently.
  • Passion – We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chain

What’s In It For You?

  • Work for the global industry leading digital supply network where the executive team is focused on driving client success
  • Join a high-functioning, collaborative team, where you can play an important role in growing the company
  • Work with an innovative product that drives significant value for clients
  • Apply emerging best practices that will accelerate your career
  • Cutting-edge supply chain technology and innovation
  • Flexible work locations
  • Competitive compensation packages
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and careers
  • Personal and pet insurance options
  • Flexible time off and paid holidays
  • 401k and bonus program
  • Wellness and mental health initiatives
  • Generous employee referral bonus program
  • Fun work environment

Responsibilities & Objectives

Elemica’s Client Success Managers are integral to our success and serve as trusted, dedicated advisors to our loyal clients, helping them to achieve success.


They will:

  • Measure, analyze, and increase customer health and value indicators such as utilization/consumption rates (leading and KPI)
  • Execute on Value Realization Plans and ensure Elemica clients achieve their value expectations within the agreed upon timeline
  • Monitor client satisfaction and proactively take action to maintain high levels of satisfaction
  • Identifying and referring cross-sell and up-sell opportunities
  • Ensure that Elemica retains clients at industry leading rates
  • Provide operational feedback loop to ensure that the organization understands how to change to increase retention

What You’ll Do

  • Develop uniquely strong customer loyalty; low-to-no customer attrition; customer executive contacts will go to bat for him/her; generate repeat business more than peers; maintain a book of business has high customer satisfaction/NPS scores relative to peers; partner with Success & Sales to position clients for success, deliver presentations, engage executives, and assist with escalations
  • Determine root cause of internal and external problems; develop solutions; oversee and help achieve resolution; ensure problems do not re-occur (learning from failure); leverage the management technique of failure-based evidence and apply those lessons
  • Maintain deep industry pand customer knowledge; know customer workflows and how they integrate into Elemica tools; solid knowledge of business and ability to proactively keep current on industry trends
  • Possess the ability to drive change with clients; create a coalition of both buyer and user personas; help create urgency to increase customer utilization of the solution
  • Proactively and consistently demonstrate to the customer the value and benefits of partnering with Elemica, ensuring the relationship is viewed by the customer as indispensable and irreplaceable
  • Gain customer loyalty; drive utilization/consumption rates; possess personal connections with accounts; asks for references and approval of case studies; identifies training opportunities and ensures customer is aware of new product features; prevent customer attrition; generate repeat business; expand the breadth and depth of existing pipeline opportunities; learn about our customers’ definition of value, challenges, persona roles, and business partners
  • Adopt company policies; utilize CRM system; adhere to opportunity management process; understand customer success and sales methodologies; define and manage handoffs with other Elemica departments and clients; measure process output; provide specific governance and guidance around process adherence; collaborate and align very effectively with leadership in Customer Success, Sales, Consulting, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cross-functional integration of processes and services; best practices and innovation in demonstrating measurable value, onboarding, and operationalizing the customer lifecycle
  • Budget time and money and effectively manages budget; manage meeting commitments; handles prioritization conflicts
  • Motivate supporters and overcome opposition of detractors within customer organizations; maintain good-will from all parties after resolution of conflicts

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, and/or Sales, preferably in a SaaS company
  • Demonstrated ability to drive customer adoption
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Collaborative problem solver who takes ownership of issues and drives to resolution
  • Knowledge of Logistics/Supply Chain function preferred
  • Ability to analyze data and convey actionable insights to executives
  • Willing and able to travel up to 30%
  • Proven accountability and excellent interpersonal skills; the confidence to be an honest advocate who is willing to speak up when needed
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with ability to get to the root cause of internal and external problems; ability to recommend resolutions
  • Must respond to client requests with empathy, compassion, strategic advisement, and rapidity
  • Desire to work with a collaborative global team with offices in the USA, Germany, UK, Netherlands, and India

Who We Are

Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually.


It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Using best practices in these areas, all Elemica employees will observe a ‘security first’ approach to their daily responsibilities. All employees are accountable for securing their work devices, work areas, and communications in the execution of their daily duties.


Our use of artificial intelligence in hiring

We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our recruitment process. These tools help us manage application volume, but no hiring decision is made by AI alone. Your rights: You have the right to request human review of any AI-assisted assessment of your application. You may also request information about how AI was used in evaluating your candidacy and contest any decision that was influenced by automated processing. To exercise these rights or ask questions about our use of AI in recruitment, contact: .

raw.description:
Overview

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Program Overview

The World Health Organization projects a global shortfall of 11 million health workers by 2030, increasingly concentrated in the African region. This includes a shortage of nearly 900,000 midwives (Nove et al., 2021) and a similar gap in children's nurses, who make up only around 2% of the nursing workforce in several African countries, despite children comprising up to half the population (North et al., 2019). These shortages are closely linked to preventable maternal, newborn, and child deaths and high under-five mortality. WHO Afro modelling estimates that health workers required a $36.3 billion wage bill in 2022, against an available financing envelope of just $20.85 billion—a 43% workforce financing gap across the region's 47 countries. This constrained fiscal space is prompting governments and partners to rethink traditional workforce approaches, including how new technologies, such as AI-enabled tools for training, clinical decision support, and workflow efficiency, can extend the reach and impact of a limited workforce, while keeping health workers and human connection at the centre of care. In May 2026, African governments adopted the Accra Declaration at the Africa Health Workforce Investment Forum, committing to concrete action on planning, training, and retaining the continent's health workforce.

Against this backdrop, a multi-country health workforce initiative is being set up to strengthen the availability, quality, distribution, and retention of primary health care and maternal, newborn, and child health (MNCH) workers across the Africa region. The initiative will support government-led efforts to close these gaps — including shortages in nursing, midwifery, MNCH specialists, allied health cadres, and community health workers — that limit access to quality primary MNCH care.

The initiative will be informed by a country-led planning process, partnering with governments, training institutions, and implementing organizations to strengthen health workforce policy, planning, and financing systems; expand and improve training capacity; support the equitable distribution and retention of health workers; and address gaps in medical equipment and facility infrastructure that limit health worker effectiveness and retention.

A secretariat is being set up at CHAI Ghana to provide technical, programmatic, and financial management assistance to participating governments and partners, including workforce planning and training design, monitoring and evaluation, and alignment with the initiative's technical framework and country priorities.

Position Overview

The Evidence, Learning, and Information Systems Director is responsible for tracking the initiative’s progress against its goals and targets, and for coordinating the overall M&E approach across governments, the Secretariat, and academic/evaluation partners.

During inception, they will design an M&E system that tracks progress of the initiative, while also strengthening countries’ national data systems. During planning, they will advise on information system-related interventions at the country level needed to track progress. They will also ensure that all country-level plans include robust M&E plans mapped to initiative-level targets and indicators. During implementation, they will maintain a dashboard tracking progress against indicators and lead the Secretariat in data-driven course correction when necessary. They will also lead the initiative’s research agenda and learning processes, ensuring that insights from data and lessons from programming are disseminated and applied across the initiative as they emerge. During close-out, they will compile all data and prepare final reports. They will supervise one or more M&E officers – exact roles and team structure will be finalized following the co-creation of the M&E approach.

Responsibilities

Inception

  • Design the initiative’s M&E system with a focus on building government data systems at the country level.
  • Develop the core indicator and data reporting template and contribute to the narrative reporting template.

Country planning

  • Advise on information-systems-related interventions needed at country level.
  • Provide technical guidance on system design and indicator development, including via review of country-level plans.

Implementation

  • Oversee a dashboard tracking progress against indicators and lead the initiative in data-driven course correction when necessary.
  • Manage reporting on progress towards the initiative’s goals.
  • Lead the initiative’s learning processes, ensuring insights from data and program lessons are disseminated and applied across the initiative as they emerge.
  • Coordinate a technical advisory group of leaders in health systems research (drawn from academic institutions, multilaterals, and government) providing strategic and methodological guidance to M&E and research.
  • Engage, as required, and manage contracted academic and evaluation partners executing more in-depth analysis, quasi-experimental studies, and peer-reviewed research.
  • Steward the initiative’s research agenda.

Management

  • Supervise one or more M&E Officer(s).

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of public health experience in planning, project/change management, stakeholder coordination, capacity building, and program performance management.
  • Experience designing and implementing a centralized M&E system from the ground up, including frameworks, tools, and guidelines.
  • Familiarity with government health information systems in sub-Saharan Africa.
  • Experience with M&E capacity building and knowledge management, including training and community-of-practice leadership.
  • Program management experience across health system strengthening initiatives, coordinating with academic research institutions, government ministries, implementing partners, and donors.
  • Experience working as an academic researcher or with academic researchers in the public health field.
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field.
  • In-depth knowledge of health workforce and health systems programming in East, West, and/or Southern Africa.
  • Technical and programmatic experience in health workforce, financing, systems, PHC, and MNCH, including measurement and data use in these areas.
  • Experience working with private philanthropies, engaged boards, and donor reporting.
  • Lived experience, extensive knowledge, and understanding of the cultural, political, and economic context in African countries.
  • Ability to inspire, motivate, and manage a diverse and geographically dispersed team.
  • Willingness to travel regularly internationally.
  • English fluency required.
  • Working French or Portuguese is an advantage.

raw.title: VP, Content Expert, Market Access
raw.excerpt: This role leads market access strategy through a population-based decision maker (PBDM) lens across multiple biopharma clients.
raw.description:
This role leads market access strategy through a population-based decision maker (PBDM) lens across multiple biopharma clients. The scope extends beyond traditional payer strategy to include channel and patient services strategy, shaping how therapies are positioned, accessed, and supported across payer, provider, specialty distribution, and patient support ecosystems.

The VP, Market Access Strategy translates market access insights into integrated, system-level strategies that influence coverage, reimbursement, channel design, and post-prescription access and affordability. This includes advancing approaches across payer and organized customer strategy, specialty pharmacy and distribution models, and patient services and HUB programs.

Partnering closely with Medical, Client Services, and cross-functional strategy leaders, this role defines access strategy at the product and portfolio level, ensuring recommendations align to real-world healthcare system dynamics and drive measurable access outcomes. The role also contributes to business growth, team leadership, and the continued evolution of market access offerings across the organization.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead population-based market access strategy, integrating payer, provider, and health system perspectives into cohesive client recommendations
  • Architect decision maker engagement strategies that shape access across payer organizations, IDNs, and other organized customers
  • Translate healthcare policy, reimbursement trends, and stakeholder dynamics into forward-looking strategic frameworks and content platforms
  • Define and evolve payer and population health narratives, value propositions, and access strategies across product lifecycles and portfolios
  • Serve as a senior advisor to clients, guiding enterprise-level access strategy and ensuring alignment to real-world decision-making environments
  • Build and maintain senior client relationships, influencing direction and ensuring delivery of high-impact, insight-driven work
  • Mentor team members and contribute to account growth, new business, and the evolution of integrated market access capabilities

Required:

  • 8- 12 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotech market access, with leadership in payer and population-based strategy
  • Demonstrated ability to shape access strategy across multiple stakeholder types (payers, providers, IDNs, government) with measurable outcomes
  • Deep expertise in U.S. healthcare systems, including how population-level decisions are made, influenced, and operationalized
  • Proven experience leading senior client engagements and driving cross-functional strategy across Strategy, Medical, and Creative teams
  • Strong track record developing strategic frameworks and content platforms that inform value communication and access decisions

Desired:

  • Experience integrating population health, value-based care, or organized customer strategy into market access approaches
  • Advanced degree (MBA, PharmD, MPH, or equivalent) with application to market access or health economics
  • Experience in a healthcare communications or agency environment supporting multiple biopharma clients or portfolios or experience working in biopharma in the market access setting
  • Familiarity with specialty pharmacy, IDNs, and government payer dynamics across therapeutic areas
  • Experience contributing to new business, thought leadership, or innovation in market access strategy
  • Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Klick is consciously creating a culture where everyone can thrive and grow in their careers. We believe that our best work comes from our diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strongly encourage members of historically underrepresented communities to apply, including Black people, Indigenous peoples, and other people of color, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities and people with intersectional identities. We're also committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please contact us at and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs and ensure you have a positive experience.

The Klick Group—comprising Klick Health (including Oxford PharmaGenesis, Klick Katalyst, and btwelve), Klick Media, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), and Klick Consulting—is an ecosystem dedicated help life sciences brands achieve their full potential through best-in-class marketing and advertising, media, medical affairs and communications, market access, real-world evidence, and technology and analytics consulting — powered by 500+ in-house medical experts and award-winning data science and AI capabilities. Founded in 1997, we have offices in Toronto, New York, Oxford, London, Cambridge, Cardiff, Melbourne, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, São Paulo, and Singapore. One of the most-awarded health agencies on the planet, Klick recently made history as Cannes Lions Healthcare Agency of the Year, Healthcare Network of the Year, and Independent Agency of the Year – Health. Klick is also consistently recognized for its people-first culture, including Great Place to Work, Best Workplace for Women, Best Workplace for Inclusion, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and a FORTUNE Best Workplace in Advertising.

About our Market Access Team
The Market Access team, as part of Klick's Medical Craft, partners with life sciences clients to ensure therapies reach the patients who need them. The team delivers payer research, pricing and reimbursement strategy, value communication, and evidence-based insights. Through qualitative and quantitative research, the craft translates complex healthcare and reimbursement dynamics into clear, strategic recommendations. Collaboration across strategy, analytics, and client services is central to how the team operates.

In May 2026, African governments adopted the Accra Declaration at the Africa Health Workforce Investment Forum, committing to concrete action on planning, training, and retaining the continent's health workforce.

Against this backdrop, a multi-country health workforce initiative is being set up to strengthen the availability, quality, distribution, and retention of primary health care and maternal, newborn, and child health (MNCH) workers across the Africa region. The initiative will support government-led efforts to close these gaps — including shortages in nursing, midwifery, MNCH specialists, allied health cadres, and community health workers — that limit access to quality primary MNCH care.

The initiative will be informed by a country-led planning process, partnering with governments, training institutions, and implementing organizations to strengthen health workforce policy, planning, and financing systems; expand and improve training capacity; support the equitable distribution and retention of health workers; and address gaps in medical equipment and facility infrastructure that limit health worker effectiveness and retention.

A secretariat is being set up at CHAI Ghana to provide technical, programmatic, and financial management assistance to participating governments and partners, including workforce planning and training design, monitoring and evaluation, and alignment with the initiative's technical framework and country priorities.

Position Overview

The Evidence, Learning, and Information Systems Director is responsible for tracking the initiative’s progress against its goals and targets, and for coordinating the overall M&E approach across governments, the Secretariat, and academic/evaluation partners.

During inception, they will design an M&E system that tracks progress of the initiative, while also strengthening countries’ national data systems. During planning, they will advise on information system-related interventions at the country level needed to track progress. They will also ensure that all country-level plans include robust M&E plans mapped to initiative-level targets and indicators. During implementation, they will maintain a dashboard tracking progress against indicators and lead the Secretariat in data-driven course correction when necessary. They will also lead the initiative’s research agenda and learning processes, ensuring that insights from data and lessons from programming are disseminated and applied across the initiative as they emerge. During close-out, they will compile all data and prepare final reports. They will supervise one or more M&E officers – exact roles and team structure will be finalized following the co-creation of the M&E approach.

Responsibilities

Inception

  • Design the initiative’s M&E system with a focus on building government data systems at the country level.
  • Develop the core indicator and data reporting template and contribute to the narrative reporting template.

Country planning

  • Advise on information-systems-related interventions needed at country level.
  • Provide technical guidance on system design and indicator development, including via review of country-level plans.

Implementation

  • Oversee a dashboard tracking progress against indicators and lead the initiative in data-driven course correction when necessary.
  • Manage reporting on progress towards the initiative’s goals.
  • Lead the initiative’s learning processes, ensuring insights from data and program lessons are disseminated and applied across the initiative as they emerge.
  • Coordinate a technical advisory group of leaders in health systems research (drawn from academic institutions, multilaterals, and government) providing strategic and methodological guidance to M&E and research.
  • Engage, as required, and manage contracted academic and evaluation partners executing more in-depth analysis, quasi-experimental studies, and peer-reviewed research.
  • Steward the initiative’s research agenda.

Management

  • Supervise one or more M&E Officer(s).

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of public health experience in planning, project/change management, stakeholder coordination, capacity building, and program performance management.
  • Experience designing and implementing a centralized M&E system from the ground up, including frameworks, tools, and guidelines.
  • Familiarity with government health information systems in sub-Saharan Africa.
  • Experience with M&E capacity building and knowledge management, including training and community-of-practice leadership.
  • Program management experience across health system strengthening initiatives, coordinating with academic research institutions, government ministries, implementing partners, and donors.
  • Experience working as an academic researcher or with academic researchers in the public health field.
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field.
  • In-depth knowledge of health workforce and health systems programming in East, West, and/or Southern Africa.
  • Technical and programmatic experience in health workforce, financing, systems, PHC, and MNCH, including measurement and data use in these areas.
  • Experience working with private philanthropies, engaged boards, and donor reporting.
  • Lived experience, extensive knowledge, and understanding of the cultural, political, and economic context in African countries.
  • Ability to inspire, motivate, and manage a diverse and geographically dispersed team.
  • Willingness to travel regularly internationally.
  • English fluency required.
  • Working French or Portuguese is an advantage.
