This posting is for an existing vacancy. While applications are being accepted from candidates across multiple geographic regions across Canada, there is currently one (1) position available.

SUMMARY

Netagen is seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Account Manager to join our team. At Netagen, Account Managers play a visible role in helping clients get lasting value from technology and telecommunications solutions. This position is ideal for a relationship-driven sales professional who wants to own a portfolio, grow trusted client partnerships, and contribute directly to retention, expansion, and long-term customer success.

The Account Manager owns, nurtures, and expands relationships within an assigned portfolio of existing clients. This role focuses on understanding each client’s business priorities, building trusted partnerships, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring clients receive responsive, reliable service. This role also includes a targeted new-customer development component, requiring the Account Manager to build relationships with prospective clients, uncover business needs, and introduce Netagen solutions that create long-term value. Working closely with internal teams, the Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for client inquiries and helps strengthen Netagen’s reputation for long-term partnership, customer satisfaction, and growth.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with assigned clients by understanding their business objectives, operational priorities, and evolving needs.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and client touchpoints to assess satisfaction, strengthen relationships, identify risks, and uncover renewal, retention, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Grow account revenue by identifying and pursuing opportunities that align clients’ needs with Netagen's products and services.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, proactively addressing concerns, resolving issues, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Partner with internal teams, including Operations, Shared Organizational Services, Sales Design, and Sales Support, to coordinate service delivery and develop solutions that meet client requirements.
  • Manage account renewals, contract amendments, and service changes while ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and maintaining accurate account documentation.
  • Maintain current and accurate client, opportunity, pipeline, and activity records within CRM systems; prepare reports and forecasts as required.
  • Monitor client account health, identify potential risks to retention, and implement strategies to strengthen engagement and minimize churn.
  • Stay informed of industry trends, market conditions, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to provide relevant recommendations and insights to clients.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development, training, and industry events to maintain product knowledge and strengthen consultative selling capabilities.
  • Contribute to sales forecasting and business planning activities by maintaining accurate pipeline and account information
  • Achieve or exceed assigned revenue, renewal, and account growth objectives
  • Develop and execute account plans for key clients to support long-term growth, retention, and client success.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • University or College degree in business, marketing, sales or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 3+ years experience in account management, customer success, or inside sales, ideally within the technology or telecommunications industry
  • Bilingualism (English and French) considered an asset
  • Proven track record of maintaining client relationships and achieving sales or retention targets
  • Strong consultative and value-based selling capability, with experience uncovering business challenges, quantifying client impact, and positioning solutions around measurable outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, SPIN Selling, Sandler, or similar qualification and opportunity-management frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new customer opportunities while also expanding existing accounts through renewal, upsell, and cross-sell strategies.
  • Ability to build account plans, map stakeholders and decision processes, identify economic buyers, manage compelling events, and advance opportunities through a disciplined sales cycle.
  • Experience building and managing a qualified pipeline, maintaining accurate CRM data, tracking opportunity stages, and applying consistent next-step discipline.
  • Ability to forecast account growth, renewal risk, and new business opportunities using customer insights, activity metrics, and opportunity qualification criteria.
  • Confident communicator able to engage stakeholders at multiple levels, including technical contacts, business leaders, procurement teams, and executive decision-makers.
  • Skilled at discovery, active listening, objection handling, commercial negotiation, and presenting business cases that connect client needs to clear solution value.
  • Comfortable learning and selling technology, telecommunications, managed services, connectivity, collaboration, or related business solutions to commercial clients.
  • Ability to translate product, service, and market knowledge into client-specific recommendations that support retention, expansion, and long-term customer value.
  • Customer-focused, resilient, and commercially curious, with a proactive approach to solving problems, creating trust, and identifying new ways to help clients succeed.

We are looking for candidates that are serious about their careers and hold a high level of enthusiasm for building a strong successful company, as we do.

ABOUT NETAGEN

Since 2001, evolving from Combat Networks, Netagen has been leading the industry with a unique personalized approach to communication solutions, empowering Businesses and Governments to meet their goals and stay connected to things that matter the most.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base Salary Range: $70,000 - $100,000 annually

The final offer will be based on factors including experience, skills, knowledge, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a performance-based incentive plan.

Netagen also offers:

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development and learning opportunities
  • Comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance.
  • Long-term disability (LTD) insurance.
  • Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) insurance.
  • Paid vacation and personal time

WHY JOIN NETAGEN?

At Netagen, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, client-focused environment where employees are empowered to make an impact, build meaningful relationships, and grow their careers.

As an Account Manager, you will have the opportunity to develop trusted client partnerships, contribute directly to business growth and work alongside experienced technology and telecommunications professionals. You’ll be supported with ongoing learning opportunities, flexible work arrangements, and a performance-driven compensation program that recognizes results.

Whether you’re looking to deepen your sales expertise, expand your industry knowledge, or take the next step in your career, Netagen offers a dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions are valued and your success is recognized.

DIVERSITY EQUITY & INCLUSION

Netagen is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and lived experiences.

Accommodation is available upon request throughout the recruitment, selection, and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate - Spain - Oncology + Hematology - Remote

Job Location: Barcelona, Spain

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Clinical Research Associate at Worldwide

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you’ll play a key role in protecting patient safety, maintaining high-quality clinical data, and ensuring investigative sites deliver studies in line with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), regulatory requirements, protocols, and SOPs.

You’ll take ownership of the full site monitoring lifecycle, from qualification and initiation through interim monitoring, site management, and close-out. You’ll work closely with sites and study teams to strengthen protocol adherence, resolve data queries, maintain essential documentation, and ensure safety information is appropriately reviewed and reported.

You’ll also have the opportunity to bring your experience beyond individual sites, acting as a Lead CRA on global studies, coordinating and mentoring CRAs, contributing to monitoring plans, reviewing visit reports, delivering training, and supporting study milestones.


Where You'll Work

This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across Spain. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 8-10 days per month.


What You'll Do

  • Lead site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, management, and close-out activities, ensuring compliance with protocols, GCP, applicable regulations, and SOPs.
  • Protect patient safety and data integrity by reviewing informed consent and safety information, conducting source document verification, reviewing CRFs, and supporting timely query resolution.
  • Guide sites in protocol adherence, Investigator Site File maintenance, regulatory and ethics documentation, investigational product accountability, and ongoing study requirements.
  • Coordinate CRAs as a Lead CRA on global studies and provide mentoring, training, accompanied visits, and practical guidance to less experienced colleagues and site staff.
  • Partner with Project Management and study teams to evaluate deliverables, study milestones, site performance, and monitoring activities.
  • Develop monitoring plans, study-specific tools, templates, and training materials as requested to support consistent study delivery.
  • Review site visit reports and provide clear feedback and edits while ensuring relevant site documentation is maintained for filing in the Trial Master File.
  • Contribute your clinical monitoring expertise to study team and investigator meetings, bid defenses, and the design of protocols and CRFs.

What You'll Bring

  • Education and CRA experience: an MD or Pharmacy qualification (MSPH, PharmD, PhD, equivalent Pharmacy degree, or similar) with at least 3 years’ CRA experience; or a minimum four-year college curriculum in medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy, or another related science with at least 5 years’ CRA experience; or a two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training, preferably a nursing or equivalent life science degree, with at least 7 years’ CRA experience.
  • Extensive knowledge of clinical research principles and processes, with a thorough understanding of FDA and/or EU regulations and directives, ICH Guidelines, local regulatory requirements, and SOPs.
  • Strong therapeutic-area expertise, with a thorough understanding of two to three therapeutic areas sufficient to operate as a Lead CRA where appropriate.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, planning, organizational, time-management, initiative, and problem-solving skills, alongside the ability to lead and motivate an assigned team when applicable.
  • Technical proficiency with Microsoft Office, IxRS, and electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
  • Experience in full-service monitoring PREFERRED.
  • Valid current passport and driving licence, with willingness to travel as required.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English, together with fluency in the local languages of the countries under responsibility.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

At CapsLock, our core values center around our people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and fostering strong relationships. Our diverse and skilled team speaks 10+ languages and is located worldwide. We are dedicated to pioneering new and efficient marketing strategies to ensure our clients’ success.

﻿Role Description

As a Finance Director at CapsLock, you will be responsible for overseeing all financial aspects of the fast-growing marketing business, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting, and providing strategic guidance to support our business goals. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills and extensive financial expertise.

This role will report to the Chief Finance Officer of the Company.

Requirements

VIBRANT Marketing is a leading North American commercial marketing firm. We bring success to our clients by providing engaging brand experiences and sales solutions capabilities. For leading brands, start-ups, or challengers we help accelerate and/or energize their commercial effort.

We believe in the power of interconnected experience.

VIBRANT tackles the business problems of its clients and partners by enhancing, re-energizing or redefining their brand experience. We are passionate about engagement and conversion. Our expertise is based on its ability to connect live/online events, retail, trade, digital platforms, innovations and all communications in a cohesive business system that promotes engagement and drives value. In the end, we bridge the gap between sales and marketing and help accelerate the commercial roll out of our clients. To support our continued growth in the United States, we are seeking an Account Coordinator to join our Client Services team.

Reporting to the Brand Experience Manager, the Account Coordinator (internally titled Brand Experience Specialist) will help lead the planning, production, and execution of experiential marketing programs in B2B and B2C settings. This role is suited to an agency professional who owns projects or program elements, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is comfortable taking ideas from initial planning through onsite execution.

This remote position is open to candidates who reside and will perform their work in Ohio, Michigan, Illinois, Georgia, Florida, or Tennessee.

Why VIBRANT?

  • Health and benefits coverage
  • Competitive vacation and holiday programs
  • Lucrative employee referral bonus program
  • Collaborative teams with access to support and professional development
  • Work remote and travel across the USA to support activations
  • Career development and advancement opportunities
  • Participation in our Commission for Life program for new business leads
  • Opportunities to work with distinctive brands at events and festivals across the United States
  • A workplace that supports a balanced approach to work and life

What You Will Do

  • Support the planning and delivery of experiential marketing programs across the U.S., including business to business events, trade shows, and brand activations
  • Take ownership of multiple project elements and workstreams from planning through onsite execution and post program reporting
  • Develop project plans, workback schedules, staffing schedules, creative production briefs, and logistical requirements in partnership with the Senior Brand Experience Manager
  • Manage relationships with vendors and suppliers, including securing estimates, negotiating costs, coordinating deliverables, and overseeing production
  • Train, brief, and manage Brand Ambassador and field teams as required
  • Serve as a professional point of contact for clients, partners, vendors, and onsite teams
  • Monitor project spending and support the delivery of programs within approved budgets
  • Identify challenges early and develop practical solutions in a fast-moving environment
  • Contribute to project plans, status updates, recaps, and postmortems
  • Travel to program locations and oversee onsite execution when required

What You Bring

  • Two to three years of experience within a marketing, experiential, events, or integrated agency environment
  • Demonstrated ownership of projects, programs, or substantial workstreams from planning through execution
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment
  • A passion for experiential marketing, with a commitment to staying informed about emerging trends, technologies, and best practices that shape memorable brand experiences.
  • Strong professional communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow through
  • The ability to work independently, take initiative, and move projects forward with appropriate guidance
  • Experience coordinating vendors, production partners, logistics, or field teams
  • A calm and adaptable approach when priorities, timelines, or onsite conditions change
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25 to 35 percent of the year
  • Availability to work extended hours, evenings, and weekends during activations when required
  • A bachelor’s degree or diploma in marketing, communications, event management, or a related field is an asset

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable

  • Experience supporting business to business events or trade shows
  • Experience with digital or technology enabled brand experiences
  • Exposure to project budgets, estimates, purchase orders, or expense reconciliation
  • Experience working with beverage alcohol brands

What Makes This Opportunity Different

VIBRANT offers an entrepreneurial environment where team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership, and build their careers through hands-on experience. Strong performers have the opportunity to expand their responsibilities, work across different clients and program types, and shape their career path as the business grows.

Candidates should be comfortable with the realities of experiential marketing. The role includes regular travel, onsite responsibilities, and longer hours during certain activations. In return, it offers direct involvement in bringing programs to life and the opportunity to see the impact of your work firsthand.

If you are an agency professional who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems, and delivering strong experiences in the field, we would like to hear from you.

VIBRANT is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace. Please contact our Talent and Culture team if you require accommodation during any stage of the interview process.

raw.title: Senior Information Systems Engineer
raw.excerpt: Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era.
raw.description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Sr Information Systems Engineer to join Cribl's IT Engineering team. In this role, you will be the technical owner of the core systems that power how Cribl operates every day — from identity and access to endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and the automations that tie it all together. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role on a team that treats reliability, security, and employee experience as equally important outcomes.

You'll partner closely with Security, Enterprise Applications, and People teams to design and run the services Cribl depends on at scale: Okta, AWS, ServiceNow, MDM, and a growing stack of SaaS integrations and AI-powered workflows. Whether you're building joiner/mover/leaver automations, hardening endpoint baselines, or governing the next generation of MCP-connected AI tools, your work will be foundational to how a fast-moving, remote-first company stays secure and operational.

This role reports to IT Engineering leadership and will serve as a senior peer and escalation point across the IT & Security organization.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

As the Sr Information Systems Engineer, you will be the technical owner of Cribl's core corporate systems — keeping identity, endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and IT automation healthy, secure, and scalable. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Identity, Access & Lifecycle: Own administration of our primary identity provider (Okta or equivalent) and design joiner/mover/leaver automations (e.g., Workday → Okta → SaaS) with a focus on least privilege, auditability, and contractor and elevated-access workflows.
  • AWS, Cloud & Core Infrastructure: Administer AWS accounts used for corporate IT, VPN, and supporting infrastructure, including secure networking patterns, logging, monitoring, and alerting across IT-owned cloud resources.
  • Endpoint Management & MDM: Own endpoint management for macOS and Windows via MDM (e.g., Jamf, Intune), including zero-touch provisioning, patch management, security baselines, and compliance reporting for the fleet.
  • ServiceNow & IT Service Management: Serve as primary ServiceNow administrator for IT & Security — core data model, catalog, workflows, SLAs, and integrations — and partner with Security, Finance, and Compliance to support ITGC, SOX/IT controls, access reviews, and change management.
  • Automation, Integrations & Tooling: Design and maintain automation workflows across IT systems (e.g., Okta Workflows, Serval, Zapier, PowerShell/Python, APIs) and serve as SME for SaaS integrations across Okta, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, Slack, and Azure/AWS.
  • AI Tools & MCP Governance: Evaluate, configure, and govern AI tools and MCP-based agent frameworks in partnership with IT and Security, ensuring safe usage patterns, appropriate access controls, and clear documentation and runbooks.
  • Operations, Support & On-Call: Serve as Tier 3 escalation for complex incidents across identity, MDM, ServiceNow, and core platforms; participate in the IT on-call rotation; and contribute to IT metrics, fleet reporting, and knowledge base content.

We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Corporate IT Systems Experience: 5+ years in corporate IT roles with significant responsibility for systems administration across identity, SaaS, and/or infrastructure in a cloud-first environment, with a proven track record balancing project work and operational/on-call responsibilities.
  • AWS Administration (Required): Hands-on, production experience with AWS (IAM, VPCs, EC2/ECS or similar, basic networking, tagging/governance) supporting internal IT or SaaS platforms.
  • ServiceNow Administration: Hands-on administration of ServiceNow or a similar enterprise ITSM platform, including workflow configuration, catalog items, change/incident processes, and basic reporting.
  • Enterprise Identity Provider Experience: Direct, production experience with at least one enterprise identity provider — Okta strongly preferred; Azure AD/Entra ID or similar acceptable — including SSO, lifecycle management, and access policies.
  • Endpoint Management Ownership: Demonstrated ownership of macOS and/or Windows endpoint management in a mid-to-large fleet, including baseline configs, software distribution, and patch management.
  • Scripting & Automation: Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar) and comfort working with REST APIs and JSON.
  • Remote-First Operator: Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-moving, distributed environment — you manage your own priorities, communicate proactively, and know when to escalate.
  • Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience with Jamf (macOS), Intune (Windows/mobile), and/or device posture tooling such as Kolide or similar.
    • Experience managing core SaaS tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian, or Glean.
    • Background designing or maintaining automations with tools like Serval, Zapier, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
    • Experience evaluating, configuring, and governing AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Glean) and MCP-based agent frameworks in an enterprise environment.
    • Working knowledge of Azure (subscriptions, RBAC, group-based access) and/or other major cloud providers alongside AWS.
    • Prior experience supporting a rapidly scaling, distributed engineering organization.

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range
$99,000—$156,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

  • Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake
  • Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities
  • Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond
  • Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time
  • Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region
  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers
  • Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge
  • Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts
  • Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies
  • Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts
  • timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution
  • Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments
  • Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions
  • Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

  • Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards
  • Manage regional budgets and resources effectively
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline
  • Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role
  • Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As Staff Product Designer, you will own the end-to-end design of MEDvidi's AI Track, the core line of AI-powered clinical tools where providers interact with model outputs in a regulated healthcare environment. Your design decisions directly shape how clinicians review, accept, and correct AI-generated notes, treatment plans, and recommendations, impacting both provider efficiency and patient outcomes.

You will work closely with product managers and engineers, reporting to the Director of Product. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports: you drive product design from problem definition through delivery, gather requirements independently, and bring solutions to release. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.

Why this role

  • Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.
  • Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.
  • Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Responsibilities

  • Own product design in your areas of the AI Track end-to-end: from defining the problem with the product manager, through user analysis, to working with engineers on the solution and accepting the build.
  • Design and iterate on human-AI interaction patterns: interfaces where providers verify, accept, edit, or reject model output and bring those patterns to a state where other teams can reuse them.
  • Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.
  • Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.
  • Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.
  • Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.
  • You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.
  • You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product design, with a focus on complex work interfaces: EHR, admin panels, CRM, operational tools, or other systems where specialists perform their core work.
  • Demonstrable experience designing human-AI interaction: interfaces where users verify, accept, edit, or reject model output. Building a 0-to-1 agentic product is ideal; experience with review-and-approval interfaces for automated decisions also qualifies.
  • Hands-on prototyping in code using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) on an existing component library or codebase, not just design tools.
  • Track record of contributing to a design system within product work: shipping reusable components, tokens, and documentation as part of feature delivery, not as a standalone project.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements independently, finding problems, talking to users and stakeholders, and driving a solution to release without waiting for a mandated brief.
  • Advanced English (B2+) and fluent Russian.
  • Availability to work within CET-compatible hours.

Would be a plus

  • Experience in healthcare or telemedicine products: understanding of HIPAA, clinical compliance constraints, and the provider's role in decision-making.
  • Experience leading a design team's transition to AI tools: setting up shared agent workflows, running workshops, driving adoption across peers.
  • Hands-on user research with specialist users: usability testing and interviews with doctors, nurses, or clinical operators (not only end consumers).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Legal Intern (Unpaid / Academic Credit Eligible)

FASD United – Justice Advisory Committee / Justice Center

Location: Remote (U.S.-based required)

Duration: Semester-based (Fall/Spring/Summer; flexible start dates)
Time Commitment: 10–15 hours per week (flexible based on academic requirements)
Compensation: Unpaid (academic credit or volunteer experience)

Position Overview

FASD United is seeking law students for a Legal Internship supporting its Justice Advisory Committee and Justice Center initiatives. This role offers hands-on experience at the intersection of law, disability, behavioral health, and public policy, with a focus on improving justice system outcomes for individuals with Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders (FASD).

Interns will contribute to legal research, training development, and the creation of case-informed resources that support attorneys, courts, families, and policymakers.

Key Responsibilities

Legal Research & Analysis

  • Conduct legal research on topics related to FASD and the justice system (e.g., competency, Miranda rights, sentencing, diversion, disability accommodations)
  • Identify and summarize relevant case law, statutes, and emerging legal trends
  • Support development of legal briefs, memoranda, and issue summaries

Amicus Brief Support

  • Assist in research and drafting components of amicus curiae briefs
  • Compile supporting evidence, citations, and interdisciplinary research (legal + clinical)
  • Track relevant appellate and post-conviction cases involving FASD-related issues

Training & Resource Development

  • Support the development of training materials for legal professionals (judges, defense attorneys, prosecutors, law enforcement)
  • Assist in creating fact sheets, legal guides, and presentation materials
  • Translate complex legal and clinical concepts into accessible formats

Committee & Program Support

  • Assist with preparation of Justice Advisory Committee materials (agendas, summaries, research briefs)
  • Support coordination of subject-matter experts and contributors
  • Participate in internal discussions and contribute insights where appropriate

Learning Objectives

Interns will:

  • Gain exposure to disability-informed legal frameworks and justice system reform
  • Develop skills in legal research, policy analysis, and applied advocacy
  • Engage with multidisciplinary professionals across law, behavioral health, and social services
  • Build experience in nonprofit legal strategy and systems-level impact work

Qualifications

  • Current law student (1L, 2L, or 3L) in good academic standing
  • Strong legal research and writing skills
  • Interest in criminal law, juvenile justice, disability law, public defense, prosecution, or public policy
  • Ability to synthesize complex information across disciplines
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Preferred (Not Required)

  • Coursework or experience in criminal law, evidence, constitutional law, or disability rights
  • Interest or experience related to FASD, neurodevelopmental disabilities, or behavioral health
  • Experience with legal databases (e.g., Westlaw, LexisNexis)

Supervision & Structure

  • Interns will be supervised by FASD United staff and/or designated legal advisors affiliated with the Justice Advisory Committee
  • Regular check-ins and feedback will be provided
  • Work may contribute to real-world legal resources, training materials, and policy initiatives

Academic Credit / Volunteer Structure

  • This is an unpaid position
  • FASD United will support documentation required for academic credit, externship programs, or pro bono hours
  • Interns are responsible for coordinating with their academic institution for credit approval

How to Apply

Please submit:

  1. Resume or CV
  2. Brief statement of interest included in a cover letter (1–2 paragraphs)
  3. Writing sample (legal or academic)
  4. Availability (hours per week and preferred term)

About FASD United

FASD United is a national nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing awareness, research, policy, and support for individuals and families affected by Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders. Through its Justice initiatives, FASD United works to improve legal system responses and outcomes for individuals with FASD.

Salary: Unpaid / Academic Credit Eligible

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

We are the Clinical Trials Division (CTD): We Supply the Hope that Changes Lives

CTD partners with pharmaceutical and biotech customers around the world to ensure the right patients get the right therapies in the right doses at the right time - a concept that we internally embrace as "There is a Patient Waiting." Our unique blend of services includes project management, packaging, distribution, transportation management and specialty logistics, ancillary supply management, clinical supply optimization, bio-repository storage and much more. Our more than 4000 employees in over 15 countries work hard every day knowing that what they do matters. Thermo Fisher Scientific – Digital Solutions develops scalable digital and data capabilities that connect customer needs, business priorities, and technology delivery. This role partners across product, engineering, data, and business teams to deliver trusted solutions and measurable value.

Your Role in that Mission:

The Sr. Manager, Digital Product Solutions serves as a customer-facing link between customers, the IT organization, and engineering teams. The role leads customer discovery to understand business objectives, workflows, challenges, and product needs, then translates those insights into clear, actionable product and technical requirements. This role maintains and prioritizes a structured product backlog, identifies recurring needs across customers and market segments, and partners with IT and engineering leaders to deliver scalable capabilities that create measurable customer and business value.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer Discovery & Product Definition

· Build trusted customer relationships and lead discovery sessions, workshops, interviews, and workflow reviews to understand goals, pain points, business processes, and desired outcomes.

· Distinguish underlying customer needs from requested features and translate them into business requirements, use cases, functional and technical specifications, user stories, data/integration requirements, and acceptance criteria.

· Validate requirements and proposed solutions with customers and technical teams, resolving ambiguity throughout design and development while avoiding unnecessary one-off customization.

Backlog & Roadmap Management

· Create, maintain, and continuously refine a structured backlog of customer and product requirements.

· Synthesize requests across customers, industries, use cases, and segments; identify common themes and reusable solutions.

· Prioritize requirements using customer impact, strategic alignment, revenue potential, urgency, effort, risk, and applicability, and partner with product leadership and engineering to incorporate priorities into roadmaps and release plans.

· Communicate priorities, tradeoffs, dependencies, and expected timelines clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

Customer & Market Insights

· Analyze customer feedback and usage patterns to identify recurring problems, unmet needs, emerging opportunities, and differences across customer segments.

· Share structured customer insights with IT, engineering, sales, customer success, implementation, and leadership teams to inform product strategy and planning.

· Combine direct customer feedback with business priorities, product vision, and technical considerations to shape scalable product capabilities.

Cross-Functional Delivery & Enablement

· Partner with engineering, IT, customer experience, security, data, and commercial, global client services, to assess feasibility, dependencies, risks, and implementation options.

· Serve as the product representative in strategic customer discussions, roadmap reviews, and solution-design sessions, facilitating alignment when requirements or priorities conflict.

· Support product launches through documentation, enablement materials, release communications, and customer-facing presentations, ensuring capabilities and limitations are represented accurately.

As Demonstrated By:

· Customer empathy and consultative communication with strong stakeholder-management and facilitation skills.

· Structured requirements analysis, systems/process thinking, and technical aptitude.

· Product judgment, commercial awareness, and evidence-based prioritization in environments with competing priorities.

· Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive-level communication skills.

· Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence cross-functionally, and translate between business and technical audiences.

Key Requirements:

Education:

· Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Product Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

· Advanced degree or relevant product/Agile certification preferred.


Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing product, solutions, business analysis, product ownership, or technical consulting role.
  • Experience conducting customer discovery and translating business needs into functional requirements, technical specifications, user stories, data/integration requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience creating, refining, and prioritizing product backlogs and synthesizing feedback across multiple customers or segments.
  • Sufficient technical fluency to work effectively with software engineers, architects, data teams, and integration specialists.
  • Experience with enterprise customers, enterprise software/SaaS, APIs, integrations, data products, workflow automation, Agile methods, or product-management tools preferred.

raw.description:
Cybersecurity Systems Engineer – CAASM (Armis)

Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time

About SERVISS

At SERVISS, we deliver cutting-edge cybersecurity and IT solutions to government and commercial clients, with a mission to secure systems, data, and critical infrastructure through innovation and expertise. We don’t just deploy tools — we engineer mission platforms that become foundational systems of record for cyber operations, compliance automation, and national cyber readiness. From CISA CDM to DoD mission enclaves, our work shapes how government sees, governs, and defends its digital terrain.
As we expand our capabilities, we’re seeking a hands-on CAASM engineer with Armis expertise to help build, integrate, and operate enterprise cyber asset visibility platforms.

Position Summary

SERVISS is seeking a CAASM Engineer to support the design, deployment, integration, and operation of Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM) platforms — with a primary focus on Armis (Axonius or equivalent a plus) — across hybrid cloud and enterprise environments. The ideal candidate works as part of a cross-functional security team to onboard asset sources, streamline data pipelines, and enhance visibility into enterprise cyber assets, exposures, and risk. This is a technically hands-on role reporting to the CAASM Engineering Lead.
This position is scoped at a mid-level baseline (3+ years), but we actively encourage senior and highly experienced engineers to apply — role scope, level, and compensation can flex to match demonstrated expertise.

The Work

This is a hands-on engineering role. The selected candidate will:
  • Deploy, configure, and tune Armis (or equivalent CAASM platforms) across hybrid cloud and enterprise environments
  • Onboard and maintain data integrations from CMDBs, EDR/XDR, vulnerability feeds, cloud inventories, identity, network, and SaaS sources
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and workflow connectors (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to enhance data ingestion and normalization
  • Build normalization, correlation, and enrichment logic that turns raw telemetry into authoritative asset intelligence
  • Monitor data quality, troubleshoot integration issues, and resolve engineering escalations
  • Support platform optimization, performance tuning, and operational stability
  • Configure dashboards, reports, and risk views that render asset and exposure data for technical and stakeholder audiences
  • Produce and maintain documentation for deployment architectures, configuration baselines, and operational procedures

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with installation, configuration, and integration of CAASM platforms (Armis primary; Axonius or equivalent a plus)
  • Onboard and maintain data integrations from CMDBs, vulnerability feeds, cloud inventories, and endpoint tools
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and workflow connectors to enhance data ingestion and normalization
  • Support CAASM platform optimization, performance tuning, and operational stability
  • Monitor data quality, troubleshoot integration issues, and resolve engineering escalations
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity analysts and stakeholders to translate security requirements into technical solutions
  • Support cyber governance reporting, continuous monitoring, and compliance automation efforts

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years in cybersecurity engineering, systems integration, or IT infrastructure roles (candidates with more experience are encouraged to apply)
  • Hands-on experience with Armis, or a comparable CAASM / asset intelligence platform (e.g., Axonius)
  • Strong understanding of IT systems including Windows, Linux, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure)
  • Familiarity with APIs, data ingestion pipelines, RESTful integration, and scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash)
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals and security principles (asset discovery, vulnerability context, normalization)
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a similar field — or equivalent experience or relevant certifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct hands-on Armis deployment, integration, or administration experience
  • Experience with asset management, CAASM applications, or enterprise security tools
  • Familiarity with cloud-native services (AWS, Azure) and service APIs
  • Experience with SIEMs common in the federal market (e.g., Elastic, Splunk) and common sensor tools
  • Understanding of Federal cyber governance — NIST 800-53/171, RMF, CDM, and continuous monitoring
  • Certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, or vendor-specific CAASM certifications
  • Exposure to data analytics or BI dashboards related to security telemetry
  • Prior DoD or Federal civilian cybersecurity experience and an active security clearance

Freedom to Thrive.

Why Join SERVISS? Our goal as an employer is simple yet profound: to create an environment where you can be your best self, pursue your passions, and enjoy the freedom to thrive both personally and professionally. Your success is our success, and we’re committed to supporting you every step of the way.
  • Be part of an exciting company with ground floor opportunities in the Equity Participation Program
  • Highly competitive compensation and best in class benefits
  • 100% of medical, vision, dental, and life insurance premiums paid for by SERVISS
  • Opportunities for annual performance bonuses and growth incentives
  • 401(k) retirement plan with 6% dollar for dollar match

Additional Considerations for HUBZone Applicants

Preference may be given to applicants residing in a federal HUBZone in support of SERVISS LLC’s HUBZone workforce objectives; all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

How to Determine HUBZone Residency

Candidates can verify HUBZone eligibility by entering their home address into the SBA HUBZone Map at . If your residence falls within a designated HUBZone area on the map, you are considered a HUBZone resident for hiring preference purposes.

raw.description:
FrankCrum is a Top Workplace!

Frank Winston Crum Insurance (FWCI) issues Workers' Compensation and General Liability policies by offering flexible coverage and payment options to meet the varied needs of businesses. Over the years, FWCI has grown from a single-state insurance carrier to one that is licensed in over 40 states and continues to expand. In addition to regional and product line growth, FWCI has enhanced its value-added services. What has not changed though is the firm's commitment - echoed throughout the family of companies - "always to do the right things for the right reasons!"

Click here to learn more about FrankCrum!

Job Applicant Privacy Policy and CA Notice at Collection

The Role You'll Play to Create Success

We are eager to announce a General Liability Claims Adjuster position filled with many exciting opportunities! This job contributes to the mission of FrankCrum by adjusting an inventory of low to moderately complex general liability claims and assisting in establishing the best and most cost-effective strategy for handling this type of claim.

  1. Investigates, evaluates and brings to timely resolution an inventory of low to moderately complex general liability claims of which some are litigated and may involve large property damage, bodily injury, inland marine and a sub- set of construction defect type claims in accordance with established claim handling standards and applicable state regulations and laws.
  2. Understands general liability coverage issues and can analyze and interpret commercial policy language in conjunction with specific facts of loss to reach appropriate coverage decisions and effectively communicate the company’s coverage position verbally and in writing including reservation of rights and denial of coverage letters
  3. Composes a variety of other written communications to insureds, claimants, attorneys and agents in a professional and error-free manner.
  4. Understands and interprets construction contracts and apply risk transfer when appropriate.
  5. Evaluates and documents damages to ensure accurate and timely reserves; immediately escalate to management cases with potential exposure above your authority.
  6. Negotiates effectively and in good faith to achieve fair and accurate claim settlements.
  7. Manages litigated claim files proactively from inception to closure, including collaboration with defense counsel to determine and execute an appropriate plan of action; bring litigated cases to resolution either by negotiated settlement or trial, as appropriate.
  8. Negotiates the duty to defend and indemnify with liable insurers when appropriate.
  9. Retains experts and vendors to achieve appropriate claim outcomes while remaining mindful of loss adjustment expenses.
  10. Manages assigned workloads effectively to achieve quality and quantity production goals while providing superior customer service.
  11. Implements strategies to expeditiously close files and manages claims to a conclusion in the most effective manner possible.
  12. Documents all notes and file activity in a paperless claim system appropriately and clearly; compose detailed periodic reports including claim summary reports and large loss notifications, as needed.
  13. Communicates with other departments regarding developments on specific claim files as well as overall claim trends.
  14. Demonstrates an understanding of reserving requirements and philosophies and can maintain appropriate reserves on all assigned claim files.

The Attributes We Seek

Keys to success in this position include an understanding of commercial lines products, policy language, exclusions, ISO forms, and effective claim handling practice, as well as a moderate level of knowledge and skill in claim handling and litigation management. Five (5) or more years of experience in adjusting commercial liability claims, with a proven record of increasing responsibility, appropriate claim outcomes and excellent customer service is required. College degree preferred, high school diploma or equivalent are needed. Must hold Proper Public adjuster licenses in Florida and/or Texas and other states with the ability to obtain additional licenses as needed.


What's Special About FrankCrum

FrankCrum, a family-owned business-to-business entity since 1981 made of several companies: FrankCrum Corporate (a professional employer organization), FrankCrum Staffing, Frank Winston Crum Insurance Company, and the FrankCrum Insurance Agency - all based in Clearwater, Florida. This "family of employer solutions" employs approximately 500 people who serve over 4,000 clients throughout the United States. FrankCrum employees are trained to deliver high value through exceptional customer service and treat clients and coworkers like family. By living by our Brand Pillars (Integrity, Affinity, and Prosperity) employees are recognized at quarterly events for exceptional customer service and milestones in tenure.

The FrankCrum headquarters spans 14 acres and includes a cafe, subsidized for employees. Menus include made-to-order breakfast, hot lunch options and even dinners that can be ordered to-go, all at very affordable prices. The cafe also plays host to monthly birthday and anniversary celebrations, eating and costume contests, and yearly holiday parties. Through the input of its own employees, The Tampa Bay Times has recognized FrankCrum as a Top Place to Work for more than 10 years in a row! FrankCrum also supports several community efforts through Trinity Cafe, the Homeless Empowerment Program, and Clearwater Free Clinic!

If you want to play this role to positively impact our clients' day-to-day business, then apply now!

This job posting will remain open continuously and qualified applicants will be considered as applications are received.

Pay Data

As required by applicable state and/or local regulations the following pay data provides a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this position at the time of posting. FrankCrum may ultimately pay more or less than the posted pay range due to many economic and individualized considerations. The pay offered to the selected candidate will be based on factors including, but not limited to qualifications, knowledge, licensure, skills, abilities, work experience, education, budget, training, employment trends, internal wage considerations, market dynamics, certifications, geographical location, assessments, and other business and organizational needs. The annualized pay range at the time of initial posting for this position is $63,000 - $83,000. These figures represent the annualized pay for both hourly and salaried types of positions and does not indicate employment is on a yearly basis nor remove the employee’s employment at-will status.

Under the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), employers are required to provide a Notice at Collection to California job applicants at or before the time their personal information is collected, whether through an applicant tracking system (ATS), application forms, recruiting portals, or other recruiting processes.
the legal requirement is that the notice be provided and readily accessible at or before the point of collection.
From a compliance perspective, the key requirement is ensuring that the notice is readily available before personal information is collected and that the organization can demonstrate that the notice was presented in a compliant manner if requested by regulators or in the event of an audit. Maintaining records of how and where the notice is displayed can help support that demonstration.

FrankCrum is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

raw.description:
We're searching for a skilled and inquisitive Marketing Automation Specialist to join our fast-growing Digital Marketing Operations team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with marketing automation tools such as Marketo and Salesforce, as well as experience with project management tools. The Marketing Automation Specialist will be responsible for implementing, automating, and measuring marketing initiatives and workflows to boost productivity and support stakeholder efforts. You will collaborate with Product, Marketing, Sales operations or Technical teams on a variety of initiatives. The ideal applicant is a detail-oriented professional who is committed to upholding high standards and delivering great results.


This is a full-remote night shift role with scheduled working hours between 3:00 PM and 12:00 AM EEST.


How you’ll make an impact:

  • Manage End-to-End Communications: Oversee and execute related communications, including monthly newsletters, regional & global marketing initiatives, social media, and other types of programs.
  • Email Marketing Activities: Perform day-to-day email marketing tasks, including setup, scheduling, testing, tagging, and deployment of one-time, recurring, or triggered emails.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot technical issues related to HTML templates, list segmentation, and other aspects of email execution.
  • Database Segmentation and A/B Testing: Utilize database segmentation techniques, dynamic content, and A/B testing to optimize campaign performance.
  • Data Flow Management: Understand and manage technical and data flows, such as setting up workflows for capturing leads from website forms and integrating values into the Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Marketo.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Act as the point person for the marketing operations team, coordinating with numerous stakeholders to ensure campaigns are planned, tested, and delivered on time.
  • Documentation: Document campaign processes and workflows, ensuring users adhere to naming conventions, program structures, and correct settings in campaigns.
  • Optimization Culture: Drive a culture of testing and learning to continually optimize campaign delivery and effectiveness.
  • Brand Compliance: Ensure all email campaigns adhere to brand guidelines.
  • Workflow Automation: Implement and optimize automated workflows to streamline campaign execution, lead nurturing, and account engagement processes.
  • Stay Updated on Industry Trends: Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in ABM and B2B marketing to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement. Use these insights to continuously refine and enhance the ABM roadmap, ensuring our strategies remain cutting-edge and effective.

What we’re looking for:

  • 1–2 years’ experience with a marketing automation platform (Marketo preferred; HubSpot, Eloqua, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud also considered).
  • Strong understanding of marketing automation concepts (email campaigns, segmentation, workflows, lead lifecycle).
  • Hands-on experience executing and optimizing email and nurture campaigns.
  • Comfortable working with data, basic reporting, and campaign performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and data flows between platforms.
  • Experience with project management tools (Monday.com, Trello, Asana).
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple campaigns at once.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work independently.
  • Interest in learning and growing in marketing automation and ABM.
  • B2B marketing experience, ideally in an account-based or demand generation environment.

We offer a fully-remote working model for our colleagues and core benefits including:

  • Annual vacation days: 21/year + additional 1 birthday leave + 3 sick days/year
  • Discretionary bonus scheme of up to 10% which the company may operate from time to time.
  • Country specific benefits package, including meal tickets of 35 RON/ working day and medical services subscription at Regina Maria.

Why join YouGov?
Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.

Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.

Life at YouGov
We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.

We strive to provide YouGovers with best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.

Equal Opportunity Employer
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity or expression, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, HIV status, political affiliation, socioeconomic background, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law or in line with our responsibilities as a fair and ethic employer. All employment decisions are made based on occupational qualifications, merit, and business need.

raw.description:
Type: Full-time, salaried employment
Location: Remote in the UK only, with expected regular travel to retailer sites across the UK
Salary Range: £98,000 - £112,000 depending on experience + stock options

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

About the Role

As Director of Operations, UK you will help build and lead the field operations team that installs and maintains Focal Systems shelf cameras across our UK retail partners. Our cameras are being deployed at scale, with 100,000+ units live or rolling out at leading retailers around the world, and the UK is a major part of that growth.

You will support the running of UK operations end to end: the people, the processes, the metrics, and the customer outcomes. You will work closely with senior and executive leadership to set and roll out operational strategy, and with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to make every deployment faster, more reliable, and more cost-effective than the last.

You will be joining an established, experienced team that works in cycles. Retailer rollouts bring periods of rapid scale-up, followed by quieter maintenance periods where we scale back down, and those transitions have not always been smooth. A key part of this role is making them smoother: planning ahead for each change in pace, keeping the team steady and supported through it, and building processes that let us ramp up and down without losing quality or momentum.

This is a senior leadership role. You will develop our existing team, support during scale-up and scale-down periods, set the operating rhythm for field work, and be the person our customers and colleagues rely on when something needs to get done.

What We Are Looking For

  • You are a hands-on operations leader who has scaled field teams and processes, and you are as comfortable working with stakeholders at different levels
  • You run operations on data: you define the right metrics, watch them closely, and act early when they move
  • You build structure where there is none, designing roles, workflows, and SOPs that hold up as volume grows and priorities shift
  • You hire well, coach well, and build teams that take ownership without needing to be chased
  • You understand that operations is a customer-facing function, and you take pride in exceeding what our retail partners expect
  • You thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment and are energised by building something new

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own ongoing field-service performance and SLA delivery, prioritising maintenance work and driving issues through to resolution.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing UK field operations team responsible for installing and maintaining shelf cameras at scale
  • Own the operational plan for UK deployments, from scheduling and logistics through installation, quality checks, and ongoing maintenance
  • Define, track, and report on the key metrics for field performance and SLA adherence
  • Partner with executive leadership to set performance goals, budgets, and long-term operational strategy for the UK
  • Analyse operational processes end to end, identify bottlenecks, and lead improvements that increase speed, quality, and efficiency
  • Work across Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Success to feed field insights back into hardware, software, and deployment playbooks
  • Act as the senior escalation point for operational and customer issues, removing blockers quickly and owning the outcome
  • Build strong relationships with retail partners, understand their store operations, agree success criteria, and deliver against them
  • Manage relationships with any third-party installers or service partners, including performance, quality, and cost
  • Establish safe working practices and ensure field activity meets health and safety requirements at every retailer site

Requirements

  • 5+ years in an operations leadership role, with a track record of managing people, processes, and budgets
  • Experience leading field operations, installation, or service teams across multiple sites, ideally deploying hardware at scale
  • Strong working knowledge of core operational functions, including finance and budgeting, customer service, logistics, and people management
  • Proven ability to plan and run operations for efficiency and productivity, using data and KPIs to drive decisions
  • Experience designing and implementing new structures, roles, and processes that support rapid growth and shifting business needs
  • Solid understanding of account management and customer success, and comfort working directly with senior customer stakeholders
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present clearly to executives, customers, and field teams
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and travel regularly within the UK

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of retail or grocery operations
  • Familiarity with retail technology such as shopper-facing apps, back-room inventory management, or POS systems
  • Experience managing third-party installers, contractors, or service partners
  • Lean Six Sigma or a similar process improvement certification
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

Why Focal Systems

Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.

Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.

Outstanding Partners - We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.

What we offerWe care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:

  • Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Pension
  • Sick Leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Learning and Development Budget
