raw.title: Industry Strategy Lead - Supplier Ecosystem
raw.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
raw.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About The Role
This role is a high-leverage operator reporting into the Director of Industry Strategy & Transformation, with direct exposure to revenue leadership and account owners. This role exists to define and scale CoLab’s supplier ecosystem strategy, building the repeatable go-to-market motion that links OEMs with their Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers so that every strategic account is connected to the network behind it.
This is a customer-facing, go-to-market, and product-influencing role. The right person is part strategist, part operator, part competitor. Someone who can read a room of executives, build a hyper compelling value case on the fly, see the supply network sitting behind the account in front of them, and close out the next step before the meeting ends.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define and own CoLab’s supplier ecosystem strategy, a scalable and repeatable go-to-market motion for how design collaboration extends from our customers into their Tier 1 and Tier 2 supply base and how that network compounds value for every company connected to it.
  • Shape how the supplier motion is packaged, priced, and resourced, partnering with product, revenue leadership, and finance to define what suppliers get, how they buy, and which teams own each stage from first connection to expansion.
  • Map the supply networks behind strategic accounts, identifying which suppliers carry the most design dependency, where feasibility, RFQ, DFM, tooling, and PPAP handoffs break down, and where the cost of that friction lands on each side.
  • Build the value case in both directions, why an OEM should bring its suppliers into CoLab and why a supplier should want to be there, grounded in quote quality, no-bid visibility, cycle time, rework, and launch risk.
  • Package supplier and network strategy plays that prospecting, BDR, and customer success teams can run without you in the room, from target lists drawn from customer supply networks to outreach angles by tier and expansion sequences for CS.
  • Spot where connected suppliers and adjacent customers become new opportunities, and build the motion that turns a supplier’s first seat in someone else’s workspace into its own enterprise relationship with CoLab.
  • Run executive, management, and user workshops that expose workflow friction on both sides of the OEM and supplier relationship and create the urgency needed to mobilize multi-stakeholder buying groups.
  • Bring the supplier network into deal strategy on CoLab’s most strategic opportunities, partnering with account executives to coach champions, align stakeholders across engineering, quality, supply chain, and procurement, and build the executive narratives that move buying groups forward.
  • Track how the motion performs, from supplier activation to supplier-sourced pipeline, and turn those signals into structured product feedback and a clear view of where to invest next.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • You've worked inside an OEM, and you understand the supplier side of the relationship.
  • You bring direct experience in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, supplier quality, or product development at an OEM, where you've owned or worked closely with the handoffs to Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers. Time on the supplier side is a strong plus.
  • You know what an OEM feels when a part misses PPAP and what a supplier feels when a late change lands on a quote, and you can speak credibly to both.
  • You are a network thinker. You see an account as one node in a larger system, and you can look at a customer's supply base and quickly see where the leverage is, which relationships will carry adoption, and which ones will stall it.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to read a room of executives in real time. You know when to push, when to pause, when to ask the harder question, and when to take the win and move on.
  • Competitive by nature. You are wired to play to win, you put in the reps, and you run at high cadence. You take losses personally enough to learn from them and not personally enough to slow down.
  • Sharp sense of time value. You understand which work compounds, which work is throwaway, and which conversations are worth a calendar hold versus a quick Slack. You make calls and you move.
  • Clear, direct communicator. You write concisely, present without filler, and can build a clean, compelling deck under pressure. You know that a strong deck is a forcing function, not a deliverable, and you build them that way.
  • Fluent with AI tools as a force multiplier. You know how to use AI to compress research, sharpen messaging, and build faster. You don't just tolerate the tools, you intentionally reach for them to do more with less.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • You have defined CoLab’s supplier ecosystem strategy, and multiple strategic accounts are actively bringing their suppliers into CoLab as a result.
  • You have shaped how the supplier motion is packaged, priced, and resourced, and it runs as a repeatable motion across the revenue org.
  • Your network plays are in use by prospecting and CS, with supplier-sourced pipeline and expansion you can point to.
  • You are owning strategic supplier mapping workshops with our top enterprise accounts.
  • You have meaningfully influenced the outcome of multiple seven figure deals.
  • You are trusted to drive customer leadership conversations without backup.

Extra Details

  • This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options
  • Unlimited paid vacation, extended health benefits, and RRSP/401k matching
  • Remote-friendly within Eastern or Central time zones in Canada or the US.
  • This role will have a travel component to visit customers onsite. Customer visits are typically 1-3 days total, one or two a month.

Equity Note
Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

This is a high-impact FP&A role at the heart of our North American business. As the senior Finance business partner for Ultimo and FSI, you will work closely with regional leaders and help shape decisions on pricing, hiring, investment and growth. You will bring financial insight into the conversation early - not simply report on decisions after they have been made.

From day one, you will have meaningful ownership. An early focus will be strengthening financial visibility across our services organization: building a forecast model leaders can rely on, sharpening our view of project margins and services revenue recognition, and improving how we plan capacity and resources. You will also play a key role in the 2027 budgeting process and help us use AI and automation to make Finance faster, smarter and more scalable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead forecasting and annual budgeting for North America across Ultimo and FSI
  • Build strong project-level reporting and provide clear insight into project margins and services revenue recognition
  • Drive utilization, capacity and resource planning for the services organization
  • Turn monthly performance data - including revenue, ARR, gross margin, services margin and operating costs - into actionable business insight
  • Partner closely with North American leadership, Sales and Services on pricing, hiring, investment and other key business decisions
  • Champion practical opportunities to use AI and automation to improve the speed, quality and scalability of Finance processes

What We Offer

  • A highly visible role in one of our strategic growth markets, with real ownership and the opportunity to influence decisions
  • An ambitious, collaborative global Finance team spanning Europe, North America and Sri Lanka
  • The opportunity to help shape a modern, AI-enabled Finance function rather than simply operate within an established model
  • An international SaaS environment with the scale and opportunities of the wider IFS group
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in FP&A, commercial finance or business partnering, ideally within SaaS and/or professional services
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to move confidently from detailed project economics to executive-level conversations
  • Based in the United States within the Eastern Time Zone. This is required to ensure real-time collaboration with North American leadership and our European Finance team
  • Advanced Excel skills, from complex financial modeling to efficient analysis and data handling
  • A strong understanding of professional services economics, including revenue recognition, utilization and margin drivers
  • A self-starter mindset: comfortable working independently, challenging assumptions and turning analysis into action
  • Curiosity about AI and automation, with an interest in applying new tools to scale and strengthen FP&A

Ultimo, an IFS company, is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer

Ultimo, an IFS company, is a leading SaaS provider of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) software, helping organizations get more from the assets that keep their businesses running. North America is a major growth market for us, strengthened by FSI, our established healthcare facilities and technology management business. Together, Ultimo and FSI create an exciting platform for continued growth across the region.

Join a high-energy, international Finance team working across Europe, North America and Sri Lanka. You will have the opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, growth-focused software environment.

title: Agentic Software Engineer (m/w/d)
description: We want to strengthen our team and are therefore looking for someone with experience.

raw.title: Agentic Software Engineer (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: We want to strengthen our team and are therefore looking for someone with experience.
raw.description:
We want to strengthen our team and are therefore looking for someone with experience.

Writing code by hand is no longer the job. Understanding what gets built is. If you see AI as an opportunity rather than a threat, read on.

Lovely Systems was founded in 2006 in Dornbirn, Austria. We build products for our clients: full stack, or the parts of it they need. Our engineers work agentically: humans steer, agents execute.

We look for builders: people who get their satisfaction from what gets built, not from typing the code. AI amplifies existing expertise. The more you understand, the better the results you get from agents.

Tasks

  • Orchestrate agents to build software, and write skills for them

  • Work test-driven

  • Run what you build: deploy, monitor, keep it healthy

  • Work across the whole ecosystem, e.g. Microservices, Kubernetes, Backend, Frontend; not necessarily all at once

  • Keep re-optimising how things are built, and automate wherever you can

Requirements

  • You bring solid software engineering experience.

  • You understand the inner workings of what is produced.

  • You love TDD.

  • You feel responsible for what you build, in production too.

  • You are fluent in English, our team language.

  • You are open source affine.

  • It's ok for you if you can't use Windows.

  • Experience orchestrating agents and writing skills for them is a plus.

These technologies appeal to you

Experience in these areas is a plus, not a must. Frameworks and languages matter less nowadays; what counts is being able to leverage tech.

  • AI agents: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini; chat interfaces to agents: e.g. cc-connect

  • Backend: Kotlin, Micronaut, jOOQ, Gradle; Python; Rust

  • Data: PostgreSQL, CrateDB, Kafka

  • Web frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Mobile and TV: Jetpack Compose Multiplatform, React Native, Swift

  • Identity management: Keycloak

  • Media: transcoding, petabyte-scale storage and delivery

  • Cloud: DigitalOcean, AWS, OVH, Hetzner

  • Infrastructure and operations: Kubernetes, Docker, Grafana, Loki, Prometheus; GitOps with ArgoCD, Kustomize

  • Code and collaboration: Git, GitHub

Benefits

  • Flexible location: remote anywhere close to ±2h Vienna time, at our office in Dornbirn, or a combination of both

  • A small, agile, English-speaking team, with members based in Austria, Hungary, Italy and Malta

  • Support for your professional development: conferences, workshops and online courses

  • Team events in person twice a year

  • Room to experiment with new technologies

  • State-of-the-art hardware (e.g. MacBook), which you may also use privately

  • Your work will be used daily by thousands of users

We are based in the Austrian Alps and looking for someone in Europe. You can find out more about us and our projects at

We are looking forward to your application including your CV and a cover letter. Tell us what you have built, ideally with agents, in either of them. No headhunters!

raw.title: Telehealth Mental Heath Provider (District of Columbia)
raw.excerpt: DescriptionMEDvidi is seeking experienced Telehealth Mental Health Providers to join our growing team.
raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is seeking experienced Telehealth Mental Health Providers to join our growing team. This is a fully remote, 1099 contractor opportunity offering flexibility, strong patient demand, and a highly supported clinical environment.

At MEDvidi, we provide comprehensive mental health evaluations and treatment for adult patients experiencing conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and mild-to-moderate OCD.

We’re reimagining how care is delivered. Here’s what sets us apart:

  • Full administrative support – no need to hire or manage staff; dedicated assistants handle scheduling, patient communication, and logistics
  • Streamlined technology – proprietary EMR with integrated PDMP and e-prescribing tools
  • Reduced administrative burden – automated workflows and AI-supported documentation tools
  • No software costs – our platform is fully provided at no cost to you
  • Low no-show rates – consistent patient flow and reliable earnings
  • Flexible scheduling – build your own schedule with the ability to increase volume over time

Compensation:

This is a 1099 contractor role with payment per completed appointment:

  • Physicians (MD/DO):
  • Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$60 per visit
  • Follow-ups (15 min): ~$40 per visit
  • Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs):
  • Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$45 per visit
  • Follow-ups (15 min): ~$30 per visit

Consistent availability and schedule optimization can significantly increase total earnings.

At MEDvidi, our mission is to make mental health care more accessible, affordable, and stigma-free. We leverage technology, clinical expertise, and operational support to empower providers and improve patient outcomes across the U.S.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations via telehealth
  • Review patient medical history, symptoms, medications, and relevant background
  • Diagnose and treat conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and OCD
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans
  • Prescribe medications, including controlled substances, in accordance with clinical and regulatory guidelines
  • Provide patient education on treatment plans, medication usage, and follow-up care
  • Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation in the EMR
  • Ensure completion of chart notes and prescriptions within required timeframes
  • Collaborate with clinical and operations teams to support patient care and continuity

Requirements

  • Board Certified Physician (MD/DO) or Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP)
  • Active and unrestricted medical license (multi-state preferred)
  • Active DEA registration
  • Minimum 2 years of clinical experience in mental health treatment
  • Experience prescribing controlled substances
  • Strong clinical judgment and comfort managing common outpatient psychiatric conditions
  • Ability to work a minimum of ~15 hours per week (preferred for patient continuity)

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

raw.description:
Description

CapsLock is a company that specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses that are facing sales growth challenges. Our comprehensive services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, all seamlessly integrated to ensure efficient and accelerated growth.

Our company was founded by industry professionals with expertise in IT, design, and data analytics. We identified a significant need for an exclusive, scalable customer acquisition solution in the market. Our vision is to provide a unique integrated solution for B2C clients that enables profitable customer acquisition, flexible scaling, and optimized internal processes.

At CapsLock, our core values center around our people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and fostering strong relationships. Our diverse and skilled team speaks 10+ languages and is located worldwide. We are dedicated to pioneering new and efficient marketing strategies to ensure our clients’ success.

﻿Role Description

As a Finance Director at CapsLock, you will be responsible for overseeing all financial aspects of the fast-growing marketing business, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting, and providing strategic guidance to support our business goals. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills and extensive financial expertise.

This role will report to the Chief Finance Officer of the Company.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Team leadership: Lead and mentor bookkeeping, FP&A, and taxation/compliance teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
  • Accounting: Oversee accounting. Lead implementation and improvement of financial and accounting policies/practices.
  • Budgeting: Oversees budgeting process. Supervise plan/fact analysis and provide explanations and recommendations.
  • Reporting: Ensure timely and accurate financial, and investment reporting for the Group of Companies
  • Internal Controls and Audits. Assist with developing and maintaining robust internal controls. Lead internal audits to ensure compliance with established financial procedures.
  • Tax and Compliance: Oversee tax filings, regulatory reports, and compliance with statutory obligations. Tax planning and optimization for the group
  • M&A transactions: Navigate the complexities of mergers and acquisitions including initial financial assessments, Due Diligence, and post-merger integration.
  • Process Improvement: Continuously improve financial processes, systems, and financial reporting to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and strategic relevance
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide insights and recommendations on financial performance and key financial metrics to the executive team
  • Third-party Communication: Manage relationships with banks, tax advisories, and external consultants

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA, CPA, ACCA preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in finance, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Experience with financial reporting, month-end / year-end processes, and IFRS/GAAP compliance.
  • Proven track record in financial planning, analysis, and management within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with executive management and external stakeholders.
  • Proactive nature, growth mindset, self-regulation.
  • Fluent English.
  • Ability and desire to work collaboratively with a diverse, remote global team.

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer above-market compensation, but we also offer perks and benefits that promote people’s well–being. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.

Ongoing Learning

People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.

Home Office

We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.

Physical Well–Being

Fitness is more than a gym membership. We all have different tastes and preferences. That’s why we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program that fits all.

Unlimited Sick Days

We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

Fun Stuff

There is never a shortage of fun stuff when you work with amazing people. But we like to spice things up and take them to the next level, you will soon learn how.

The Role:

We're growing our sales team and we're looking to bring on an Account Executive with a focus on Enterprise Sales across the India region. You will be at the forefront of our efforts to expand our growing business. Challenge yourself by selling the intrinsic value of software solutions to our customers. The primary responsibility will be to manage and close a pipeline of software license opportunities, while working closely with other Apryse resources and presales teams.

Account Executives at our company learn about the document processing opportunities and challenges facing the developer community across all industries. Our goal is to make the developer experience easier for our customers as they deliver value to their end users!

Responsibilities:

  • Qualify and manage new sales leads through the full sales cycle.
  • Identify opportunities that would benefit from our technology suite using a consultative sales approach.
  • Work closely with Solution Engineers in gathering requirements and proposing high value solutions.
  • Gain a deep understanding of the strengths and weaknesses of competing products, and effectively illustrate the value of our high-quality/market-leading solutions to prospects.
  • Recognize high value sales opportunities.
  • Effectively gather intelligence on markets, prospects, and the competition using various resources.
  • Meet or exceed quota expectations.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years' experience selling complex B2B software products.
  • Outstanding negotiation skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, particularly via e-mail and by phone.
  • Professional working fluency in English and Hindi.
  • A college or university degree. Technical disciplines or backgrounds are preferred.
  • Demonstrated success using a consultative approach with key business and technical executives, especially CTOs, VPs of Product Management, and Development/Engineering.
  • Consistent history of overachievement, with demonstrated success of multi-year quota achievement.
  • An accountable team player with a tenacious drive to win.
  • Experienced in using CRM to manage sales cycle.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience & qualifications.
  • A comprehensive extended benefits package.
  • A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential.
  • Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment.
  • On going support for learning development so you can continue to master your craft.
  • Work with the hardware you're most comfortable with (Windows or Mac)
  • Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other.
  • Excellent work-life balance with a flexible remote work environment.

Company Description

As the industry-leading provider of document software development (SDK) technology powering everything from traditional desktop software to innovative web and mobile applications, at Apryse we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that empower our clients to achieve their goals. With a broad international portfolio of combined companies, products, and leading technologies, we are actively changing the way the world works with documents to make work better and life simpler.

Customers like IBM, Autodesk, DocuSign, Boeing, Microsoft (and many more!) come to us to realize their web and mobile strategies for document management, editing, and collaboration as the #1-ranked commercial document SDK of choice for companies worldwide. As a result, you can find our document technology in thousands of solutions, including those of household names, used by millions across virtually every industry. Our XODO app alone has 25M unique installs -- and counting -- and the highest ratings among PDF productivity apps on the largest online app marketplaces.

Ready to join our team?

If you are interested in helping Apryse deliver on its commitments and taking your career to the next level, we invite you to apply online now. Additionally, we view the above section as a guide, not a checklist. We welcome diverse and non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you do not have every requirement listed.

We are committed to a work environment that is inclusive to all and free of discrimination. It is our policy to be an equal opportunity employer without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, citizenship status or any other factors prohibited by law. Apryse will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals.

raw.description:
Summary:

Cobalt AI uses automation to elevate physical safety and security in the workplace. Our platform, Cobalt Monitoring Intelligence, is a hybrid AI system, cloud-hosted with edge-deployed hardware, that provides human-verified, real-time monitoring of surveillance cameras, alarms, and robots across enterprise locations.

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to own the interfaces that security teams rely on every day, including live robot video feeds, event triage workflows, real-time alarm dashboards, and fleet management tools built in React and TypeScript. You’ll also work across the backend (Django/Python, GraphQL) to build the APIs that power those experiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and refine real-time security dashboards, event triage interfaces, and fleet management

tools used by security teams 24/7

  • Design and implement complex, interactive UIs — canvas rendering (environment maps, robot
    positioning), data visualization, live robot video via WebRTC, and subscription-driven event

streaming

  • Own component architecture in a monorepo and contribute to a Storybook-driven design system
    • Build and extend the GraphQL API — queries, mutations, and WebSocket subscriptions —

serving all frontend applications

  • Work with Django models in PostgreSQL — multi-tenant data isolation, schema design, query
    optimization, and migrations
    • Ship full-stack features end-to-end — from React components to GraphQL mutations to Django
    models and background jobs
    • Partner with the CDS and ML teams on the detection-to-event pipeline
    • Write well-tested code with strong observability — tracing, structured logging, and metrics
    • Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, incident response, and on-call rotations

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with depth in frontend development
    • Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript — opinionated about component architecture, state

management, and rendering performance

  • Experience building complex, interactive UIs — canvas/2D rendering, real-time streaming, data
    visualization, or WebRTC
    • Backend fluency in Python and Django — building GraphQL APIs, writing migrations, and
    optimizing ORM queries
    • Solid understanding of PostgreSQL — data modeling, indexing, and query performance
    • Comfort working in a monorepo with shared packages, generated types, and cross-team code
    ownership
    • Experience deploying to AWS and working with containerized applications

Why Work for Us?:

Competitive salary, equity, and full benefits (medical, vision, dental). Flexible work arrangements. A proven platform, an expanding customer base, and the opportunity to shape the engineering org at an inflection point.

Salary Range: $160k - $210k (actual compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law)

Cobalt AI is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Salary: $160,000–$210,000 per year

raw.title: Client Success Specialist
raw.excerpt: • Reports to: Manager, Client Success Delivery • Location: British Columbia (Remote) • Please note that though this role is remote, team members are expected to be available to attend key on-site events 2-4 times per year in the NYC office.
raw.description:
• Reports to: Manager, Client Success Delivery
  • Location: British Columbia (Remote)
    • Please note that though this role is remote, team members are expected to be available to attend key on-site events 2-4 times per year in the NYC office. The onsite weeks are scheduled in advance and travel expenses are covered by the business. Other occasional travel may also be required.
  • Hours/Status: Full-Time, exempt
    • Regular hours are usually 9am-5pm or 10am-6pm, Monday-Friday.
    • Occasional on-call work is required on a rotational basis (evenings 1:00-9:00 pm and weekends 10:00 am-6:00 pm).
  • Salary (CAD): $68,000-$80,000

The role

Spektrix has an exciting opportunity for Client Support Specialists to join our team!

As one of our Client Success Specialists (CSS), you'll provide accurate and timely support and consistent relationship management to Spektrix clients as a member of a Client Success Delivery Team. You'll act as the named relationship owner for an assigned group of clients, while also contributing to the shared reactive support the team provides across its full client cohort. Ultimately, the success of this role is achieved through the delivery of services that lead to successful outcomes for all Spektrix clients within the delivery team’s portfolio.

If you thrive on building meaningful connections, solving puzzles on the fly, and helping arts and cultural organizations succeed, we’d love for you to join us!

What You'll Do

  • Multi-Channel Resolution & On-Call Coverage: Resolve inbound client inquiries across phone, email, and video call using internal documentation and established processes, and participate in the support schedule, including rotating on-call coverage outside business hours.
  • Proactive Issue Detection: Identify broader trends during support interactions such as recurring bugs, training gaps, or emerging risks and either address them directly or escalate them to the right internal team.
  • Account Ownership & Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, keeping a clear view of their organizational goals, platform usage, and key stakeholders while maintaining consistent touchpoints.
  • Meeting Management & Action Tracking: Lead and follow up on client meetings including recording calls when appropriate, confirming next steps in writing, and tracking tasks through to completion.
  • Risk Monitoring & Escalation: Continuously track account health for early warning signs of dissatisfaction, low engagement, or declining usage, documenting and raising risks promptly.
  • Feature Adoption & Strategy: Guide clients through adopting core Spektrix capabilities tailored to their goals, leveraging product data and account history to surface expansion opportunities and bringing in specialist teams for advanced client needs.
  • Session & Event Delivery: Deliver tailored activation sessions, workshops, and enablement events for individual clients or groups using established materials from Enablement and the Client Success Lead.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Documentation: Maintain detailed records of client interactions in internal systems while collaborating across Client Success, Product, Operations, Solutions, and Enablement to resolve complex issues and share actionable feedback.
  • Technical Escalation & Continuous Improvement: Escalate complex technical issues falling outside standard procedures, while actively identifying opportunities to optimize internal processes and submitting recommendations to the CS Team Manager.
  • Professional Standards: Consistently display professionalism and reliability in all client and team interactions to build lasting trust.

What You Bring

  • 1+ years of experience in a client- or customer-facing role, such as support, customer success, or account management, or in box office, ticketing, or patron services within an arts or culture organization.
  • Proven ability to quickly learn and navigate complex software systems, and to apply that knowledge to client questions and needs.
  • Excellent interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with client stakeholders across a range of roles and levels of seniority.
  • Ability to manage a wide range of priorities, including making sure important urgent items don’t get dropped, while important items that aren’t urgent still get moved steadily forward.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a consistent approach to documenting work and following through on commitments.
  • Strong technical aptitude with a high degree of proficiency in tools such as Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Docs, and other web-based applications.
  • Ability to provide explanations and reasons for the choices you make and the advice you provide.
  • Ability to recognize and accept responsibility for mistakes and take the steps needed to achieve a resolution.
  • Demonstrated openness to coaching, feedback, and new ways of working as team processes evolve.
  • Ability to maintain sensitive/confidential client information.
Bonus Points if you have:
  • Experience using Spektrix, or another ticketing, CRM, or fundraising platform, in an arts or culture setting.
  • Experience with support and client management tools, such as Zendesk or HubSpot.
  • Experience delivering training, webinars, or workshops to clients or end users.
  • Professional working proficiency in French.

Benefits

  • Health benefit package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Disability, and more!)
  • Generous Paid Time Off benefits, including:
    • 22 days of PTO (vacation, personal time, whatever you choose to use it for)
    • 13 paid public holidays
    • 10 Paid Sick Days
  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Two paid volunteering days per year
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Flexible working with support for WFH setup / equipment
  • Month-long Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of service
  • Varied range of regular social activities throughout the year
Working From HomeWhile many Spektrix team members live near one of our offices (NYC, London, or Manchester), remote/non-local team members work from home most of the time, and all team members work from home at least some of the time!

We provide reasonable support and all the hardware you need to get started, but we do require that you have the have the following in place to work from home:
  • A quiet working space at home where you can consistently take video calls without interruption
  • A strong, reliable internet connection that supports your participation in video calls and access to our systems and service
Working At The OfficeFor team members who are 'local' to NYC, a stipend is offered for each day you work on-site. Think of it as our way of easing potential commute related costs (but no need to prove it - this is a perk we offer for days worked onsite, regardless of how you choose to get there).

Equal OpportunitiesSpektrix is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age or disability status and look to employ from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.

Spektrix is committed to creating an inclusive work environment, where our team members are supported in expressing themselves and delivering their best work. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.
Diversity in the workplace is hugely important to our working environment and to enable both individuals and Spektrix to thrive. By valuing each person’s differences we enable each person to contribute their unique experiences, strengths and viewpoints. Workplace diversity is something we aim to achieve and maintain at Spektrix, and we are pursuing a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and work in. We aim to reflect this diversity in all departments and at all levels of seniority in the business, right up to the board.

In an effort to help us reduce bias, please do not include a photo on your resume or application.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use automated or AI-supported tools to assist with screening and assessing applications. These tools are used strictly to support, not replace, human decision-making. Every resume is reviewed manually by a recruiter, and AI is never the sole source of whether an applicant is considered for employment.

raw.excerpt: All Together, Extraordinary Aduna is the Connector of networks, bringing together leading telecom operators and technology partners to simplify global access to Network APIs.
raw.description:
All Together, Extraordinary

Aduna is the Connector of networks, bringing together leading telecom operators and technology partners to simplify global access to Network APIs. Through a single, unified platform, we enable businesses and developers to build more secure, seamless and innovative digital services.

We are looking for a Senior Customer Engineer to join Aduna's Customer Engineering team, where Product, Engineering, customers, and CSPs come together to solve complex integration and platform challenges.

In this role, you will work directly with customers, telecom operators, and internal teams to analyze requirements, design technical solutions, and help shape the evolution of Aduna's platform. You will take ownership of challenging technical problems, bridge the gap between customer needs and product capabilities, and help ensure that real-world market requirements become scalable platform solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze customer and CSP requirements that fall outside Aduna's standard product capabilities and assess technical feasibility.
  • Design technical solutions and platform adaptations while maintaining alignment with CAMARA, TM Forum, and Open Gateway standards where possible.
  • Work directly with customer integration teams and CSP engineering counterparts to troubleshoot issues, answer technical questions, and drive successful integrations.
  • Translate market requirements into clear technical recommendations for Product and Engineering teams.
  • Identify recurring integration patterns and help determine which capabilities should become standard product features.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Network API standards through insights gained from customer and CSP engagements.
  • Build and maintain technical demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and reference implementations.
  • Support customer prototyping and early-stage solution validation activities.
  • Create technical documentation, design recommendations, and engineering requirements that support product development and market delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management to ensure customer and operator feedback influences future platform development.
  • Share knowledge and best practices across the Customer Engineering team to continuously improve how the function operates.

Experience, Knowledge and Skills Required

  • Strong engineering background with hands-on experience in API integration, solution architecture, platform engineering, or related technical disciplines.
  • Deep understanding of modern APIs, integration patterns, authentication flows, and distributed systems.
  • Experience working directly with customers on technical problem-solving and solution design.
  • Ability to independently analyze complex technical challenges and drive solutions from concept to implementation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, architecture recommendations, and integration guidance.
  • Self-starter mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a global environment across multiple cultures and time zones.
  • Collaborative approach and willingness to share expertise across teams and functions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with telecommunications operators, CSPs, or network infrastructure providers.
  • Familiarity with CAMARA APIs, Open Gateway, TM Forum standards, or related telecom ecosystem initiatives.
  • Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and CIBA authentication flows.
  • Experience with API productization and API lifecycle management.
  • Exposure to standards organizations such as CAMARA, TM Forum, or GSMA.
  • Experience designing developer-facing solutions, developer tooling, or platform integrations.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • You enjoy solving complex technical challenges that span products, customers, and operators.
  • You are comfortable working in ambiguous situations and creating clarity where none exists.
  • You build credibility quickly with engineers, architects, customers, and business stakeholders.
  • You combine technical depth with a practical focus on delivering workable solutions.
  • You thrive in highly collaborative environments and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.
  • You take ownership of outcomes and consistently drive progress without waiting for direction.

Why Join Aduna?

  • Work at the intersection of telecommunications, APIs, and modern developer platforms.
  • Help shape how Network APIs are adopted globally by operators, enterprises, and partners.
  • Influence both customer success and long-term product evolution.
  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, Supply, and Sales teams in a highly collaborative environment.
  • Solve meaningful technical challenges with visible impact on customers and the industry.
  • Join a growing team where your expertise will directly influence how the Customer Engineering function evolves.

Our MXDR service combines powerful proprietary AI with a one-of-a-kind collaboration model to continuously build a deep understanding of our customers’ environments, informing how we prevent, detect, and respond to threats. Our unrivaled Microsoft expertise allows customers to achieve these outcomes with the Microsoft Security tools they already own. The result is highly localized managed protection that empowers security teams to be faster, smarter, and more cost efficient than ever before.

Continuous protection. AI-powered Nonstop SecOps. That’s Ontinue.

Your mission

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Key Account Manager to join our team. This role is critical to our growth strategy and involves managing and nurturing key client relationships, driving customer satisfaction, increasing retention, and expanding our footprint within existing accounts.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in sales, account management, customer success, and a deep understanding of Microsoft security solutions and managed security services.

Key Responsibilities and skills required:

  • Own and grow strategic customer accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and building strong relationships with technical, security, and executive stakeholders.

Identify opportunities to expand value, align Ontinue solutions to customer needs, and coordinate internal experts to support customer outcomes and long-term partnership growth.

About Cargobase

At Cargobase, we build a collaborative platform that connects enterprise shippers (e.g. Bosch, Reckitt Benckiser, Goodyear, Ennoconn) and Logistics Service Providers (e.g. DHL, DSV, FedEx) to work together across complex freight operations. The platform supports the full logistics lifecycle - from urgent ad-hoc shipments to long-term tenders, and from invoicing and compliance to reporting and analytics. Our customers rely on Cargobase as a system embedded in their day-to-day operations.

Cargobase is entering its next phase of growth, scaling its product ecosystem, modernizing platform architecture, and expanding its global customer base. As customer complexity and commercial ambition increase, execution quality and customer outcomes become business-critical.

Role Overview

The Senior Customer Excellence Manager owns the full post-sales customer lifecycle, with accountability for onboarding, implementation, platform support, ongoing success, and commercial expansion within existing accounts. This role leads a global team of generalist Customer Excellence Consultants and is responsible not only for delivery quality and customer outcomes, but also for retention, expansion readiness, and revenue protection post-sale.

The role operates at the intersection of delivery, customer value realization, and commercial outcomes, ensuring customers adopt broadly, expand intentionally, and remain long-term strategic accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a global team of Customer Excellence Consultants across all levels.
  • Define clear expectations for consultants across delivery excellence, customer ownership, and commercial awareness.
  • Build career paths, conduct performance reviews, and promote a culture of accountability and collaboration.
  • Ensure consultants can manage technical implementation and identify expansion signals and upsell readiness during engagements.

Implementation Ownership

  • Oversee the successful implementation of the Cargobase platform for new customers, ensuring a smooth and timely onboarding process.
  • Define and maintain implementation frameworks, playbooks, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Sales to address blockers, ensure customer readiness, and meet go-live commitments.
  • Ensure implementations are designed to support future scope expansion, integrations, and volume growth.

Customer Experience Management

  • Ensure a seamless and unified post-sales experience covering onboarding, support, and success
  • Establish team workflows to deliver timely support responses, effective issue resolution, and proactive account engagement.
  • Develop structured customer touchpoints and lifecycle strategies that scale across regions and customer types.
  • Track and optimize customer health metrics (e.g., NPS, CES, adoption rates, time-to-resolution).
  • Ensure Customer Excellence acts as the primary signal source for churn risk, upsell timing, and account growth opportunities.

Commercial Expansion & Revenue Impact

  • Partner with Sales to support account expansion, renewals, and commercial growth within existing customers.
  • Ensure Customer Excellence identifies, qualifies, and documents expansion opportunities (additional lanes, volumes, modules, regions).
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and handoff models between Customer Excellence and Sales for upsell execution.
  • Drive expansion readiness by ensuring customers are operationally stable, adopted, and value-aligned before commercial discussions.
  • Track and report post-sales commercial metrics, including retention, expansion contribution, and at-risk revenue.
  • Embed commercial thinking into Customer Excellence processes without compromising customer trust or delivery quality.

Process & Operational Excellence

  • Own and continuously improve the Customer Excellence Playbook.
  • Implement systems, SLAs, and metrics to manage workload, track performance, and improve response quality.
  • Support rollout and usage of internal tools, knowledge base, ticketing, and self-service resources.
  • Identify efficiency opportunities through data insights and team feedback.

Internal & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the senior voice of the customer across the company, bringing insights to Product, Engineering, and Sales teams.
  • Drive post-implementation feedback loops to influence product improvements.
  • Partner with Sales to support account expansion and retention strategies.
  • Contribute to strategic planning for scaling the customer experience function.

Education & Experience

  • 6-8 years of experience in post-sales customer-facing roles, including implementation, onboarding, and support.
  • 3+ years in a team leadership or management role, ideally within SaaS, logistics, or B2B platforms.
  • Demonstrated ownership of customer lifecycle outcomes including retention and expansion.
  • Comfortable in spreadsheet software (Excel, Google Sheets) and BI solutions (PowerBI, Metabase, Qlik)
  • Familiarity with practical applications of AI in business workflows is a big plus
  • Proven Track record of owning and improving customer onboarding and implementation processes.
  • Structured management of customer relationships, support cases, and follow-ups.
  • Effective coordination of cross-functional projects and implementations.
  • Clear, scalable documentation for customers and internal teams.
  • Experience working with enterprise systems and integrations is a plus.
  • Knowledge of supply chain/ freight forwarding background is a plus

Benefits

  • 21 days annual leave plus all national public holidays.
  • Additional Years of Service Leave.
  • Flexible wellness benefit for gym memberships and more.
  • Remote work from South Africa
  • Opportunity to work in a fast-growing global technology company with strong career growth potential.

Product and Partner Implementation Manager | Relevate Health

WHO WE ARE

At Relevate Health, we believe every HCP communication should be genuinely relevant, and we've built a company of exceptional people around that purpose. We're healthcare marketing experts who push ourselves every day to deliver life-changing engagement, and our work is growing fast, especially in point-of-care solutions that put the right message in front of clinicians at the right moment in their workflow.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Our Point of Care (POC) product portfolio has grown exponentially, and we're adding new partners and new products at a pace that calls for someone who can build the machine behind the momentum. As our Product and Partner Implementation Manager, you'll take new and evolving POC-enabled healthcare advertising products, including EHR offerings, and turn them into fully operational, compliant, and scalable solutions that our teams can confidently sell, execute, and support.

You'll sit at the center of a cross-functional network spanning Product, Technology, Marketing Operations, Delivery, Analytics, Sales, Client Service, and external vendor partners. You'll define the workflows, document the specs, run the pilots, and write the playbook for how Relevate Health onboards every new partner and product from here on out. You won't own contracts or system builds. You'll own clarity: who does what, when, and how, so launches go smoothly and teams hand off with confidence. This is a role for someone who is energized by ambiguity and can drive alignment without direct authority.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the end-to-end operationalization of POC products and partners, from concept through launch
  • Manage pilot projects and lead cross-functional teams to develop SOPs, tech specs, vendor and client spec documents, Workfront templates, and Sales and Account decks
  • Translate product strategy into clear workflows, intake requirements, and execution playbooks
  • Define roles, responsibilities, SLAs, and handoffs across internal teams and external partners
  • Own cross-functional launch readiness for new products and major enhancements, including checklists, timelines, and risk mitigation plans
  • Serve as the point of accountability for confirming products are ready to sell, execute, and support
  • Lead operational alignment with vendors and platform partners: define requirements, confirm readiness before launch, document specs, SLAs, and escalation paths, and support onboarding, QA, and ongoing performance review
  • Partner with Technology and SDS teams by defining operational requirements and real-world use cases, and supporting UAT and launch readiness
  • Partner with the POC Solutions team to deliver training for Sales, internal teams, and key stakeholders
  • Create and maintain SOPs, workflow documentation, requirements docs, and product playbooks as products, vendors, and regulations evolve
  • Hand off ongoing management to each team's functional leaders once products are live
  • Monitor adoption, execution quality, and operational performance, gather feedback, and drive continuous improvement

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves

  • 5 to 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Implementation, Marketing Operations, or Ad Operations
  • Proven experience designing and documenting processes, and implementing them in a prior role
  • Experience managing third-party vendors and partner relationships
  • Experience building and directing cross-functional teams
  • Experience managing pilot projects
  • Strong process design, documentation, and cross-functional leadership skills
  • Ability to operationalize products with both internal and external partners
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and driving clarity without direct authority
  • Proficiency with Microsoft products

Big Pluses

  • Experience with EHR, healthcare advertising, ad tech, or other regulated digital products
  • Agency or pharma experience
  • Familiarity with Workfront or similar project management tools
  • Experience working with Legal, Procurement, and Technology teams on vendor onboarding

This role can be fully remote. If you live within 40 miles of a Relevate Health office (Cincinnati, or New Jersey), the role is hybrid. Travel is not regular, but you may join the team in person a few times a year for team meetings.

WHY RELEVATE?

We offer more than a job. We offer a place to grow, do meaningful work, and feel genuinely supported doing it.

Our Culture & Values

Be a part of a compassionate, driven team that emphasizes open communication through our PACT Core Values: Pioneering, Accountable, Caring, and Transparent.

PACT Bonus Program

We put our money where our values are. Every month, we recognize colleagues who go above and beyond to exemplify our PACT Core Values with a monetary bonus ranging from $500 to $2,500. At Relevate, living our values doesn't go unnoticed.

Be a Part of Our FUN!

  • Team Impact: Bringing our colleagues together to think outside the box and implement ingenious activities to involve, inspire, and facilitate positivity and caring.
  • Team HOPE: Seeks out philanthropic opportunities so that we can proactively care, respect, help, serve, and grow.

Set Up for Success

A welcoming onboarding program with the focus on setting our new colleagues up for success from day one.

Competitive Pay & Top Benefits, Including:

  • Unlimited PTO
  • 401K
  • Pet Insurance
  • Health, Dental & Vision
  • Employer-paid STD, LTD, Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital, and Life Insurance
  • and more!

READY TO APPLY?

If you're a systems-minded builder who loves turning complexity into clear, repeatable process, and you want to shape how a fast-growing portfolio scales, we want to hear from you. This is your chance to write the playbook, not just follow one. Apply today and let's talk.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. In this role, you'll be expected to: 

Live Service P&L Ownership

  • Own the P&L across VOID’s live service portfolio, including titles already in market and projects entering launch.
  • Set the strategic direction for how our live service content creates value for players and the business, with real emphasis on customisation, identity, and long-term engagement.

Economy andMonetisationDesign

  • Build economy frameworks that scale across the live calendar: battle passes, stores, pricing, consumables, progression, currency.
  • Design and ship monetisation features alongside design, production, and engineering, turning concepts into shippable systems and a steady content cadence.
  • Coordinate monetisation execution across the live calendar: seasonal beats, in-game merchandising, promotions, special initiatives. Keep delivery realistic and don’t overcommit the team.

Data, Analytics, and Infrastructure

  • Own the architecture and rollout of VOID’s data warehouse, attribution stack, and analytics infrastructure across the live portfolio.
  • Lead vendor evaluation and selection for MMP, BI, and CRM platforms in coordination with studio leadership.
  • Define and stand up cohort frameworks, retention reporting, and the core KPIs we’ll measure across UA, monetisation, and engagement.
  • Run the analytics function as a player-coach. Write the queries, build the dashboards, then scale the team as the business case justifies it.

Player Insight and Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Stay close to player feedback and performance signals. Watch how monetised content affects satisfaction, retention, and sentiment, and adjust the plan when the data says to.
  • Partner with Marketing and Publishing on UA, lifecycle, and pricing strategy.
  • Set the working models with internal teams and external partners (including our publishing team at Miniboss) so content gets produced efficiently and lands with the right player context.

Here's what you'll be bringing to the team: 

  • 7+ years in live service, F2P, or growth roles at game studios or publishers, with leadership-track responsibilities.
  • Proven ownership of a live service P&L at scale, with revenue and retention outcomes you can point to.
  • Hands-on experience designing battle passes, stores, pricing, progression, and economy balance for F2P or hybrid titles.
  • Strong technical chops, including SQL, cohort analysis, segmentation, A/B testing, and the underlying data infrastructure decisions.
  • Experience leading or scoping data warehouse builds, MMP integrations, and attribution stack setup.
  • Confidence presenting strategy and performance insights to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Product, Analytics, Game Design, or equivalent experience.

Bonus points if you have: 

  • Experience scaling live service operations from launch through year-threelifecycle.
  • Track record of building monetisation strategy from scratch on titles without existing brand equity.
  • Familiarity with platform pricing constraints, regulatory considerations, fraud prevention, and consumer trust.
  • Experience with tools like Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Braze, or similar BI and CRM platforms.
  • Console, PC, and mobile live service experience with platform-specific considerations.
  • Strong taste in games and a player-first approach to monetisation design.

Please Note: This role is offered as a full-time employee position for candidates based in Ireland.  For candidates based outside of Ireland, the role will be engaged on a full-time contractor basis, subject to local laws and eligibility requirements. We are a remote-first company and are committed to hiring the best candidate for the role, regardless of location. Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

  • Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities

  • Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time
  • Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers
  • Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge
  • Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact

Customer / Market Engagement

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts
  • Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies
  • Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts
  • timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution
  • Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments
  • Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions
  • Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

  • Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards
  • Manage regional budgets and resources effectively
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline
  • Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role
  • Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals
  • Prior launch experience required; first-launch / startup biotech experience strongly preferred
  • Experience in cardiovascular, nephrology, hypertension, or related specialty markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success in recruiting and developing top talent
  • Strong business planning, analytical, and coaching skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment
  • Willingness to travel extensively within region

Leadership Profile

  • A strong coach who develops people and builds winning teams
  • Highly accountable, with a bias for action and urgency
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping build infrastructure
  • Collaborative and able to influence across functions
  • Resilient, adaptable, and energized by launch environments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 60% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. raw.description:
Red Nucleus is hiring an Associate Client Engagement Manager to join our global Medical Communications team! This is a home-based position out of Canada.

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.

At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a “Great Place to Work".

Job Overview

The Associate Client Engagement Manager supports day-to-day client engagement and execution of publications and medical communications projects across assigned accounts and projects. This role partners closely with Client Engagement Directors to ensure high-quality delivery, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction while developing the skills required for increased ownership and leadership.

The Associate Client Engagement Manager plays a critical role in coordinating workstreams, managing project documentation, tracking timelines and finances, and facilitating clear communication between clients and internal teams. This individual thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong attention to detail, and is proactive in anticipating needs and solving problems.

Responsibilities:

Under the guidance of a Client Engagement Director, theAssociateClient Engagement Manageris responsible for:

  • Supporting day-to-day client communications and serving as a secondary point of contact for assigned projects.
  • Assisting with execution of publications & medical communications projects from initiation through completion.
  • Supporting development of project briefs, timelines, scopes of work, and internal documentation.
  • Coordinating project activities across internal capability teams such as Scientific, Creative & Editorial
  • Tracking project timelines, deliverables, and milestones; escalating risks or delays as needed.
  • Preparing client status updates, meeting agendas, recaps, and action-item follow-ups.
  • Supporting budget tracking, forecasting, and reconciliations under the direction of senior team members.
  • Manage entry, update, and maintenance of publication records within Datavision (or similar publications management platforms)
  • Assisting with scope change documentation and change orders as required.
  • Supporting the medical/regulatory/legal (MLR) review process, including document submission systems (e.g., Veeva).
  • Reviewing materials for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with client feedback prior to submission.
  • Ensuring adherence to agency and client SOPs, compliance standards, and industry regulations.
  • Participating in client meetings, advisory boards, congresses, and speaker programs as appropriate with limited travel required.
  • Maintaining organized project records and documentation.
  • Performing other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Education and Experience

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Communications, Marketing, Life Sciences, or related field preferred). Advanced degree a plus.

Experience

  • 3-5+ years of experience in medical communications, medical education, pharma marketing, or related fields.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Foundational understanding of the life sciences industry and medical communications environment
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Familiarity with medical publication processes and industry guidelines
  • Working knowledge of publications management tools such as Datavision
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality, accuracy, and compliance
  • Ability to follow processes while learning when and how to escalate issues
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners
  • Willingness to learn and grow into increased client and financial responsibility
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
  • Familiarity with project management tools and document submission systems (e.g., Veeva PromoMats) preferred
  • Ability to adapt quickly to new tools, technologies, and processes

Compensation Disclosure:

The compensation range for this role is $80,000 to $93,000 CAN. Compensation will be determined based on an applicant’s skills, competencies, experience, and qualifications. Employees may progress within this range over time based on performance, tenure, and internal equity considerations. Red Nucleus Employees may progress within this range over time based on performance, tenure, and internal equity considerations.

Diversity, equity and inclusion are valued at Red Nucleus and we believe we have a shared responsibility to provide equal opportunity and foster an inclusive spirit. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, caste, sexual orientation, gender, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Description

TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.

Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career.

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

TripleTen is a remote first organization mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment

We are looking for a high energy, consultative Technical Senior Sales Consultant to work with a more advanced audience: experienced tech professionals who already work in the industry and are looking to deepen their expertise, switch specializations, or move into senior and higher paying roles. This is a step above our core B2C sales team. You'll be selling an advanced program to experienced engineers, so you need to hold a credible, peer-level conversation and be comfortable across the full arc of modern systems engineering (system design and architecture, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems and data, security, and production AI). You won't need to write code, but you must understand these concepts well enough to answer real questions, map the curriculum to the roles and salaries candidates are targeting, and earn the trust of people who have hands-on experience.

The best candidates for this position combine strong consultative sales skills with genuine comfort in technical conversations, and thrive on complex, high value deals rather than high volume transactional sales.

What you will do

  • Operate as a full cycle sales consultant, engaging technically experienced prospects, qualifying their goals, and guiding them to a decision
  • Hold credible, informed conversations about technical topics relevant to our advanced courses, without needing to defer every technical question elsewhere
  • Present and articulate TripleTen's value proposition for career advancement and skill deepening, tailored to an audience that already has industry experience
  • Work closely with sales leadership to close complex, higher ticket deals and consistently meet or exceed quota
  • Work closely with marketing to refine messaging and positioning for this more experienced audience
  • Maintain accurate documentation of leads and pipeline progress using HubSpot
  • Bring consultative rigor and technical credibility to a team built around trust and expertise

﻿Weekly Schedule:

11:00 AM - 8:00 PM (EST) Monday to Thursday, 9:00 AM (EST) - 6:00 PM (EST) rotating Friday or Saturday

Requirements

  • 3+ years closing high-ticket deals ($5k+) yourself, full cycle — B2B SaaS, tech sales, EdTech or other complex products
  • Strong discovery skills - able to diagnose a prospect's goals and gaps before pitching, not lead with a script.
  • Fluent English (C1 or above)
  • Technical background or experience selling to technical buyers is a plus, not a requirement

What we can offer you

  • Base Compensation: $5,400/month + uncapped commission based on hitting monthly cash-in quota. Total monthly earnings typically range from $6,000 to $10,000+ for consistent performers, with no cap on top results.
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom — to make working together seamless
  • Growth. Our product is expanding quickly, so it's a great time to get on board and challenge yourself
  • Internationally distributed team. Exceptional teammates, who love what they do

Disclosures

*This description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time.

**TripleTen is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national original, age, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.
